About the Role
 We are looking for Procurement Specialist to join our team and help manage our organization’s procurement needs in area of Information Technology (IT).
 Responsibilities of Procurement Specialist IT include:

• Support a variety of initiatives to reduce costs and improve quality of goods and services provided by third parties for category areas such as Hardware, Software, Licenses, Cloud & Connectivity, IT Outsourcing

• Lead commercial negotiations for assigned business cases

• Prepare, review and negotiate contracts, initiate legal reviews and vendor due diligence process where needed

• Execute comprehensive RFx process followed by full contract life cycle management

• Review and approve purchase orders to ensure compliance with internal standards and guidelines

• Collaborate with Category Managers in developing and implementing procurement strategies across the organization

• Communicate with internal partners to ensure that purchased products and services meet the business needs and support strategic goals

• Cooperate with cross-functional teams to ensure compliance with digital governance
 About the Team
 You will be part of IT & Data Procurement, a unit within Group Procurement Team of Swiss Re. As a member of this unit you will work closely with Procurement Specialists and Category Managers based primarily in Bratislava, Zurich and London.
 About You

• You have a bachelor’s or master´s degree preferably in Economics / Business Administration or a Procurement, Supply chain degree.

• You have around 3-4 years of experience in purchasing of IT categories or similar in a global organization with multi-million spend.

• You have strong negotiations skills and can demonstrate focused delivery of significant cost savings/service improvements

• You are detailed and process oriented person.

• You have sophisticated verbal and written command of English (other language is desirable, German would be a plus).

• You are naturally proactive, a problem solver, able to navigate ambiguity and passionate about customer outcomes.
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week
 For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between EUR 1,900 and EUR 3,200 per month (for a full-time role).
 The specific salary offered considers:
 • the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,
 • the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialization, skills and experience.
 In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits.

We provide feedback to all candidates via email. If you have not heard back from us, please check your spam folder.
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 14,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work.

Informazioni sul ruolo
Siamo alla ricerca di Procurement Specialist per unire il nostro team e contribuire a gestire le esigenze di approvvigionamento della nostra organizzazione in area di Information Technology (IT).
Responsabilità del Procurement Specialist IT includono:

• Sostenere una serie di iniziative per ridurre i costi e migliorare la qualità dei beni e dei servizi forniti da terzi per settori di categoria quali Hardware, Software, Licenze, Cloud & Connectivity, IT Outsourcing

• Principali negoziati commerciali per i casi aziendali assegnati

• Preparare, rivedere e negoziare i contratti, avviare le recensioni legali e il processo di due diligence del venditore dove necessario

• Eseguire un processo RFx completo seguito da una gestione completa del ciclo di vita del contratto

• Revisione e approvazione degli ordini di acquisto per garantire il rispetto delle norme e delle linee guida interne

• Collabora con i responsabili della categoria nello sviluppo e nell'attuazione delle strategie di approvvigionamento in tutta l'organizzazione

• Comunicare con partner interni per garantire che i prodotti e i servizi acquistati soddisfino le esigenze aziendali e supportino gli obiettivi strategici

• Collaborare con team interfunzionali per garantire il rispetto della governance digitale
Informazioni sulla squadra
Sarete parte di IT & Data Procurement, un'unità all'interno del Gruppo Procurement Team di Swiss Re. Come membro di questa unità lavorerai a stretto contatto con gli Specialisti di appalti e i Manager di categoria con sede principalmente a Bratislava, Zurigo e Londra.
A proposito di te

• Hai un diploma di laurea o master preferibilmente in Economia / Business Administration o un corso di laurea, Supply Chain Degree.

• Hai circa 3-4 anni di esperienza nell'acquisto di categorie IT o simili in un'organizzazione globale con spesa multimilionaria.

• Hai forti competenze di negoziazione e può dimostrare la consegna focalizzata di significativi risparmi di costo / miglioramenti di servizio

• Siete persona dettagliata e orientata al processo.

• Avete un sofisticato comando verbale e scritto dell'inglese (l'altra lingua è desiderabile, il tedesco sarebbe un plus).

• Sei naturalmente proattivo, un risolutore di problemi, in grado di navigare ambiguità e appassionato sui risultati del cliente.
La nostra azienda ha un modello di lavoro ibrido in cui l'aspettativa è che sarete in ufficio almeno tre giorni alla settimana
Per la Slovacchia la gamma di stipendio base per questa posizione è compresa tra 1.900 euro e 3.200 euro al mese (per un ruolo a tempo pieno).
Lo stipendio specifico offerto considera:
• i requisiti, la portata, la complessità e le responsabilità del ruolo,
• il proprio profilo del richiedente, tra cui istruzione/qualifica, competenza, specializzazione, competenze ed esperienza.
Oltre al tuo stipendio base, potresti essere idoneo per ulteriori ricompense e benefici.

Forniamo feedback a tutti i candidati via e-mail. Se non avete sentito indietro da noi, si prega di controllare la cartella spam.
Informazioni su Swiss Re
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione, lavorando per rendere il mondo più resiliente. Aspettiamo e gestiamo una vasta gamma di rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine. Combinando l'esperienza con il pensiero creativo e l'esperienza all'avanguardia, creiamo nuove opportunità e soluzioni per i nostri clienti. Questo è possibile grazie alla collaborazione di oltre 14.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Abbracciamo un posto di lavoro dove ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il loro sé autentico al lavoro.

Über die Rolle
Wir suchen einen Einkaufsspezialisten, der sich unserem Team anschließt und bei der Verwaltung des Beschaffungsbedarfs unserer Organisation im Bereich Informationstechnologie (IT) hilft.
Zu den Aufgaben des Beschaffungsspezialisten IT gehören:

• Unterstützung einer Vielzahl von Initiativen zur Kostensenkung und Verbesserung der Qualität von Waren und Dienstleistungen, die von Dritten für Kategoriebereiche wie Hardware, Software, Lizenzen, Cloud & Connectivity, IT Outsourcing bereitgestellt werden

• Führen Sie kommerzielle Verhandlungen für zugewiesene Geschäftsfälle

• Vorbereitung, Überprüfung und Verhandlung von Verträgen, Einleitung von rechtlichen Überprüfungen und Vendor Due Diligence Prozess, wo nötig

• Ausführen eines umfassenden RFx-Prozesses, gefolgt von einem Full Contract Lifecycle Management

• Überprüfung und Genehmigung von Bestellungen, um die Einhaltung interner Standards und Richtlinien sicherzustellen

• Zusammenarbeit mit Category Managern bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Beschaffungsstrategien im gesamten Unternehmen

• Kommunizieren Sie mit internen Partnern, um sicherzustellen, dass gekaufte Produkte und Dienstleistungen den Geschäftsanforderungen entsprechen und strategische Ziele unterstützen

• Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams, um die Einhaltung der digitalen Governance sicherzustellen
Über das Team
Sie werden Teil von IT & Data Procurement, einer Einheit im Group Procurement Team von Swiss Re. Als Mitglied dieser Einheit arbeiten Sie eng mit Einkaufsspezialisten und Category Managern mit Sitz in Bratislava, Zürich und London zusammen.
Über dich

• Sie haben einen Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss vorzugsweise in Economics / Business Administration oder einen Procurement-, Supply Chain-Abschluss.

• Sie haben etwa 3-4 Jahre Erfahrung im Einkauf von IT-Kategorien oder ähnlichem in einer globalen Organisation mit mehreren Millionen Ausgaben.

• Sie verfügen über ein starkes Verhandlungsgeschick und können eine gezielte Bereitstellung signifikanter Kosteneinsparungen / Serviceverbesserungen nachweisen

• Sie sind eine detaillierte und prozessorientierte Person.

• Sie haben anspruchsvolle mündliche und schriftliche Englischkenntnisse (andere Sprache ist wünschenswert, Deutsch wäre ein Plus).

• Sie sind natürlich proaktiv, ein Problemlöser, in der Lage, Mehrdeutigkeiten zu navigieren und leidenschaftlich über Kundenergebnisse.
Unser Unternehmen hat ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, bei dem erwartet wird, dass Sie mindestens drei Tage pro Woche im Büro sind
Für die Slowakei liegt die Grundgehaltsspanne für diese Position zwischen 1.900 EUR und 3.200 EUR pro Monat (für eine Vollzeitstelle).
Das angebotene spezifische Gehalt berücksichtigt:
• Anforderungen, Umfang, Komplexität und Zuständigkeiten der Rolle,
• das eigene Profil des Antragstellers, einschließlich Ausbildung/Qualifikationen, Fachwissen, Spezialisierung, Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung.

Wir geben allen Kandidaten Feedback per E-Mail. Wenn Sie noch nichts von uns gehört haben, überprüfen Sie bitte Ihren Spam-Ordner.
Über Swiss Re
Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen des versicherungsbasierten Risikotransfers und arbeitet daran, die Welt widerstandsfähiger zu machen. Wir antizipieren und managen eine Vielzahl von Risiken, von Naturkatastrophen und Klimawandel bis hin zu Cyberkriminalität. Durch die Kombination von Erfahrung mit kreativem Denken und modernster Expertise schaffen wir neue Möglichkeiten und Lösungen für unsere Kunden. Dies ist dank der Zusammenarbeit von mehr als 14.000 Mitarbeitern auf der ganzen Welt möglich.

Unser Erfolg hängt von unserer Fähigkeit ab, eine integrative Kultur aufzubauen, die neue Perspektiven und innovatives Denken fördert. Wir nehmen einen Arbeitsplatz an, an dem jeder die gleichen Chancen hat, beruflich zu gedeihen und sich zu entwickeln, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Rasse, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Geschlechtsidentität und / oder Ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, körperlicher oder geistiger Fähigkeit, Fähigkeiten, Gedanken oder anderen Eigenschaften. jobs.description:
Are you ready to bring your risk and financial expertise to a dynamic, global environment? Join Swiss Re Corporate Solutions in London and play a key role in supporting our UK, Irish and international clients with their surety and guarantee needs. This is your opportunity to combine analytical excellence with meaningful client relationships — all within a truly entrepreneurial and collaborative setting.

About the Role
 As an Underwriter Surety based in London, you will be an integral part of our growing Surety Europe team, connecting analytical insight with hands-on client management. You will work closely with corporates and brokers across the UK, Ireland and internationally, balancing risk underwriting with client-facing responsibilities. This role offers a fantastic platform to develop your surety career within one of the world's leading surety groups.
 Key responsibilities:

• Conduct comprehensive risk assessments for new and existing clients, ensuring alignment with Swiss Re's risk appetite while maintaining the highest standards of client satisfaction

• Manage your own client portfolio and transactions, identifying and developing new business opportunities across the UK, Ireland and broader Europe

• Analyse and evaluate credit and transactional risks in close collaboration with internal stakeholders, applying rigorous financial and legal due diligence

• Approve transactions within your own authority levels and prepare structured submissions for relevant committees

• Build and nurture strong client and broker relationships through regular, proactive engagement and meaningful face-to-face interactions

• Conduct market analysis to identify changes in the underwriting, market and legal landscape, assessing their risk implications and adapting strategies accordingly

• Collaborate with and support colleagues across the wider European Surety team, contributing to a culture of shared knowledge and continuous improvement

About the Team
 Backed by more than 150 years of experience, significant capacity and the financial strength of the Swiss Re Group, Swiss Re Corporate Solutions solves the risk management and financing needs of corporations around the globe. We pursue the goal of results-oriented underwriting. The positive relationship with our customers and brokers in the UK, Ireland and broader Europe, combined with our strong brand, is the foundation of our success. If you share the passion for surety and financial products, we encourage you to apply for this position. As part of a global team offering tailor-made solutions across a broad range of surety products, you will have the opportunity to join a highly motivated team that shares the same passion for this business.
 About You
 You thrive in an international, team-oriented environment and enjoy combining analytical thinking with client engagement. You are a proactive communicator who builds trust with clients and business partners naturally, and you bring a solutions-focused mindset to every challenge. You are comfortable working both independently and collaboratively, and you are eager to contribute to the continued growth of a market-leading surety business.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Minimum 3 years of relevant professional experience, preferably within a bank, surety insurer or financial institution with exposure to credit and guarantee products

• Strong understanding of credit risks and financial markets, particularly in relation to debt financing, capital market instruments and surety/guarantee structures

• Proven analytical and decision-making skills, with the ability to assess complex credit and transactional risks and translate findings into clear, structured recommendations

• Confident communication and interpersonal skills, with demonstrated experience engaging with clients, brokers and internal stakeholders at a professional level

• Proficiency in English (written and verbal) is essential; additional European language skills are a strong advantage

These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience working with multinational corporations or in a cross-border European surety/credit context

• Familiarity with legal due diligence processes related to surety or guarantee transactions

• Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong focus on identifying and originating new business opportunities

• Experience using data and market intelligence tools to monitor portfolio performance and market trends

• A university degree or equivalent qualification in finance, economics, law or a related discipline #LI-Hybrid

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.
 For London, the annual base salary range for this position is between GBP 63 000 and GBP 95 000 (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,

• the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.

In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits. Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.
 About Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group. We offer innovative insurance solutions to large and midsized multinational corporations from our approximately 50 locations worldwide. We help clients mitigate their risk exposure, whilst our industry-leading claims service provides them with additional peace of mind.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions embraces a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
 We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei pronto a portare la tua esperienza di rischio e finanziaria in un ambiente dinamico e globale? Partecipa a Swiss Re Corporate Solutions a Londra e gioca un ruolo chiave nel supportare i nostri clienti britannici, irlandesi e internazionali con le loro esigenze di sicurezza e garanzia. Questa è la vostra opportunità di combinare l'eccellenza analitica con relazioni di cliente significative - tutto all'interno di un ambiente veramente imprenditoriale e collaborativo.

Informazioni sul ruolo
Come Underwriter Surety con sede a Londra, sarete parte integrante del nostro team di Surety Europe, in crescita, che mette in relazione l'intuizione analitica con la gestione clienti hands-on. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con le aziende e i broker in tutto il Regno Unito, Irlanda e a livello internazionale, bilanciando la scrittura del rischio con le responsabilità del cliente. Questo ruolo offre una piattaforma fantastica per sviluppare la tua carriera di sicurezza all'interno di uno dei principali gruppi di sicurezza del mondo.
Responsabilità chiave:

• Condurre valutazioni di rischio complete per i clienti nuovi e esistenti, garantendo l'allineamento con l'appetito di rischio di Swiss Re mantenendo i più elevati standard di soddisfazione del cliente

• Gestire il proprio portafoglio clienti e transazioni, identificare e sviluppare nuove opportunità di business in Regno Unito, Irlanda e Europa più ampia

• Analizzare e valutare i rischi di credito e di transazione in stretta collaborazione con gli stakeholder interni, applicando rigorosi debiti finanziari e legali

• Approva le transazioni all'interno dei propri livelli di autorità e prepara le proposte strutturate per i comitati pertinenti

• Costruire e nutrire forti relazioni cliente e broker attraverso un impegno regolare, proattivo e interazioni significative faccia a faccia

• Condurre l'analisi del mercato per identificare i cambiamenti nel contesto della sottoscrizione, del mercato e del paesaggio giuridico, valutare le loro implicazioni di rischio e adattare le strategie di conseguenza

• Collabora con e supporta i colleghi di tutto il team europeo Surety, contribuendo a una cultura della conoscenza condivisa e a un miglioramento continuo

Informazioni sulla squadra
Sostenuta da oltre 150 anni di esperienza, capacità significativa e forza finanziaria del Gruppo Swiss Re, Swiss Re Corporate Solutions risolve le esigenze di gestione e finanziamento dei rischi delle aziende di tutto il mondo. Perseguiamo l'obiettivo della sottoscrizione orientata ai risultati. Il rapporto positivo con i nostri clienti e broker nel Regno Unito, in Irlanda e in Europa più ampia, combinato con il nostro marchio forte, è la base del nostro successo. Se condividi la passione per i prodotti sicuri e finanziari, ti invitiamo a candidarti per questa posizione. Come parte di un team globale che offre soluzioni su misura in una vasta gamma di prodotti di sicurezza, avrete l'opportunità di unire un team altamente motivato che condivide la stessa passione per questo business.
A proposito di te
Si prospera in un ambiente internazionale, team-oriented e godere di combinare il pensiero analitico con il coinvolgimento del cliente. Sei un comunicatore proattivo che costruisce fiducia con clienti e partner commerciali naturalmente, e si porta una mentalità orientata alle soluzioni a ogni sfida. Sei comodo lavorare sia in modo indipendente che collaborativo, e sei desideroso di contribuire alla crescita continua di un business di sicurezza leader di mercato.
Siamo alla ricerca di candidati che soddisfano questi requisiti:

• Minimo 3 anni di esperienza professionale rilevante, preferibilmente all'interno di una banca, un'assicurazione di sicurezza o un'istituzione finanziaria con esposizione al credito e ai prodotti di garanzia

• Forte comprensione dei rischi di credito e dei mercati finanziari, in particolare in relazione al finanziamento del debito, agli strumenti di mercato dei capitali e alle strutture di sicurezza/garanzia

• Prove competenze analitiche e decisionali, con la capacità di valutare i rischi complessi di credito e transazionale e tradurre i risultati in raccomandazioni chiare e strutturate

• Comunicazione sicura e competenze interpersonali, con esperienza dimostrata coinvolgendo clienti, broker e stakeholder interni a livello professionale

• La competenza in inglese (scritto e verbale) è essenziale; ulteriori competenze linguistiche europee sono un forte vantaggio

Questi sono ulteriori bello da avere:

• Esperienza di lavoro con le multinazionali o in un contesto europeo di sicurezza/credito transfrontaliero

• Familiarità con processi legali di due diligence relativi a operazioni di sicurezza o garanzia

• Mindset imprenditoriale con una forte attenzione all'identificazione e all'origine di nuove opportunità di business

• Esperienza utilizzando strumenti di informazione e mercato per monitorare le prestazioni del portafoglio e le tendenze del mercato

• Una laurea o qualifica equivalente in finanza, economia, legge o una disciplina correlata #LI-Hybrid

La nostra azienda ha un modello di lavoro ibrido in cui l'aspettativa è che sarete in ufficio almeno tre giorni alla settimana.
Per Londra, la fascia salariale annuale di base per questa posizione è compresa tra 63 000 GBP e 95 000 GBP (per un ruolo a tempo pieno). Lo stipendio specifico offerto considera:

• i requisiti, la portata, la complessità e le responsabilità del ruolo,

• il proprio profilo del richiedente, tra cui istruzione/qualifica, competenza, specializzazione, competenze ed esperienza.

Oltre al tuo stipendio base, Swiss Re offre un attraente componente di compensazione variabile basato sulle prestazioni, progettato per riconoscere i tuoi risultati. Inoltre potrete godere di una varietà di vantaggi globali e specifici posizione. L'ammissibilità può variare a seconda dei termini delle politiche di Swiss Re e del contratto di lavoro.
Informazioni su Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione. Prevediamo e gestiamo i rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions è il braccio di assicurazione commerciale del Gruppo Swiss Re. Offriamo soluzioni di assicurazione innovative a grandi e medie multinazionali dalle nostre circa 50 sedi in tutto il mondo. Aiutiamo i clienti a mitigare la loro esposizione al rischio, mentre il nostro servizio di reclami leader del settore fornisce loro un'ulteriore pace della mente.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions abbraccia un posto di lavoro in cui ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il proprio sé autentico a lavorare e la loro passione per la sostenibilità.

Se sei un professionista esperto che torna alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.
Possiamo utilizzare strumenti basati su AI per supportare la revisione e la valutazione delle applicazioni per questa posizione. Questi strumenti forniscono ulteriori informazioni ai nostri team di reclutamento, ma tutte le decisioni di assunzione sono attentamente esaminate e fatte dalle persone. Per saperne di più su come utilizziamo l'IA nel reclutamento e come gestiamo i tuoi dati personali, si prega di rivedere la nostra Informativa sulla privacy dei dati prima di applicare.

Sind Sie bereit, Ihre Risiko- und Finanzexpertise in ein dynamisches, globales Umfeld zu bringen? Treten Sie Swiss Re Corporate Solutions in London bei und spielen Sie eine wichtige Rolle bei der Unterstützung unserer britischen, irischen und internationalen Kunden bei ihren Sicherheits- und Garantieanforderungen. Dies ist Ihre Gelegenheit, analytische Exzellenz mit sinnvollen Kundenbeziehungen zu kombinieren - alles in einem wirklich unternehmerischen und kollaborativen Umfeld.

Über die Rolle
Als Underwriter Surety mit Sitz in London sind Sie ein integraler Bestandteil unseres wachsenden Surety Europe-Teams und verbinden analytische Erkenntnisse mit praktischem Kundenmanagement. Sie werden eng mit Unternehmen und Brokern in Großbritannien, Irland und international zusammenarbeiten und das Risikomanagement mit den Verantwortlichkeiten der Kunden in Einklang bringen. Diese Rolle bietet eine fantastische Plattform, um Ihre Bürgschaftskarriere in einer der weltweit führenden Bürgschaftsgruppen zu entwickeln.
Hauptzuständigkeiten:

• Führen Sie umfassende Risikobewertungen für neue und bestehende Kunden durch, um die Übereinstimmung mit der Risikobereitschaft von Swiss Re zu gewährleisten und gleichzeitig die höchsten Standards für die Kundenzufriedenheit einzuhalten

• Verwalten Sie Ihr eigenes Kundenportfolio und Ihre eigenen Transaktionen, identifizieren und entwickeln Sie neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in Großbritannien, Irland und ganz Europa

• Analyse und Bewertung von Kredit- und Transaktionsrisiken in enger Zusammenarbeit mit internen Stakeholdern unter Anwendung einer strengen finanziellen und rechtlichen Sorgfaltspflicht

• Genehmigen Sie Transaktionen innerhalb Ihrer eigenen Behördenebenen und erstellen Sie strukturierte Einreichungen für relevante Ausschüsse

• Aufbau und Pflege starker Kunden- und Brokerbeziehungen durch regelmäßiges, proaktives Engagement und sinnvolle persönliche Interaktionen

• Durchführung von Marktanalysen, um Veränderungen in der Zeichnungs-, Markt- und Rechtslandschaft zu identifizieren, ihre Risikoauswirkungen zu bewerten und Strategien entsprechend anzupassen

• Zusammenarbeit mit und Unterstützung von Kollegen im gesamten europäischen Surety-Team und Beitrag zu einer Kultur des Wissensaustauschs und der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung

Über das Team
Mit mehr als 150 Jahren Erfahrung, beträchtlicher Kapazität und der finanziellen Stärke der Swiss Re Group löst Swiss Re Corporate Solutions die Risikomanagement- und Finanzierungsanforderungen von Unternehmen auf der ganzen Welt. Wir verfolgen das Ziel eines ergebnisorientierten Underwritings. Die positive Beziehung zu unseren Kunden und Brokern in Großbritannien, Irland und Europa, kombiniert mit unserer starken Marke, ist die Grundlage unseres Erfolgs. Wenn Sie die Leidenschaft für Bürgschafts- und Finanzprodukte teilen, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich für diese Position zu bewerben. Als Teil eines globalen Teams, das maßgeschneiderte Lösungen für eine breite Palette von Garantieprodukten anbietet, haben Sie die Möglichkeit, sich einem hochmotivierten Team anzuschließen, das die gleiche Leidenschaft für dieses Geschäft teilt.
Über dich
Sie leben in einem internationalen, teamorientierten Umfeld und verbinden gerne analytisches Denken mit Kundenengagement. Sie sind ein proaktiver Kommunikator, der auf natürliche Weise Vertrauen zu Kunden und Geschäftspartnern aufbaut und bei jeder Herausforderung eine lösungsorientierte Denkweise einbringt. Sie arbeiten sowohl unabhängig als auch kollaborativ und sind bestrebt, zum weiteren Wachstum eines marktführenden Bürgschaftsgeschäfts beizutragen.
Wir suchen Kandidaten, die diese Anforderungen erfüllen:

• Mindestens 3 Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung, vorzugsweise bei einer Bank, einem Versicherer oder einem Finanzinstitut mit Kredit- und Garantieprodukten

• Starkes Verständnis von Kreditrisiken und Finanzmärkten, insbesondere in Bezug auf Fremdfinanzierung, Kapitalmarktinstrumente und Bürgschafts-/Garantiestrukturen

• Bewährte Analyse- und Entscheidungsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Kredit- und Transaktionsrisiken zu bewerten und die Ergebnisse in klare, strukturierte Empfehlungen umzusetzen

• Vertrauensvolle Kommunikation und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten, mit nachgewiesener Erfahrung im Umgang mit Kunden, Brokern und internen Stakeholdern auf professioneller Ebene

• Englischkenntnisse (schriftlich und mündlich) sind unerlässlich; zusätzliche europäische Sprachkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil

Dies sind zusätzliche nett zu haben:

• Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit multinationalen Unternehmen oder in einem grenzüberschreitenden europäischen Bürgschafts- / Kreditkontext

• Vertrautheit mit Legal Due Diligence-Prozessen im Zusammenhang mit Bürgschafts- oder Garantietransaktionen

• Unternehmerische Denkweise mit starkem Fokus auf der Identifizierung und Schaffung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten

• Erfahrung mit Daten und Market Intelligence Tools zur Überwachung der Portfolio-Performance und Markttrends

• Ein Universitätsabschluss oder eine gleichwertige Qualifikation in Finanzen, Wirtschaft, Recht oder einer verwandten Disziplin #LI-Hybrid

Unser Unternehmen hat ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, bei dem erwartet wird, dass Sie mindestens drei Tage pro Woche im Büro sind.
Für London liegt die jährliche Grundgehaltsspanne für diese Position zwischen 63 000 GBP und 95 000 GBP (für eine Vollzeitstelle). Das angebotene spezifische Gehalt berücksichtigt:

• Anforderungen, Umfang, Komplexität und Zuständigkeiten der Rolle,

• das eigene Profil des Antragstellers, einschließlich Ausbildung/Qualifikationen, Fachwissen, Spezialisierung, Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung.

Zusätzlich zu Ihrem Grundgehalt bietet Swiss Re eine attraktive leistungsbasierte variable Vergütungskomponente, die Ihre Leistungen würdigt. Darüber hinaus genießen Sie eine Vielzahl von globalen und standortspezifischen Vorteilen. Die Berechtigung kann je nach den Bedingungen der Swiss Re Police und Ihrem Arbeitsvertrag variieren.
Über Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen der versicherungsbasierten Risikoübertragung. Wir antizipieren und managen Risiken, von Naturkatastrophen und Klimawandel bis hin zu Cyberkriminalität.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions ist der gewerbliche Versicherungszweig der Swiss Re Gruppe. Wir bieten innovative Versicherungslösungen für große und mittlere multinationale Konzerne an unseren rund 50 Standorten weltweit. Wir helfen Kunden, ihre Risikoexposition zu mindern, während unser branchenführender Schadenservice ihnen zusätzliche Sicherheit bietet.

Unser Erfolg hängt von unserer Fähigkeit ab, eine integrative Kultur aufzubauen, die neue Perspektiven und innovatives Denken fördert. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions umfasst einen Arbeitsplatz, an dem jeder die gleichen Chancen hat, beruflich zu gedeihen und sich zu entwickeln, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Rasse, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Geschlechtsidentität und / oder Ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, körperlicher oder geistiger Fähigkeiten, Fähigkeiten, Gedanken oder anderen Eigenschaften. In unserem integrativen und flexiblen Umfeld kann jeder sein authentisches Selbst und seine Leidenschaft für Nachhaltigkeit mitbringen.

Wenn Sie ein erfahrener Profi sind, der nach einer Berufspause in die Belegschaft zurückkehrt, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich für offene Stellen zu bewerben, die Ihren Fähigkeiten und Ihrer Erfahrung entsprechen.
Wir können KI-basierte Tools verwenden, um die Überprüfung und Bewertung von Anwendungen für diese Position zu unterstützen. Diese Tools bieten unseren Rekrutierungsteams zusätzliche Einblicke, aber alle Einstellungsentscheidungen werden sorgfältig überprüft und von Menschen getroffen. Um mehr darüber zu erfahren, wie wir KI bei der Rekrutierung einsetzen und wie wir mit Ihren personenbezogenen Daten umgehen, lesen Sie bitte unsere Datenschutzerklärung, bevor Sie sich bewerben.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Êtes-vous prêt à apporter votre expertise en matière de risques et de finances à un environnement mondial dynamique? Rejoignez Swiss Re Corporate Solutions à Londres et jouez un rôle clé dans le soutien de nos clients britanniques, irlandais et internationaux avec leurs besoins de garantie et de garantie. C'est l'occasion de combiner l'excellence analytique et des relations clients significatives, dans un cadre vraiment entrepreneurial et collaboratif.

À propos du rôle
En tant que Sureté Underwriter basée à Londres, vous ferez partie intégrante de notre équipe croissante de Surety Europe, connectant les idées analytiques à la gestion pratique des clients. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec des entreprises et des courtiers à travers le Royaume-Uni, l'Irlande et à l'échelle internationale, en conciliant la souscription de risques et les responsabilités des clients. Ce rôle offre une plateforme fantastique pour développer votre carrière de caution au sein d'un des principaux groupes de caution du monde.
Principales responsabilités :

• Effectuer des évaluations complètes des risques pour les clients nouveaux et existants, en assurant l'alignement avec l'appétit de risque de Swiss Re tout en maintenant les normes les plus élevées de satisfaction des clients

• Gérez votre propre portefeuille de clients et vos propres transactions, en identifiant et en développant de nouvelles opportunités commerciales à travers le Royaume-Uni, l'Irlande et l'Europe élargie

• Analyser et évaluer les risques liés au crédit et aux transactions en étroite collaboration avec les intervenants internes, en appliquant une diligence raisonnable en matière financière et juridique

• Approuver les transactions au sein de vos propres niveaux d'autorité et préparer des présentations structurées pour les comités pertinents

• Établir et entretenir de solides relations avec les clients et les courtiers grâce à un engagement proactif régulier et à des interactions significatives en personne

• Effectuer une analyse de marché pour identifier les changements dans la souscription, le marché et le paysage juridique, évaluer leurs incidences sur les risques et adapter les stratégies en conséquence

• Collaborer avec des collègues et les soutenir dans l'ensemble de l'équipe de la caution européenne, contribuant à une culture de partage des connaissances et d'amélioration continue

À propos de l'équipe
Forte de plus de 150 ans d'expérience, de capacités importantes et de la solidité financière du Groupe Swiss Re, Swiss Re Corporate Solutions résout les besoins de gestion des risques et de financement des entreprises du monde entier. Nous poursuivons l'objectif de la souscription axée sur les résultats. La relation positive avec nos clients et nos courtiers au Royaume-Uni, en Irlande et dans toute l'Europe, combinée à notre marque forte, est le fondement de notre succès. Si vous partagez la passion pour la caution et les produits financiers, nous vous encourageons à postuler pour ce poste. Dans le cadre d'une équipe mondiale offrant des solutions sur mesure sur une large gamme de produits de garantie, vous aurez l'occasion de rejoindre une équipe très motivée qui partage la même passion pour cette entreprise.
À propos de toi
Vous vous développez dans un environnement international axé sur l'équipe et aimez combiner la pensée analytique et l'engagement des clients. Vous êtes un communicateur proactif qui renforce la confiance avec les clients et les partenaires commerciaux naturellement, et vous apportez un état d'esprit axé sur les solutions à chaque défi. Vous êtes à l'aise de travailler de façon indépendante et collaborative, et vous êtes impatient de contribuer à la croissance continue d'une entreprise de caution leader sur le marché.
Nous cherchons des candidats qui répondent à ces exigences :

• Au moins 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle pertinente, de préférence au sein d'une banque, d'un assureur de caution ou d'un établissement financier exposé aux produits de crédit et de garantie

• Une bonne compréhension des risques de crédit et des marchés financiers, en particulier en ce qui concerne le financement de la dette, les instruments du marché des capitaux et les structures de garanties

• Compétences analytiques et décisionnelles éprouvées, avec la capacité d'évaluer les risques complexes liés au crédit et aux transactions et de traduire les résultats en recommandations claires et structurées

• Communication confidentielle et aptitudes interpersonnelles, avec une expérience démontrée en contact avec les clients, les courtiers et les intervenants internes au niveau professionnel

• La maîtrise de l'anglais (écrite et verbale) est essentielle; les compétences linguistiques européennes supplémentaires constituent un avantage important.

Ce sont des avantages supplémentaires à avoir:

• Expérience de travail avec des sociétés multinationales ou dans un contexte transfrontalier de caution/crédit européen

• Connaissance des procédures légales de diligence raisonnable liées aux opérations de caution ou de garantie

• L'esprit d'entreprise en mettant fortement l'accent sur l'identification et la création de nouvelles possibilités d'affaires

• Expérience de l'utilisation des données et des outils de veille du marché pour suivre la performance du portefeuille et les tendances du marché

• Diplôme universitaire ou diplôme équivalent en finance, économie, droit ou discipline connexe #LI-Hybrid

Notre entreprise a un modèle de travail hybride où l'on s'attend à ce que vous soyez au bureau au moins trois jours par semaine.
Pour Londres, l'échelle annuelle des salaires de base pour ce poste se situe entre 63 000 GBP et 95 000 GBP (pour un rôle à temps plein). Le salaire spécifique offert tient compte:

• les exigences, la portée, la complexité et les responsabilités du rôle,

• le profil propre du candidat, y compris l'éducation/qualifications, l'expertise, la spécialisation, les compétences et l'expérience.

En plus de votre salaire de base, Swiss Re offre une composante de rémunération variable axée sur la performance, conçue pour reconnaître vos réalisations. De plus, vous bénéficierez d'une variété d'avantages globaux et spécifiques à l'emplacement. L'éligibilité peut varier en fonction des conditions des politiques Swiss Re et de votre contrat de travail.
À propos de Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
Suisse Re est l'un des principaux fournisseurs mondiaux de réassurance, d'assurance et d'autres formes de transfert de risque fondé sur l'assurance. Nous anticipons et gérons les risques, des catastrophes naturelles et du changement climatique à la cybercriminalité.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions est la branche assurance commerciale du Groupe Swiss Re. Nous offrons des solutions d'assurance innovantes aux grandes et moyennes multinationales de nos 50 sites dans le monde. Nous aidons les clients à atténuer leur exposition aux risques, tandis que notre service de réclamation leader de l'industrie leur procure une plus grande tranquillité d'esprit.

Notre succès dépend de notre capacité à bâtir une culture inclusive favorisant de nouvelles perspectives et une pensée novatrice. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions embrasse un lieu de travail où chacun a les mêmes chances de prospérer et de se développer professionnellement, quel que soit son âge, son sexe, sa race, son appartenance ethnique, son identité et/ou son expression, son orientation sexuelle, ses aptitudes physiques ou mentales, ses compétences, sa pensée ou d'autres caractéristiques. Dans notre environnement inclusif et flexible, tout le monde peut apporter son authentique soi au travail et sa passion pour la durabilité.

Si vous êtes un professionnel expérimenté qui revient au marché du travail après une interruption de carrière, nous vous encourageons à postuler à des postes ouverts qui correspondent à vos compétences et à votre expérience.
Nous pouvons utiliser des outils alimentés par l'IA pour appuyer l'examen et l'évaluation des demandes pour ce poste. Ces outils fournissent des renseignements supplémentaires à nos équipes de recrutement, mais toutes les décisions d'embauche sont soigneusement examinées et prises par les gens. Pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous utilisons l'IA dans le recrutement et comment nous traitons vos données personnelles, veuillez consulter notre Déclaration de confidentialité des données avant de postuler.

jobs.description:
About Role:
 This position is part of the Global Technical Accounting & Services organization, which has overall responsibility for the activities of Technical Accounting functions worldwide, including the Business Solution Centers. This position will report to the Manager Operations Southeast Asia & India.
 This team is expected to regularly meet the KPI, Quality targets pertaining to Technical Accounting Team & perform extensive data validations/analysis based on Reinsurance Contract wording for the respective Clients. One of the key activities is to ensure that payments received from clients (for example premiums) and payments made to clients (for example claims) reconcile against those payments expected. The client management expectation of this role would require you to correspond with internal and external stakeholders/clients to resolve issues related to Data quality aspect. Improvising while working within a set framework of policies and processes is key to the role.
 Principal Responsibilities towards:
 Operations:

• Consistently deliver on operational commitments.

• Develop & create data analysis summaries that aid decision making within and outside the Technical Accounting boundaries & can be consumed by multiple cross functional teams.

• Monitor the financial number's accounted into Technical Accounting Swiss Re system on regular basis & identify adverse Premium/Claim trends from the Client data.

• Deliver on the TA mandate including KPI'S to effectively manage/accelerate Cash in the books while demonstrating Swiss Re Values.

• Premium and Claims validation to be performed on the Client Seriatim data, make sure client reported data is complying with Contract wordings/agreement.

• Taking initiative at functional level to enhance the technical/Process knowledge of people across Technical Accounting team & act as Subject Matter Expert.
 People:

• Collaborate with team members and take ownership for team activities in specific markets

• Deliver results in consultation and as part of multiple-matrixed teams besides directly assigned work

• Build a network with both cross-functional and cross-geographical Swiss Re teams to discuss & Implement best Business Practices.
 Stakeholders (Cross Functional Team Coordination):

• Build and manage strong relationships with stakeholders and contribute to strengthening client relationship.

• Managing efficient and effective relevant business processes, portfolios in coordination with stakeholders.
 About the Team

This position is part of the Global Technical Accounting & Services organization for Life & Health Business, which has overall responsibility for Technical Accounting functions worldwide, including Business Solution Centers. The team ensures that payments received from clients (premiums) and payments made to clients (claims) reconcile against expected amounts. Working within established frameworks while finding innovative solutions is key to the team's success. The role reports to the Manager Operations Southeast Asia & India.
 About you:

• Graduate/Postgraduate in Commerce, Accounting, Insurance or equivalent field.

• 7+ years of work experience in the banking /insurance or any other financial services industry.

• Strong written & verbal communication skills.

• Strong Client management skills.

• Good Data analytical skills. Expertise in SAS & Python will be an added advantage.

• Sound Insurance Product Knowledge & understanding of Insurance/Reinsurance End to End Value Chain.
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 14,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Questa posizione fa parte dell'organizzazione Global Technical Accounting & Services, che ha la responsabilità generale per le attività delle funzioni di contabilità tecnica in tutto il mondo, tra cui i Business Solution Centers. Stakeholders (Cross Functional Team Coordination):

• Costruire e gestire relazioni forti con gli stakeholder e contribuire a rafforzare il rapporto con i clienti.

Informazioni sulla squadra

Questa posizione fa parte dell'organizzazione Global Technical Accounting & Services per Life & Health Business, che ha la responsabilità generale per le funzioni di contabilità tecnica in tutto il mondo, tra cui Business Solution Centers. Lavorare all'interno di strutture consolidate mentre trovare soluzioni innovative è fondamentale per il successo del team. Il ruolo riporta al Manager Operations Southeast Asia & India.
Su di te:

• Laureato in Commercio, Contabilità, Assicurazione o campo equivalente.

• 7+ anni di esperienza lavorativa nel settore bancario/assicurazione o di qualsiasi altro settore dei servizi finanziari.

• Forte capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale.

• Forte capacità di gestione dei clienti.

• Buone competenze analitiche dei dati. La competenza in SAS & Python sarà un vantaggio aggiuntivo.

• Conoscenza e comprensione del prodotto Assicurazione/Riassicurazione Fine alla catena del valore finale.
Informazioni su Swiss Re
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione, lavorando per rendere il mondo più resiliente. Aspettiamo e gestiamo una vasta gamma di rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine. Copriamo sia Proprietà & Casuale e Vita & Salute. Combinando l'esperienza con il pensiero creativo e l'esperienza all'avanguardia, creiamo nuove opportunità e soluzioni per i nostri clienti. Questo è possibile grazie alla collaborazione di oltre 14.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Abbracciamo un posto di lavoro dove ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il proprio sé autentico a lavorare e la loro passione per la sostenibilità.

Se sei un professionista esperto che torna alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.
Possiamo utilizzare strumenti basati su AI per supportare la revisione e la valutazione delle applicazioni per questa posizione. This team is expected to regularly meet the KPI, Quality targets pertaining to Technical Accounting Team & perform extensive data validations/analysis based on Reinsurance Contract wording for the respective Clients. One of the key activities is to ensure that payments received from clients (for example premiums) and payments made to clients (for example claims) reconcile against those payments expected. The client management expectation of this role would require you to correspond with internal and external stakeholders/clients to resolve issues related to Data quality aspect. Improvising while working within a set framework of policies and processes is key to the role.
Principal Responsibilities towards:
Operations:

• Consistently deliver on operational commitments.

• Develop & create data analysis summaries that aid decision making within and outside the Technical Accounting boundaries & can be consumed by multiple cross functional teams.

• Monitor the financial number's accounted into Technical Accounting Swiss Re system on regular basis & identify adverse Premium/Claim trends from the Client data.

• Deliver on the TA mandate including KPI'S to effectively manage/accelerate Cash in the books while demonstrating Swiss Re Values.

• Premium and Claims validation to be performed on the Client Seriatim data, make sure client reported data is complying with Contract wordings/agreement.

• Taking initiative at functional level to enhance the technical/Process knowledge of people across Technical Accounting team & act as Subject Matter Expert.
People:

• Collaborate with team members and take ownership for team activities in specific markets

• Deliver results in consultation and as part of multiple-matrixed teams besides directly assigned work

• Build a network with both cross-functional and cross-geographical Swiss Re teams to discuss & Implement best Business Practices.
Stakeholders (Cross Functional Team Coordination):

• Build and manage strong relationships with stakeholders and contribute to strengthening client relationship.

• Managing efficient and effective relevant business processes, portfolios in coordination with stakeholders.
About the Team

This position is part of the Global Technical Accounting & Services organization for Life & Health Business, which has overall responsibility for Technical Accounting functions worldwide, including Business Solution Centers. The team ensures that payments received from clients (premiums) and payments made to clients (claims) reconcile against expected amounts. Working within established frameworks while finding innovative solutions is key to the team's success. The role reports to the Manager Operations Southeast Asia & India.
About you:

• Graduate/Postgraduate in Commerce, Accounting, Insurance or equivalent field.

• 7+ years of work experience in the banking /insurance or any other financial services industry.

• Strong written & verbal communication skills.

• Strong Client management skills.

• Good Data analytical skills. Expertise in SAS & Python will be an added advantage.

• Sound Insurance Product Knowledge & understanding of Insurance/Reinsurance End to End Value Chain.
About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 14,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. À propos du rôle :
Ce poste fait partie de l'organisation Global Technical Accounting & Services, qui assume la responsabilité globale des activités des fonctions de comptabilité technique dans le monde entier, y compris les Business Solution Centers. L'une des principales activités consiste à faire en sorte que les paiements reçus des clients (par exemple les primes) et les paiements effectués aux clients (par exemple les demandes de remboursement) se rapprochent des paiements prévus. L'attente de la direction client de ce rôle vous obligerait à correspondre avec les intervenants/clients internes et externes pour résoudre les problèmes liés à la qualité des données. Opérations :

• Élaborer et créer des résumés d'analyse des données qui facilitent la prise de décisions à l'intérieur et à l'extérieur des limites de la comptabilité technique et qui peuvent être consommés par de multiples équipes interfonctionnelles.

• Surveillez régulièrement les chiffres financiers comptabilisés dans le système Technical Accounting Swiss Re et identifiez les tendances défavorables de Premium/Claim à partir des données du Client.

• Exécuter le mandat de TA, y compris KPI'S, pour gérer et accélérer efficacement la trésorerie dans les livres tout en démontrant Swiss Re Values.

• Prendre des initiatives au niveau fonctionnel pour améliorer les connaissances techniques/processus des personnes dans l'équipe de comptabilité technique et agir en tant qu'expert en matière.

• Fournir des résultats en consultation et dans le cadre d'équipes à matrices multiples en plus des tâches directement assignées

• Construisez un réseau avec des équipes de Swiss Re cross-fonctionnels et cross-géographiques pour discuter et mettre en œuvre les meilleures pratiques commerciales.
Partenaires (coordination des équipes fonctionnelles) :

• Établir et gérer des relations solides avec les intervenants et contribuer au renforcement des relations avec la clientèle.

• Gérer les processus opérationnels pertinents, efficaces et efficients, en coordination avec les parties prenantes.

• Fortes compétences en communication écrite et verbale.

• Fortes compétences en gestion des clients.

• Bonnes compétences en analyse des données. L'expertise en SAS & Python sera un avantage supplémentaire.

• Saine connaissance des produits d'assurance et compréhension de l'assurance et de la réassurance.

Suisse Re est l'un des principaux fournisseurs de réassurance, d'assurance et d'autres formes de transfert de risque fondé sur l'assurance, travaillant à rendre le monde plus résilient. jobs.description:
About our team

We are a diverse and dynamic team of experienced and motivated individuals who are passionate about solving complex problems through simple, intuitive designs.

Our Design Team is organized around products – and you will be too. Instead of time-boxed projects, we are responsible for the experience design of a landscape of products at various stages of their lifecycle.

Our product portfolio consists of more than 150 web and mobile applications supporting reinsurance business functions such as Sales, Underwriting, and Claims Management.

Our guiding principles are collaboration, pragmatism, and agility. We strive to create experiences that are intuitive, scalable, and impactful, helping our users work more effectively while supporting Swiss Re's mission to address some of the world's most urgent challenges, including climate change and closing the protection gap.

We are looking for a UX/UI Designer with a proven track record of designing high-quality digital experiences. Given the complexity of our industry, we value creative problem solvers who enjoy tackling sophisticated business, asking questions, addressing technical, and analytical challenges and translating them into meaningful user experiences.

About the role

As a UX/UI Designer, you will help shape intuitive, scalable, and impactful digital experiences across a portfolio of products. You will work closely with Product Owners, Business Experts, Engineers, and fellow Designers to understand user needs, define solutions, and deliver experiences that balance user value, business objectives, and technical feasibility.

You will be expected to contribute both as a hands-on designer and as a strategic partner, helping teams make informed decisions about product direction, experience quality, and long-term usability.

Key Responsibilities

• Drive the end-to-end design process from discovery through delivery for one or more digital products

• Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Business Experts, Engineers, and other Designers to create solutions that are desirable, feasible, and viable

• Conduct and apply user research, usability testing, journey mapping, and other user-centred design practices to inform product decisions

• Create wireframes, user flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs using Figma and our design system

• Apply established UX patterns, interaction design principles, and accessibility standards to create intuitive and consistent user experiences

• Contribute to product strategy by identifying user needs, opportunities, and experience improvements across the broader product ecosystem

• Bring a systems-thinking and service-design perspective to understand end-to-end workflows and identify opportunities beyond individual screens or features

• Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure design quality and successful implementation

• Use data, analytics, and user feedback to continuously evaluate and improve product experiences

• Contribute to the evolution, governance, and documentation of design systems, UX patterns, accessibility standards, reusable design assets, and design guidance that enable consistency and scalability across products and teams

• Explore and apply emerging technologies, including AI-assisted design and development workflows, where they create meaningful value for users and teams

• Help shape experiences that incorporate intelligent systems, ensuring they remain understandable, trustworthy, and human-centred

About you

• 3+ years of experience in UX/UI, Product Design, Interaction Design, or a related field (experience in complex B2B environments is a plus)

• Strong proficiency in Figma and modern design workflows

• Demonstrated ability to apply UX patterns, interaction design principles, information architecture, and visual design best practices

• Experience working with design systems and component-based design approaches; contributing to a design system is a plus

• Familiarity with accessibility standards and inclusive design principles (WCAG knowledge is a plus)

• Comfortable applying user-centred design methods, including research, usability testing, journey mapping, and iterative design

• Excellent communication, collaboration, facilitation, and storytelling skills

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and clearly document design decisions, patterns, standards, and processes for diverse audiences

• Systems thinker who can balance detailed design execution with broader product, service, and business goals

• Curious about emerging technologies, particularly AI and automation, and eager to explore how they can enhance both design practice and user experiences

• Comfortable navigating ambiguity, learning continuously, and helping teams move from complexity to clarity

Nice to Have

• Experience contributing to or maintaining design systems, accessibility standards, UX pattern libraries, or other shared design resources

• Experience working in agile product teams

• Experience designing complex enterprise or data-rich applications

• Familiarity with analytics tools and data-informed design practices

For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between EUR 2,100 and EUR 3,400 per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:​

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role, ​

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.​
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.​
 Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.

Informazioni sulla nostra squadra

Siamo un team diversificato e dinamico di individui esperti e motivati che sono appassionati di risolvere problemi complessi attraverso disegni semplici e intuitivi.

Il nostro team di progettazione è organizzato intorno ai prodotti – e sarete anche voi. Invece di progetti in time-box, siamo responsabili della progettazione esperienza di un paesaggio di prodotti in varie fasi del loro ciclo di vita.

Il nostro portafoglio di prodotti è costituito da oltre 150 applicazioni web e mobile che supportano le funzioni aziendali di riassicurazione come Sales, Underwriting e Gestione dei reclami.

I nostri principi guida sono collaborazione, pragmatismo e agilità. Ci sforziamo di creare esperienze intuitive, scalabili e d'impatto, aiutando i nostri utenti a lavorare più efficacemente, supportando la missione di Swiss Re per affrontare alcune delle sfide più urgenti del mondo, tra cui il cambiamento climatico e la chiusura del gap di protezione.

Siamo alla ricerca di un UX/UI Designer con un comprovato track record di progettazione di esperienze digitali di alta qualità. Data la complessità del nostro settore, apprezziamo i risolutori di problemi creativi che amano affrontare il business sofisticato, fare domande, affrontare le sfide tecniche e analitiche e tradurli in esperienze utente significative.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Come UX/UI Designer, contribuirai a creare esperienze digitali intuitive, scalabili e di impatto su un portafoglio di prodotti. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con i proprietari di prodotti, gli esperti aziendali, gli ingegneri e altri progettisti per comprendere le esigenze degli utenti, definire soluzioni e fornire esperienze che bilanciano il valore dell'utente, gli obiettivi aziendali e la fattibilità tecnica.

Si prevede di contribuire sia come progettista pratico che come partner strategico, aiutando i team a prendere decisioni informate sulla direzione del prodotto, la qualità dell'esperienza e l'usabilità a lungo termine.

Principali responsabilità

• Guidare il processo di progettazione end-to-end dalla scoperta attraverso la consegna per uno o più prodotti digitali

• Collaborare a stretto contatto con i proprietari di prodotti, gli esperti aziendali, gli ingegneri e altri progettisti per creare soluzioni che siano desiderabili, fattibili e realizzabili

• Condurre e applicare la ricerca degli utenti, test di usabilità, mappatura del viaggio e altre pratiche di progettazione centrate sull'utente per informare le decisioni dei prodotti

• Creare wireframe, flussi utente, prototipi e disegni ad alta fedeltà utilizzando Figma e il nostro sistema di progettazione

• Applicare modelli UX consolidati, principi di progettazione di interazione e standard di accessibilità per creare esperienze utente intuitive e coerenti

• Contribuisci alla strategia del prodotto identificando le esigenze degli utenti, le opportunità e i miglioramenti dell'esperienza nell'ecosistema dei prodotti più ampio

• Portare una prospettiva di progettazione di sistemi e di service-design per comprendere i flussi di lavoro end-to-end e identificare le opportunità oltre singoli schermi o funzionalità

• Collabora con i team di ingegneria per garantire la qualità del design e l'implementazione di successo

• Utilizzare dati, analisi e feedback degli utenti per valutare e migliorare continuamente le esperienze dei prodotti

• Contribuisci all'evoluzione, alla governance e alla documentazione dei sistemi di progettazione, ai modelli UX, agli standard di accessibilità, alle risorse di progettazione riutilizzabili e alle linee guida di progettazione che consentono coerenza e scalabilità tra prodotti e team

• Esplora e applica tecnologie emergenti, tra cui flussi di lavoro di progettazione e sviluppo assistiti da AI, dove creano un valore significativo per utenti e team

• Aiuta a modellare esperienze che incorporano sistemi intelligenti, assicurando che rimangano comprensibili, affidabili e centrati sull'uomo

Su di te

• 3+ anni di esperienza in UX/UI, Product Design, Interaction Design, o un campo correlato (l'esperienza in ambienti B2B complessi è un plus)

• Forte competenza in Figma e flussi di lavoro di design moderni

• Capacità dimostrata di applicare modelli UX, principi di progettazione di interazione, architettura delle informazioni e pratiche di progettazione visiva

• Esperienza di lavoro con sistemi di progettazione e approcci di progettazione basati su componenti; contribuire a un sistema di progettazione è un plus

• Familiarità con gli standard di accessibilità e principi di progettazione inclusi (la conoscenza WCAG è un plus)

• Confortevole applicazione metodi di progettazione centrati sull'utente, tra cui ricerca, test di usabilità, mappatura del viaggio e progettazione iterativa

• Ottima capacità di comunicazione, collaborazione, facilitazione e narrazione

• Forte capacità organizzativa con la capacità di gestire più priorità e documentare chiaramente decisioni di progettazione, modelli, standard e processi per il pubblico diverso

• Pensatore di sistemi in grado di bilanciare l'esecuzione di progettazione dettagliata con prodotti più ampi, servizi e obiettivi aziendali

• Curioso circa le tecnologie emergenti, in particolare l'AI e l'automazione, e desideroso di esplorare come possono migliorare sia la pratica del design che le esperienze degli utenti

• Confortevole navigazione ambiguità, apprendimento continuo, e aiutare i team a passare dalla complessità alla chiarezza

Bello da avere

• Esperienza contribuendo o mantenendo sistemi di progettazione, standard di accessibilità, librerie di modelli UX, o altre risorse di progettazione condivise

• Esperienza di lavoro in team di prodotti agili

• Esperienza nella progettazione di complesse applicazioni aziendali o ricche di dati

• Familiarità con strumenti di analisi e pratiche di progettazione informatizzate

Per la Slovacchia la fascia salariale di base per questa posizione è compresa tra 2.100 e 3.400 EUR al mese (per un ruolo a tempo pieno). Lo stipendio specifico offerto considera:

• i requisiti, la portata, la complessità e le responsabilità del ruolo,

• il proprio profilo del richiedente, tra cui istruzione/qualifica, competenza, specializzazione, competenze ed esperienza.

About our team

We are a diverse and dynamic team of experienced and motivated individuals who are passionate about solving complex problems through simple, intuitive designs.

Our Design Team is organized around products – and you will be too. Instead of time-boxed projects, we are responsible for the experience design of a landscape of products at various stages of their lifecycle.

Our product portfolio consists of more than 150 web and mobile applications supporting reinsurance business functions such as Sales, Underwriting, and Claims Management.

Our guiding principles are collaboration, pragmatism, and agility. We strive to create experiences that are intuitive, scalable, and impactful, helping our users work more effectively while supporting Swiss Re's mission to address some of the world's most urgent challenges, including climate change and closing the protection gap.

We are looking for a UX/UI Designer with a proven track record of designing high-quality digital experiences. Given the complexity of our industry, we value creative problem solvers who enjoy tackling sophisticated business, asking questions, addressing technical, and analytical challenges and translating them into meaningful user experiences.

About the role

As a UX/UI Designer, you will help shape intuitive, scalable, and impactful digital experiences across a portfolio of products. You will work closely with Product Owners, Business Experts, Engineers, and fellow Designers to understand user needs, define solutions, and deliver experiences that balance user value, business objectives, and technical feasibility.

You will be expected to contribute both as a hands-on designer and as a strategic partner, helping teams make informed decisions about product direction, experience quality, and long-term usability.

Key Responsibilities

• Drive the end-to-end design process from discovery through delivery for one or more digital products

• Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Business Experts, Engineers, and other Designers to create solutions that are desirable, feasible, and viable

• Conduct and apply user research, usability testing, journey mapping, and other user-centred design practices to inform product decisions

• Create wireframes, user flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs using Figma and our design system

• Apply established UX patterns, interaction design principles, and accessibility standards to create intuitive and consistent user experiences

• Contribute to product strategy by identifying user needs, opportunities, and experience improvements across the broader product ecosystem

• Bring a systems-thinking and service-design perspective to understand end-to-end workflows and identify opportunities beyond individual screens or features

• Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure design quality and successful implementation

• Use data, analytics, and user feedback to continuously evaluate and improve product experiences

• Contribute to the evolution, governance, and documentation of design systems, UX patterns, accessibility standards, reusable design assets, and design guidance that enable consistency and scalability across products and teams

• Explore and apply emerging technologies, including AI-assisted design and development workflows, where they create meaningful value for users and teams

• Help shape experiences that incorporate intelligent systems, ensuring they remain understandable, trustworthy, and human-centred

About you

• 3+ years of experience in UX/UI, Product Design, Interaction Design, or a related field (experience in complex B2B environments is a plus)

• Strong proficiency in Figma and modern design workflows

• Demonstrated ability to apply UX patterns, interaction design principles, information architecture, and visual design best practices

• Experience working with design systems and component-based design approaches; contributing to a design system is a plus

• Familiarity with accessibility standards and inclusive design principles (WCAG knowledge is a plus)

• Comfortable applying user-centred design methods, including research, usability testing, journey mapping, and iterative design

• Excellent communication, collaboration, facilitation, and storytelling skills

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and clearly document design decisions, patterns, standards, and processes for diverse audiences

• Systems thinker who can balance detailed design execution with broader product, service, and business goals

• Curious about emerging technologies, particularly AI and automation, and eager to explore how they can enhance both design practice and user experiences

• Comfortable navigating ambiguity, learning continuously, and helping teams move from complexity to clarity

Nice to Have

• Experience contributing to or maintaining design systems, accessibility standards, UX pattern libraries, or other shared design resources

• Experience working in agile product teams

• Experience designing complex enterprise or data-rich applications

• Familiarity with analytics tools and data-informed design practices

For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between EUR 2,100 and EUR 3,400 per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:​

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role, ​

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.​
In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.​
Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.
#LI-Hybrid

About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.
