jobs.title: Senior Structurer, Property & Casualty
jobs.description:
Locations:
Schaumburg, IL, US |
Armonk, NY, US

We are looking for a Senior Structurer, who leads a Deal Team for Transactions, to be an integral member of the cross-functional team that facilitates the execution of Property & Casualty (P&C) structured reinsurance solutions (PCSS). Our Structurers actively contribute to the identification and origination of P&C transaction opportunities in the Americas!
 About the Role
 In collaboration with Client Markets and the wider team, we show the value of P&C structured solutions to our clients, through compelling analytics and presentation materials. We work to ensure that best practice underwriting and actuarial resources are utilized and compliance with regulatory, accounting, tax and legal requirements (mitigate reputational risk) are met.
 Key Responsibilities include:

• Meet regularly with clients and brokers to understand client challenges. Collaborate to design strategic and appropriate solutions tailored to meet client needs.

• Develop strong professional relationships with key external and internal clients.

• Represent PCSS as an innovator and structural thought leader internally and externally.

• Manage transaction process and ensure an inclusive deal team approach with underwriters, actuarial, legal, accounting, finance and risk professionals within Swiss Re.

• Develop and promote innovation.

• Leverage Underwriting experts for local market and custom practices while promoting best practice and address governance matters. Drive efficiency using an inclusive approach with cross-functional teams.
 Leadership :

• Prioritize (triage) market opportunities and realize synergies among PCSS and other units of Swiss Re.

• Assist with internal initiatives to advance the transactions topic with key internal stakeholders and across the broader organization.
 About the Team
 We are a highly experienced, diverse, and energetic team of structurers. At PCSS, we understand that we have a unique place within Swiss Re that adds significant value through the origination, structuring and deal team leadership of our largest and most sophisticated programs. We have high visibility in the organization and many opportunities to influence our Senior Leaders to support needle moving transactions.
 Our hunger, drive, persistence, and collaboration set us apart from our competition. We are technical. We are pragmatic. We are problem solvers. We are courageous. We have fun. The successful candidate will possess all of these traits and will enjoy being part of a selfless team who works together and supports one another without hesitation!
 About You
 The successful candidate possesses a high level of integrity, transparency and analytical capabilities along with excellent communication, negotiation and facilitation skills. In addition, they will have strong networking and influencing skills and experience in organizing and motivating cross-functional teams.
 Additional requirements include :

• College degree required.

• Minimum 3 years' experience in the financial/insurance industry.

• Actuarial or corporate finance qualifications a plus.

• Reinsurance experience either in Underwriting, Risk Management or Marketing; ideally complemented by practical experience in executing tailored P&C reinsurance transactions.

• Thorough understanding of reinsurance products, markets and risk, and actuarial principles.

• Strong financial acumen with capital management / solvency proficiency.

• Client-oriented and desire to be integral to the success of our clients.

• Adapts to new circumstances with ease and speed.

• Passionate about Reinsurance, and to outperform.

• Possesses a passion for the business and commitment to solving problems
 Travel required 25%. This position is not eligible for full-time telework or visa sponsorship.
 The estimated base salary range for this position in Schaumburg is $136,000 to $204,000 and in Armonk is $144,000 to $216,000. The specific salary offered for this or any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short-and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

Swiss Re is an equal opportunity employer. It is our practice to recruit, hire and promote without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, pregnancy, sexual orientations, marital status, military status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Decisions on employment are solely based on an individual's qualifications for the position being filled.

During the recruitment process, reasonable accommodations for disabilities are available upon request. If contacted for an interview, please inform the Recruiter/HR Professional of the accommodation needed.

We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Siamo alla ricerca di un Senior Structurer, che guida un Deal Team for Transactions, per essere parte integrante del team interfunzionale che facilita l'esecuzione delle soluzioni di riassicurazione strutturate di Property & Casualty (P&C). I nostri Strutturatori contribuiscono attivamente all'identificazione e all'origine delle opportunità di transazione P&C nelle Americhe!
Informazioni sul ruolo
In collaborazione con Client Markets e il team più ampio, mostriamo il valore delle soluzioni strutturate P&C ai nostri clienti, attraverso l'analitica e i materiali di presentazione. Lavoriamo per garantire che le migliori pratiche sottoscrittura e le risorse attuariali sono utilizzati e il rispetto dei requisiti normativi, contabili, fiscali e legali (rischio di reputazione) sono soddisfatti.
Le responsabilità chiave includono:

• Incontra regolarmente con clienti e broker per comprendere le sfide dei clienti. Collaborate per progettare soluzioni strategiche e appropriate su misura per soddisfare le esigenze del cliente.

• Sviluppare forti relazioni professionali con i clienti esterni e interni chiave.

• Rappresentare PCSS come innovatore e leader di pensiero strutturale internamente ed esternamente.

• Gestire il processo di transazione e garantire un approccio del team di affari inclusi con i sottoscrittori, attuariali, legali, contabili, finanziari e professionisti del rischio all'interno di Swiss Re.

• Sviluppare e promuovere l'innovazione.

• Esperti di scrittura di Leverage per il mercato locale e pratiche personalizzate, promuovendo le migliori pratiche e questioni di governance degli indirizzi. Efficienza di guida utilizzando un approccio inclusivo con team interfunzionali.
Leadership:

• Priorizzare (triage) opportunità di mercato e realizzare sinergie tra PCSS e altre unità di Swiss Re.

• Assistere con iniziative interne per promuovere il tema delle transazioni con i principali stakeholder interni e attraverso l'organizzazione più ampia.
Informazioni sulla squadra
Siamo un team di strutturatori altamente esperto, vario ed energico. A PCSS, comprendiamo che abbiamo un posto unico all'interno di Swiss Re che aggiunge un valore significativo attraverso l'origine, la strutturazione e l'affidamento della leadership del team dei nostri programmi più grandi e più sofisticati. Abbiamo alta visibilità nell'organizzazione e molte opportunità per influenzare i nostri leader senior per sostenere le transazioni in movimento degli aghi.
La nostra fame, la nostra spinta, la nostra persistenza e la nostra collaborazione ci hanno separati dalla nostra concorrenza. Siamo tecnici. Siamo pragmatici. Siamo risolutori di problemi. Siamo coraggiosi. Ci divertiamo. Il candidato di successo possederà tutti questi tratti e godrà di essere parte di una squadra altruista che lavora insieme e si sostiene l'un l'altro senza esitazione!
A proposito di te
Il candidato di successo possiede un alto livello di integrità, trasparenza e capacità analitiche insieme ad eccellenti capacità di comunicazione, negoziazione e facilitazione. Inoltre, avranno una forte rete e influenzeranno le competenze e l'esperienza nell'organizzazione e nella motivazione delle squadre interfunzionali.
I requisiti supplementari comprendono:

• Grado universitario richiesto.

• Esperienza minima di 3 anni nel settore finanziario/assicurazione.

• Qualifiche attuariali o corporate finance a plus.

• Esperienza di riassicurazione sia in Underwriting, Risk Management o Marketing; idealmente completato da esperienza pratica nell'esecuzione di transazioni di riassicurazione P&C su misura.

• Una comprensione approfondita dei prodotti di riassicurazione, dei mercati e dei rischi e dei principi attuariali.

• Forte acume finanziario con la gestione del capitale / competenza di solvibilità.

• Il cliente orientato e il desiderio di essere parte integrante del successo dei nostri clienti.

• Adatta a nuove circostanze con facilità e velocità.

• Appassionato di Reinsurance, e di esperformarsi.

• Possede una passione per il business e l'impegno a risolvere i problemi
Viaggi richiesto 25%. Questa posizione non è ammissibile per il telelavoro a tempo pieno o la sponsorizzazione del visto.
L'intervallo di stipendio base stimato per questa posizione a Schaumburg è di $ 136,000 a $ 204,000 e ad Armonk è di $ 1444,000 a $216,000. Lo stipendio specifico offerto per questo o qualsiasi dato ruolo terrà conto di un certo numero di fattori, tra cui, ma non solo, la posizione del lavoro, la portata del ruolo, le qualifiche, la complessità/specializzazione/scarsità del talento, l'esperienza, l'istruzione e il bilancio del datore di lavoro. A Swiss Re, prendiamo un "approccio di compensazione totale" quando prendiamo decisioni di risarcimento. Ciò significa che consideriamo tutti i componenti di compensazione nella loro totalità (come la retribuzione base, gli incentivi a breve e a lungo termine e i benefici offerti), nella definizione di una compensazione individuale.
Informazioni su Swiss Re
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione, lavorando per rendere il mondo più resiliente. Aspettiamo e gestiamo una vasta gamma di rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine. Combinando l'esperienza con il pensiero creativo e l'esperienza all'avanguardia, creiamo nuove opportunità e soluzioni per i nostri clienti. Questo è possibile grazie alla collaborazione di oltre 15.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Abbracciamo un posto di lavoro dove ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il proprio sé autentico a lavorare e la loro passione per la sostenibilità.

Se sei un professionista esperto che torna alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.

Svizzera Re è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. È la nostra pratica di reclutare, assumere e promuovere senza riguardo a razza, religione, colore, origine nazionale, sesso, disabilità, età, gravidanza, orientamento sessuale, stato civile, stato militare, o qualsiasi altra caratteristica protetta dalla legge. We are looking for a Senior Structurer, who leads a Deal Team for Transactions, to be an integral member of the cross-functional team that facilitates the execution of Property & Casualty (P&C) structured reinsurance solutions (PCSS). Our Structurers actively contribute to the identification and origination of P&C transaction opportunities in the Americas!
About the Role
In collaboration with Client Markets and the wider team, we show the value of P&C structured solutions to our clients, through compelling analytics and presentation materials. We work to ensure that best practice underwriting and actuarial resources are utilized and compliance with regulatory, accounting, tax and legal requirements (mitigate reputational risk) are met.
Key Responsibilities include:

• Meet regularly with clients and brokers to understand client challenges. Collaborate to design strategic and appropriate solutions tailored to meet client needs.

• Develop strong professional relationships with key external and internal clients.

• Represent PCSS as an innovator and structural thought leader internally and externally.

• Manage transaction process and ensure an inclusive deal team approach with underwriters, actuarial, legal, accounting, finance and risk professionals within Swiss Re.

• Develop and promote innovation.

• Leverage Underwriting experts for local market and custom practices while promoting best practice and address governance matters. Drive efficiency using an inclusive approach with cross-functional teams.
Leadership :

• Prioritize (triage) market opportunities and realize synergies among PCSS and other units of Swiss Re.

• Assist with internal initiatives to advance the transactions topic with key internal stakeholders and across the broader organization.
About the Team
We are a highly experienced, diverse, and energetic team of structurers. At PCSS, we understand that we have a unique place within Swiss Re that adds significant value through the origination, structuring and deal team leadership of our largest and most sophisticated programs. We have high visibility in the organization and many opportunities to influence our Senior Leaders to support needle moving transactions.
Our hunger, drive, persistence, and collaboration set us apart from our competition. We are technical. We are pragmatic. We are problem solvers. We are courageous. We have fun. The successful candidate will possess all of these traits and will enjoy being part of a selfless team who works together and supports one another without hesitation!
About You
The successful candidate possesses a high level of integrity, transparency and analytical capabilities along with excellent communication, negotiation and facilitation skills. In addition, they will have strong networking and influencing skills and experience in organizing and motivating cross-functional teams.
Additional requirements include :

• College degree required.

• Minimum 3 years' experience in the financial/insurance industry.

• Actuarial or corporate finance qualifications a plus.

• Reinsurance experience either in Underwriting, Risk Management or Marketing; ideally complemented by practical experience in executing tailored P&C reinsurance transactions.

• Thorough understanding of reinsurance products, markets and risk, and actuarial principles.

• Strong financial acumen with capital management / solvency proficiency.

• Client-oriented and desire to be integral to the success of our clients.

• Adapts to new circumstances with ease and speed.

• Passionate about Reinsurance, and to outperform.

• Possesses a passion for the business and commitment to solving problems
Travel required 25%. This position is not eligible for full-time telework or visa sponsorship.
The estimated base salary range for this position in Schaumburg is $136,000 to $204,000 and in Armonk is $144,000 to $216,000. The specific salary offered for this or any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short-and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.
About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

Swiss Re is an equal opportunity employer. It is our practice to recruit, hire and promote without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, pregnancy, sexual orientations, marital status, military status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Decisions on employment are solely based on an individual's qualifications for the position being filled.

During the recruitment process, reasonable accommodations for disabilities are available upon request. If contacted for an interview, please inform the Recruiter/HR Professional of the accommodation needed.

We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Wir suchen einen Senior Structurer, der ein Deal Team für Transaktionen leitet, um ein integrales Mitglied des funktionsübergreifenden Teams zu sein, das die Ausführung von strukturierten Rückversicherungslösungen (PCSS) für Property & Casualty (P&C) erleichtert. Unsere Strukturierer tragen aktiv zur Identifizierung und Entstehung von P & C-Transaktionsmöglichkeiten in Amerika bei!
Über die Rolle
In Zusammenarbeit mit Client Markets und dem breiteren Team zeigen wir unseren Kunden den Wert strukturierter P&C-Lösungen durch überzeugende Analyse- und Präsentationsmaterialien. Wir arbeiten daran, sicherzustellen, dass Best Practice Underwriting und versicherungsmathematische Ressourcen genutzt werden und die Einhaltung der regulatorischen, buchhalterischen, steuerlichen und rechtlichen Anforderungen (Reputationsrisiko mindern) erfüllt wird.
Zu den wichtigsten Aufgaben gehören:

• Treffen Sie sich regelmäßig mit Kunden und Brokern, um die Herausforderungen der Kunden zu verstehen. Arbeiten Sie zusammen, um strategische und angemessene Lösungen zu entwickeln, die auf die Bedürfnisse der Kunden zugeschnitten sind.

• Aufbau starker professioneller Beziehungen zu wichtigen externen und internen Kunden.

• Repräsentieren Sie PCSS als Innovator und struktureller Vordenker intern und extern.

• Verwalten Sie den Transaktionsprozess und gewährleisten Sie einen inklusiven Deal-Teamansatz mit Underwritern, Versicherungsmathematikern, Rechtsexperten, Buchhaltungs-, Finanz- und Risikoexperten bei Swiss Re.

• Entwicklung und Förderung von Innovationen.

• Nutzen Sie Underwriting-Experten für lokale Markt- und kundenspezifische Praktiken, während Sie Best Practices fördern und Governance-Angelegenheiten ansprechen. Steigerung der Effizienz durch einen integrativen Ansatz mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams.
Führung :

• Priorisieren Sie (Triage-) Marktchancen und realisieren Sie Synergien zwischen PCSS und anderen Einheiten von Swiss Re.

• Unterstützung bei internen Initiativen, um das Transaktionsthema mit wichtigen internen Stakeholdern und der gesamten Organisation voranzutreiben.
Über das Team
Wir sind ein sehr erfahrenes, vielfältiges und energisches Team von Strukturierern. Bei PCSS verstehen wir, dass wir innerhalb von Swiss Re einen einzigartigen Platz haben, der durch die Entwicklung, Strukturierung und Deal-Teamführung unserer größten und anspruchsvollsten Programme einen erheblichen Mehrwert schafft. Wir haben eine hohe Sichtbarkeit in der Organisation und viele Möglichkeiten, unsere Senior Leaders zu beeinflussen, um Nadelbewegungstransaktionen zu unterstützen.
Unser Hunger, Antrieb, Beharrlichkeit und unsere Zusammenarbeit heben uns von unserer Konkurrenz ab. Wir sind technisch. Wir sind pragmatisch. Wir sind Problemlöser. Wir sind mutig. Wir haben Spaß. Der erfolgreiche Kandidat wird all diese Eigenschaften besitzen und wird es genießen, Teil eines selbstlosen Teams zu sein, das ohne Zögern zusammenarbeitet und sich gegenseitig unterstützt!
Über dich
Der erfolgreiche Kandidat verfügt über ein hohes Maß an Integrität, Transparenz und Analysefähigkeiten sowie über hervorragende Kommunikations-, Verhandlungs- und Erleichterungsfähigkeiten. Darüber hinaus verfügen sie über eine starke Vernetzung und beeinflussen Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung in der Organisation und Motivation von funktionsübergreifenden Teams.
Zusätzliche Anforderungen umfassen:

• College-Abschluss erforderlich.

• Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Finanz- / Versicherungsbranche.

• Versicherungsmathematische oder Corporate Finance Qualifikationen ein Plus.

• Rückversicherungserfahrung entweder im Underwriting, Risikomanagement oder Marketing; idealerweise ergänzt durch praktische Erfahrung bei der Durchführung maßgeschneiderter P&C-Rückversicherungstransaktionen.

• Ein gründliches Verständnis von Rückversicherungsprodukten, -märkten und -risiken sowie versicherungsmathematischen Grundsätzen.

• Starke finanzielle Scharfsinn mit Kapitalmanagement / Solvenz Kenntnisse.

• Kundenorientiert und der Wunsch, für den Erfolg unserer Kunden wesentlich zu sein.

• Passt sich mit Leichtigkeit und Geschwindigkeit an neue Umstände an.

• Leidenschaft für die Rückversicherung und übertreffen.

• Besitzt eine Leidenschaft für das Geschäft und Engagement für die Lösung von Problemen
Reisen erforderten 25%. Diese Position ist nicht für Vollzeit-Telearbeit oder Visa-Sponsoring berechtigt.
Die geschätzte Grundgehaltsspanne für diese Position in Schaumburg beträgt 136.000 bis 204.000 US-Dollar und in Armonk 144.000 bis 216.000 US-Dollar. Das spezifische Gehalt, das für diese oder eine bestimmte Rolle angeboten wird, berücksichtigt eine Reihe von Faktoren, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf den Arbeitsplatz, den Umfang der Rolle, die Qualifikationen, die Komplexität / Spezialisierung / Knappheit von Talenten, Erfahrung, Ausbildung und Arbeitgeberbudget. Bei Swiss Re verfolgen wir einen "Gesamtvergütungsansatz", wenn wir Entschädigungsentscheidungen treffen. Dies bedeutet, dass wir alle Komponenten der Entschädigung in ihrer Gesamtheit (wie Grundvergütung, kurz- und langfristige Anreize und angebotene Leistungen) bei der Festlegung der individuellen Entschädigung berücksichtigen.
Über Swiss Re
Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen des versicherungsbasierten Risikotransfers und arbeitet daran, die Welt widerstandsfähiger zu machen. Wir antizipieren und managen eine Vielzahl von Risiken, von Naturkatastrophen und Klimawandel bis hin zu Cyberkriminalität. Durch die Kombination von Erfahrung mit kreativem Denken und modernster Expertise schaffen wir neue Möglichkeiten und Lösungen für unsere Kunden. Dies ist dank der Zusammenarbeit von mehr als 15.000 Mitarbeitern auf der ganzen Welt möglich.

Unser Erfolg hängt von unserer Fähigkeit ab, eine integrative Kultur aufzubauen, die neue Perspektiven und innovatives Denken fördert. Wir nehmen einen Arbeitsplatz an, an dem jeder die gleichen Chancen hat, beruflich zu gedeihen und sich zu entwickeln, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Rasse, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Geschlechtsidentität und / oder Ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, körperlicher oder geistiger Fähigkeit, Fähigkeiten, Gedanken oder anderen Eigenschaften. In unserem integrativen und flexiblen Umfeld kann jeder sein authentisches Selbst und seine Leidenschaft für Nachhaltigkeit mitbringen.

Wenn Sie ein erfahrener Profi sind, der nach einer Berufspause in die Belegschaft zurückkehrt, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich für offene Stellen zu bewerben, die Ihren Fähigkeiten und Ihrer Erfahrung entsprechen.

Schweizer Re ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit. Es ist unsere Praxis, ohne Rücksicht auf Rasse, Religion, Hautfarbe, nationale Herkunft, Geschlecht, Behinderung, Alter, Schwangerschaft, sexuelle Orientierungen, Familienstand, Militärstatus oder andere gesetzlich geschützte Merkmale zu rekrutieren, einzustellen und zu fördern. Entscheidungen über die Beschäftigung basieren ausschließlich auf den Qualifikationen einer Person für die zu besetzende Stelle.

Während des Rekrutierungsprozesses sind angemessene Unterkünfte für Behinderungen auf Anfrage verfügbar. Wenn Sie für ein Interview kontaktiert werden, informieren Sie bitte den Recruiter / HR Professional über die erforderliche Unterkunft.

Wir können KI-basierte Tools verwenden, um die Überprüfung und Bewertung von Anwendungen für diese Position zu unterstützen. Diese Tools bieten unseren Rekrutierungsteams zusätzliche Einblicke, aber alle Einstellungsentscheidungen werden sorgfältig überprüft und von Menschen getroffen. Um mehr darüber zu erfahren, wie wir KI bei der Rekrutierung einsetzen und wie wir mit Ihren personenbezogenen Daten umgehen, lesen Sie bitte unsere Datenschutzerklärung, bevor Sie sich bewerben.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un Structureur senior, qui dirige une équipe de transactions, pour être membre à part entière de l'équipe interfonctionnelle qui facilite l'exécution des solutions de réassurance structurées (PCSS). Nos structurants contribuent activement à l'identification et à l'origine des occasions de transactions de P&C dans les Amériques!
À propos du rôle
En collaboration avec les Marchés Clients et l'équipe élargie, nous montrons la valeur des solutions structurées de P&C à nos clients, grâce à des matériaux d'analyse et de présentation convaincants. Nous veillons à ce que les meilleures pratiques de souscription et les ressources actuarielles soient utilisées et que les exigences réglementaires, comptables, fiscales et juridiques (risque de réputation) soient respectées.
Les principales responsabilités comprennent :

• Rencontrez régulièrement les clients et les courtiers pour comprendre les défis des clients. Collaborer à la conception de solutions stratégiques et appropriées adaptées aux besoins des clients.

• Établir des relations professionnelles solides avec les principaux clients externes et internes.

• Représenter le PCSS comme un chef de file innovateur et de pensée structurelle à l'interne et à l'externe.

• Gérer le processus de transaction et assurer une approche d'équipe inclusive avec les assureurs, les professionnels de l'actuaire, du droit, de la comptabilité, des finances et des risques au sein de Swiss Re.

• Développer et promouvoir l'innovation.

• Tirer parti des experts de la souscription pour les pratiques du marché local et les pratiques coutumières tout en promouvant les meilleures pratiques et en abordant les questions de gouvernance. Conduire l'efficacité en utilisant une approche inclusive avec des équipes interfonctionnelles.
Leadership :

• Prioriser (trier) les opportunités du marché et réaliser des synergies entre PCSS et d'autres unités de Swiss Re.

• Appuyer les initiatives internes visant à faire avancer le sujet des transactions avec les principaux intervenants internes et dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.
À propos de l'équipe
Nous sommes une équipe de structureurs hautement expérimentée, diversifiée et énergique. Chez PCSS, nous comprenons que nous avons une place unique au sein de Swiss Re qui ajoute une valeur significative grâce à l'origine, la structuration et le leadership d'équipe de nos programmes les plus importants et les plus sophistiqués. Nous avons une grande visibilité au sein de l'organisation et de nombreuses occasions d'influencer nos cadres supérieurs pour appuyer les transactions de déplacement d'aiguilles.
Notre faim, notre dynamisme, notre persévérance et notre collaboration nous ont séparés de notre concurrence. Nous sommes techniques. Nous sommes pragmatiques. Nous sommes des résolveurs de problèmes. Nous sommes courageux. Nous nous amusons. La candidate reçue possédera tous ces traits et appréciera de faire partie d'une équipe désintéressée qui travaille ensemble et se soutient mutuellement sans hésiter!
À propos de toi
Le candidat retenu possède un haut niveau d'intégrité, de transparence et de capacités analytiques, ainsi que d'excellentes compétences en communication, négociation et facilitation. De plus, ils auront de solides réseaux et auront une influence sur les compétences et l'expérience dans l'organisation et la motivation des équipes interfonctionnelles.
Les exigences supplémentaires comprennent :

• Diplôme requis.

• Au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans le secteur financier/assurance.

• Qualifications actuarielles ou financières des entreprises a plus.

• Expérience en réassurance en souscription, en gestion des risques ou en marketing; idéalement complétée par une expérience pratique dans l'exécution d'opérations de réassurance sur mesure.

• Compréhension approfondie des produits de réassurance, des marchés et des risques, et des principes actuariels.

• Forte maîtrise de la gestion financière et de la solvabilité.

• Orientation client et désir de faire partie intégrante du succès de nos clients.

• S'adapte aux nouvelles circonstances avec facilité et rapidité.

• Passionné de réassurance, et de surperformance.

• Possède une passion pour l'entreprise et l'engagement à résoudre les problèmes
Voyage requis 25 %. Ce poste n'est pas admissible au télétravail à temps plein ou au parrainage de visa.
L'échelle salariale de base estimative pour ce poste à Schaumburg est de 136 000 $ à 204 000 $ et à Armonk de 144 000 $ à 216 000 $. Le salaire spécifique offert pour ce rôle ou un tel rôle tiendra compte d'un certain nombre de facteurs, y compris, sans s'y limiter, le lieu de travail, l'étendue du rôle, les qualifications, la complexité, la spécialisation et la pénurie de talents, l'expérience, les études et le budget de l'employeur. Chez Swiss Re, nous adoptons une «approche de la rémunération totale» pour prendre des décisions en matière de rémunération. Cela signifie que nous considérons toutes les composantes de la rémunération dans leur ensemble (comme la rémunération de base, les incitatifs à court et à long terme et les avantages offerts) dans l'établissement de la rémunération individuelle.
À propos de Swiss Re
Suisse Re est l'un des principaux fournisseurs de réassurance, d'assurance et d'autres formes de transfert de risque fondé sur l'assurance, travaillant à rendre le monde plus résilient. Nous anticipons et gérons une grande variété de risques, des catastrophes naturelles et du changement climatique à la cybercriminalité. Combinant l'expérience avec la pensée créative et l'expertise de pointe, nous créons de nouvelles opportunités et solutions pour nos clients. Cela est possible grâce à la collaboration de plus de 15 000 employés à travers le monde.

Notre succès dépend de notre capacité à bâtir une culture inclusive favorisant de nouvelles perspectives et une pensée novatrice. Nous embrassons un lieu de travail où chacun a les mêmes chances de prospérer et de se développer professionnellement, quel que soit son âge, son sexe, sa race, son appartenance ethnique, son identité et/ou son expression, son orientation sexuelle, ses aptitudes physiques ou mentales, ses compétences, sa pensée ou d'autres caractéristiques. Dans notre environnement inclusif et flexible, tout le monde peut apporter son authentique soi au travail et sa passion pour la durabilité.

Si vous êtes un professionnel expérimenté qui revient au marché du travail après une interruption de carrière, nous vous encourageons à postuler à des postes ouverts qui correspondent à vos compétences et à votre expérience.

Suisse Re est un employeur à chances égales. Notre pratique consiste à recruter, embaucher et promouvoir sans égard à la race, à la religion, à la couleur, à l'origine nationale, au sexe, au handicap, à l'âge, à la grossesse, à l'orientation sexuelle, à l'état civil, à l'état militaire ou à toute autre caractéristique protégée par la loi. Les décisions relatives à l'emploi sont fondées uniquement sur les qualifications d'une personne pour le poste à pourvoir.

Pendant le processus de recrutement, des aménagements raisonnables sont disponibles sur demande. Si vous êtes contacté pour une entrevue, veuillez informer le recruteur/professionnel des RH de l'accommodement nécessaire.

Nous pouvons utiliser des outils alimentés par l'IA pour appuyer l'examen et l'évaluation des demandes pour ce poste. Ces outils fournissent des renseignements supplémentaires à nos équipes de recrutement, mais toutes les décisions d'embauche sont soigneusement examinées et prises par les gens. Pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous utilisons l'IA dans le recrutement et comment nous traitons vos données personnelles, veuillez consulter notre Déclaration de confidentialité des données avant de postuler.

A proposito del RUOLO
In qualità di Responsabile Operazioni e Consegna di terze parti, DORA, coordina l'esecuzione di TPM attraverso il ciclo di vita di terze parti e supporta i deliverable correlati a DORA, tra cui la convalida dei dati, il coordinamento delle entità legali, la disponibilità di report e le risposte alle richieste di revisione o di regolamentazione. Tradurrete i requisiti in azioni chiare, escalate i problemi presto e contribuire a mantenere i dati di alta qualità, controlli e prove.
Questo è un ruolo di copertura premaman a due anni. Le future opportunità all'interno di Swiss Re possono essere considerate, soggette a prestazioni individuali e esigenze aziendali. Incoraggiamo le applicazioni da professionisti motivati con esperienza rilevante nella gestione di terze parti, nella fornitura di normative, nel rischio operativo, nella conformità, negli appalti, nell'audit o nella fornitura di servizi. Il ruolo non è progettato come una posizione entry-level. Richiede proprietà, buon giudizio, fiducia degli stakeholder e la capacità di fornire risultati in un ambiente globale.
A proposito di te
Devono

• Almeno 5 anni di esperienza rilevante nella gestione di terze parti, rischio operativo, conformità, approvvigionamento, outsourcing, audit, cambiamento normativo o fornitura di servizi, idealmente all'interno di un ambiente regolamentato (assicurazione, riassicurazione o banca).

• Esperienza pratica con processi di ciclo di vita di terze parti (a bordo, due diligence, monitoraggio, monitoraggio dei problemi, reporting e offboarding).

• Forte comprensione dei requisiti di rischio, controlli, qualità dei dati e audit, compreso il mantenimento della documentazione chiara e delle prove.

• Capacità comprovata di gestire le parti interessate e coordinare i responsabili complessi in team globali, enti legali e funzioni di controllo.

• Forte capacità analitiche e di problem solving, con un approccio strutturato e orientato al dettaglio.

• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente, dimostrare la proprietà e il giudizio sonoro, e fornire risultati con supervisione limitata.

• Competenze di comunicazione affidabili, con la capacità di spiegare argomenti complessi chiaramente e sfidare costruttivamente.

• Conoscenza dei quadri normativi come DORA, linee guida di outsourcing, resilienza operativa, EIOPA, FINMA, PRA, MAS o Solvency II.

• Esperienza con strumenti TPM, workflow, reporting o GRC.
Bello ad avere

• Certificazioni rilevanti nella gestione dei rischi, audit, conformità o rischio di terze parti.

• Laurea magistrale in economia, finanza, economia, gestione del rischio o un campo correlato.

• Ulteriori competenze linguistiche.
Questo è il ruolo di copertura di maternità con contratto temporaneo.
Per la Slovacchia la fascia salariale di base per questa posizione è compresa tra 2 900 EUR e 4 800 EUR al mese (per un ruolo a tempo pieno). Lo stipendio specifico offerto considera:

• i requisiti, la portata, la complessità e le responsabilità del ruolo,

• il proprio profilo del richiedente, tra cui istruzione/qualifica, competenza, specializzazione, competenze ed esperienza.
Oltre al tuo stipendio base, Swiss Re offre un attraente componente di compensazione variabile basato sulle prestazioni, progettato per riconoscere i tuoi risultati. Inoltre potrete godere di una varietà di vantaggi globali e specifici posizione.
L'ammissibilità può variare a seconda dei termini delle politiche di Swiss Re e del contratto di lavoro.
#LI-Hybrid #
Informazioni su Swiss Re
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione, lavorando per rendere il mondo più resiliente. Aspettiamo e gestiamo una vasta gamma di rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine. Combinando l'esperienza con il pensiero creativo e l'esperienza all'avanguardia, creiamo nuove opportunità e soluzioni per i nostri clienti. Questo è possibile grazie alla collaborazione di oltre 15.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Abbracciamo un posto di lavoro dove ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il proprio sé autentico al lavoro e alla loro passione per la sostenibilità.

Se sei un professionista esperto di ritorno alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.
Possiamo utilizzare strumenti basati su AI per supportare la revisione e la valutazione delle applicazioni per questa posizione. Questi strumenti forniscono ulteriori informazioni ai nostri team di reclutamento, ma tutte le decisioni di assunzione sono attentamente esaminate e fatte dalle persone. Per saperne di più su come utilizziamo l'IA nel reclutamento e come gestiamo i tuoi dati personali, si prega di rivedere la nostra Informativa sulla privacy dei dati prima di applicare.

ABOUT THE TEAM
The TPM Operations and Delivery team runs core TPM services across onboarding, due diligence, monitoring, reporting and offboarding. We work with business units, legal entities, Procurement, Risk, Compliance and other control functions to apply TPM requirements consistently and support transparent regulatory and management reporting.
This role is for an experienced professional who can work independently, handle ambiguity, solve problems with discipline and help stakeholders do business with third parties in a controlled and efficient way.
ABOUT THE ROLE
As Third-Party Operations and Delivery Manager — DORA, you will coordinate TPM execution across the third-party lifecycle and support DORA-related deliverables, including data validation, legal entity coordination, reporting readiness and responses to audit or regulatory requests. You will translate requirements into clear actions, escalate issues early and help maintain high-quality data, controls and evidence.
This is a two-year fixed-term maternity cover role. Future opportunities within Swiss Re may be considered, subject to individual performance and business needs. We encourage applications from motivated professionals with relevant experience in third-party management, regulatory delivery, operational risk, compliance, procurement, audit or service delivery. The role is not designed as an entry-level position. It requires ownership, good judgement, stakeholder confidence and the ability to deliver results in a global environment.
ABOUT YOU
Must-have

• At least 5 years of relevant experience in third-party management, operational risk, compliance, procurement, outsourcing, audit, regulatory change or service delivery, ideally within a regulated environment (insurance, reinsurance or banking).

• Hands-on experience with third-party lifecycle processes (onboarding, due diligence, monitoring, issue tracking, reporting and offboarding).

• Strong understanding of risk, controls, data quality and audit requirements, including maintaining clear documentation and evidence.

• Proven ability to manage stakeholders and coordinate complex deliverables across global teams, legal entities and control functions.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a structured and detail-oriented approach.

• Ability to work independently, demonstrate ownership and sound judgement, and deliver results with limited supervision.

• Confident communication skills, with the ability to explain complex topics clearly and challenge constructively.

• Knowledge of regulatory frameworks such as DORA, outsourcing guidelines, operational resilience, EIOPA, FINMA, PRA, MAS or Solvency II.

• Experience with TPM, workflow, reporting or GRC tools.
Nice-to-have

• Relevant certifications in risk management, audit, compliance or third-party risk.

• Master’s degree in business, finance, economics, risk management or a related field.

• Additional language skills.
This is maternity cover role with temporary contract.
For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between 2 900 EUR and 4 800 EUR per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:​

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role, ​

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.​
In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.​
Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.
#LI-Hybrid
About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Das TPM Operations and Delivery Team betreibt die wichtigsten TPM-Services für Onboarding, Due Diligence, Monitoring, Reporting und Offboarding. Diese Rolle ist für einen erfahrenen Fachmann, der unabhängig arbeiten, Mehrdeutigkeiten handhaben, Probleme mit Disziplin lösen und Stakeholdern helfen kann, Geschäfte mit Dritten auf kontrollierte und effiziente Weise zu tätigen.
ÜBER DIE ROLLE
Als Third-Party Operations and Delivery Manager - DORA koordinieren Sie die TPM-Ausführung über den Lebenszyklus eines Drittanbieters hinweg und unterstützen DORA-bezogene Leistungen, einschließlich Datenvalidierung, Koordination von Rechtsträgern, Berichtsbereitschaft und Reaktionen auf Audit- oder regulatorische Anforderungen. Sie werden Anforderungen in klare Maßnahmen umsetzen, Probleme frühzeitig eskalieren und dazu beitragen, qualitativ hochwertige Daten, Kontrollen und Beweise zu erhalten.

Wir empfehlen Anwendungen von motivierten Fachleuten mit relevanter Erfahrung in den Bereichen Management von Drittanbietern, regulatorische Lieferung, Betriebsrisiko, Compliance, Beschaffung, Audit oder Servicebereitstellung. Die Rolle ist nicht als Einstiegsposition konzipiert. Es erfordert Eigenverantwortung, gutes Urteilsvermögen, Vertrauen der Stakeholder und die Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse in einem globalen Umfeld zu liefern.

Must-Have

• Fähigkeit, unabhängig zu arbeiten, Eigenverantwortung und fundiertes Urteilsvermögen zu demonstrieren und Ergebnisse mit begrenzter Aufsicht zu liefern.

Nice-to-have

Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen des versicherungsbasierten Risikotransfers und arbeitet daran, die Welt widerstandsfähiger zu machen. L'équipe des opérations et de la prestation des MPT gère les principaux services de MPT à l'échelle de l'intérieur, de la diligence raisonnable, de la surveillance, de l'établissement de rapports et de l'extérieur. Ce rôle est pour un professionnel expérimenté qui peut travailler de façon indépendante, gérer l'ambiguïté, résoudre les problèmes avec la discipline et aider les parties prenantes à faire des affaires avec des tiers de manière contrôlée et efficace.

En tant que gestionnaire des opérations et de la prestation des services de tiers — DORA, vous coordonnerez l'exécution des MPT tout au long du cycle de vie des tiers et appuierez les produits livrables liés à DORA, y compris la validation des données, la coordination des entités juridiques, l'état de préparation des rapports et les réponses aux demandes de vérification ou de réglementation. jobs.description:
Are you a qualified or nearly qualified Property & Casualty actuary looking to leverage your technical expertise in a role with broad organizational impact? Join our Group Internal Audit team where you'll help protect Swiss Re's assets, reputation, and sustainability through independent risk assessment and insightful recommendations. This role offers exceptional visibility across the business and the opportunity to influence topics of organizational significance.
 About the Role:
 As a Senior Auditor specializing in Property & Casualty actuarial topics, you'll lead audits across the (re)insurance value chain, focusing on reserving, pricing, and risk management. You'll evaluate control effectiveness, identify emerging risks, and engage with senior stakeholders to drive meaningful improvements and risk management practices. Coach and support team members while building effective stakeholder relationships. Contribute to a strong, forward-looking risk culture at Swiss Re.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and deliver a portfolio of audits across the Property & Casualty (re)insurance value chain, owning engagements end-to-end and ensuring timely, high-quality, risk-focused outcomes.

• Evaluate the effectiveness of governance, controls, and risk management practices across actuarial topics, including reserving and pricing.

• Identify and assess key and emerging risks within the P&C actuarial domain.

• Engage and challenge senior stakeholders, fostering transparent and constructive discussions that support effective risk management and decision-making.

• Coach and support team members while building effective stakeholder relationships.

• Contribute to a strong, forward-looking risk culture at Swiss Re.
 About the Team
 Group Internal Audit (GIA) provides independent and objective assurance to support the Board of Directors and Group Executive Committee in protecting Swiss Re's assets, reputation, and sustainability. GIA's vision is to advance Swiss Re's resilience by delivering risk-responsive assurance and providing innovative insights that strengthen the control environment and support the achievement of business objectives.

About You
 You're a detail-oriented Property & Casualty (P&C) actuary with strong analytical skills and the confidence to challenge established practices. You excel at translating complex actuarial concepts into meaningful business insights and can communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels. You're passionate about risk management and eager to contribute to Swiss Re's resilience through independent, objective assessment.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Nearly qualified or qualified P&C actuary

• 7+ years of experience in the insurance and/or reinsurance industry

• Strong experience in P&C reserving and/or pricing methodologies

• Understanding of emerging risks and trends in the P&C (re)insurance industry

• Solid understanding of IFRS 17 and/or US GAAP governance, processes, and controls
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience in internal audit or risk management functions

• Knowledge of regulatory frameworks applicable to (re)insurance companies

• Experience with data analytics tools and techniques

• Project management skills and experience leading small teams

This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short-and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.

Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. Sei un azionario di Proprietà & Casualty qualificato o quasi qualificato che cerca di sfruttare le tue competenze tecniche in un ruolo con ampio impatto organizzativo? Unisciti al nostro team di Gruppo Internal Audit dove potrai proteggere i beni, la reputazione e la sostenibilità di Swiss Re attraverso la valutazione del rischio indipendente e raccomandazioni approfondite. Questo ruolo offre una visibilità eccezionale in tutto il business e l'opportunità di influenzare temi di significato organizzativo.
Informazioni sul ruolo:
In qualità di Senior Auditor specializzato negli argomenti di proprietà & Casualty actuarial, guiderai audit attraverso la (re) catena del valore di assicurazione, concentrandosi sulla conservazione, sui prezzi e sulla gestione dei rischi. Valuterai l'efficacia del controllo, identificherai i rischi emergenti e ti impegni con gli stakeholder senior per guidare miglioramenti significativi e pratiche di gestione dei rischi. I membri del team di coach e di supporto mentre costruiscono relazioni efficaci con gli stakeholder. Contribuisci a una forte cultura del rischio in vista della Svizzera Re.

Principali responsabilità

• Guidare e fornire un portafoglio di audit attraverso la catena di valore di garanzia di proprietà & Casualty (re), possedere gli impegni end-to-end e garantire risultati tempestivi, di alta qualità, focalizzati sul rischio.

• Valutare l'efficacia della governance, dei controlli e delle pratiche di gestione del rischio su argomenti attuariali, tra cui la conservazione e la valutazione dei prezzi.

• Identificare e valutare i rischi chiave e emergenti all'interno del dominio attuariale P&C.

• Coinvolgere e sfidare gli stakeholder senior, promuovendo discussioni trasparenti e costruttive che sostengono una gestione efficace del rischio e un processo decisionale.

• I membri del team di coach e di supporto mentre costruiscono relazioni efficaci con gli stakeholder.

• Contribuisci a una forte cultura del rischio in vista della Svizzera Re.
Informazioni sulla squadra
Group Internal Audit (GIA) garantisce l'indipendenza e l'obiettivo di supportare il Consiglio di Amministrazione e il Comitato Esecutivo di Gruppo nella tutela dei beni, della reputazione e della sostenibilità di Swiss Re. La visione di GIA è quella di anticipare la resilienza di Swiss Re, garantendo la risposta ai rischi e fornendo informazioni innovative che rafforzano l'ambiente di controllo e supportano il raggiungimento degli obiettivi aziendali.

A proposito di te
Sei un'attivita' dettagliata di Property & Casualty (P&C) con forti competenze analitiche e la fiducia nella sfida delle pratiche stabilite. Si eccelle nel tradurre concetti attuariali complessi in insight aziendali significativi e in grado di comunicare efficacemente con gli stakeholder a tutti i livelli. Sei appassionato di gestione del rischio e desideroso di contribuire alla resilienza di Swiss Re attraverso una valutazione obiettiva indipendente.
Siamo alla ricerca di candidati che soddisfano questi requisiti:

• Attuario P&C quasi qualificato o qualificato

• 7+ anni di esperienza nel settore assicurativo e/o riassicurazione

• Forte esperienza nelle metodologie di prenotazione e/o prezzi P&C

• Comprensione dei rischi e delle tendenze emergenti nel settore dell'assicurazione P&C

• Solida comprensione della governance, dei processi e dei controlli del GAAP degli Stati Uniti
Questi sono ulteriori bello da avere:

• Esperienza nelle funzioni di audit interno o gestione del rischio

• Conoscenza dei quadri normativi applicabili alle imprese di assicurazione

• Esperienza con strumenti e tecniche di analisi dei dati

• Capacità di gestione del progetto e esperienza leader di piccoli team
Il range di stipendio base stimato per questa posizione per Armonk, NY è di $120,000 a $200,000 e per Chicago/Schaumburg, IL, la gamma è di $113,000 - $188,000. Lo stipendio specifico offerto per questo, o qualsiasi dato ruolo terrà conto di un certo numero di fattori, tra cui ma non limitato alla posizione del lavoro, la portata del ruolo, le qualifiche, la complessità/specializzazione/scarsità del talento, l'esperienza, l'istruzione e il bilancio del datore di lavoro. A Swiss Re, prendiamo un "approccio di compensazione totale" quando prendiamo decisioni di risarcimento. Ciò significa che consideriamo tutti i componenti di compensazione nella loro totalità (come la retribuzione base, gli incentivi a breve e a lungo termine e i benefici offerti), nella definizione di una compensazione individuale.
Informazioni su Swiss Re
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione, lavorando per rendere il mondo più resiliente. Aspettiamo e gestiamo una vasta gamma di rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine. Copriamo sia Proprietà & Casuale e Vita & Salute. Combinando l'esperienza con il pensiero creativo e l'esperienza all'avanguardia, creiamo nuove opportunità e soluzioni per i nostri clienti. Questo è possibile grazie alla collaborazione di oltre 15.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Abbracciamo un posto di lavoro dove ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il proprio sé autentico al lavoro e alla loro passione per la sostenibilità.

Se sei un professionista esperto di ritorno alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.

Svizzera Re è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. È la nostra pratica di reclutare, assumere e promuovere senza riguardo a razza, religione, colore, origine nazionale, sesso, disabilità, età, gravidanza, orientamento sessuale, stato civile, stato militare, o qualsiasi altra caratteristica protetta dalla legge. Le decisioni sull'occupazione si basano esclusivamente sulle qualifiche di un individuo per la posizione in essere.

Durante il processo di reclutamento, su richiesta sono disponibili sistemazioni ragionevoli per disabili. Se contattato per un'intervista, si prega di informare il Recruiter/HR Professional dell'alloggio necessario.

Possiamo utilizzare strumenti basati su AI per supportare la revisione e la valutazione delle applicazioni per questa posizione. Questi strumenti forniscono ulteriori informazioni ai nostri team di reclutamento, ma tutte le decisioni di assunzione sono attentamente esaminate e fatte dalle persone. Per saperne di più su come utilizziamo l'IA nel reclutamento e come gestiamo i tuoi dati personali, si prega di rivedere la nostra Informativa sulla privacy dei dati prima di applicare.

Are you a qualified or nearly qualified Property & Casualty actuary looking to leverage your technical expertise in a role with broad organizational impact? Join our Group Internal Audit team where you'll help protect Swiss Re's assets, reputation, and sustainability through independent risk assessment and insightful recommendations. This role offers exceptional visibility across the business and the opportunity to influence topics of organizational significance.
About the Role:
As a Senior Auditor specializing in Property & Casualty actuarial topics, you'll lead audits across the (re)insurance value chain, focusing on reserving, pricing, and risk management. You'll evaluate control effectiveness, identify emerging risks, and engage with senior stakeholders to drive meaningful improvements and risk management practices. Coach and support team members while building effective stakeholder relationships. Contribute to a strong, forward-looking risk culture at Swiss Re.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and deliver a portfolio of audits across the Property & Casualty (re)insurance value chain, owning engagements end-to-end and ensuring timely, high-quality, risk-focused outcomes.

• Evaluate the effectiveness of governance, controls, and risk management practices across actuarial topics, including reserving and pricing.

• Identify and assess key and emerging risks within the P&C actuarial domain.

• Engage and challenge senior stakeholders, fostering transparent and constructive discussions that support effective risk management and decision-making.

• Coach and support team members while building effective stakeholder relationships.

• Contribute to a strong, forward-looking risk culture at Swiss Re.
About the Team
Group Internal Audit (GIA) provides independent and objective assurance to support the Board of Directors and Group Executive Committee in protecting Swiss Re's assets, reputation, and sustainability. GIA's vision is to advance Swiss Re's resilience by delivering risk-responsive assurance and providing innovative insights that strengthen the control environment and support the achievement of business objectives.

About You
You're a detail-oriented Property & Casualty (P&C) actuary with strong analytical skills and the confidence to challenge established practices. You excel at translating complex actuarial concepts into meaningful business insights and can communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels. You're passionate about risk management and eager to contribute to Swiss Re's resilience through independent, objective assessment.
We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Nearly qualified or qualified P&C actuary

• 7+ years of experience in the insurance and/or reinsurance industry

• Strong experience in P&C reserving and/or pricing methodologies

• Understanding of emerging risks and trends in the P&C (re)insurance industry

• Solid understanding of IFRS 17 and/or US GAAP governance, processes, and controls
These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience in internal audit or risk management functions

• Knowledge of regulatory frameworks applicable to (re)insurance companies

• Experience with data analytics tools and techniques

• Project management skills and experience leading small teams
The estimated base salary range for this position for Armonk, NY is $120,000 to $200,000 and for Chicago/Schaumburg, IL, the range is $113,000 - $188,000. The specific salary offered for this, or any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short-and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.
About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

Swiss Re is an equal opportunity employer. It is our practice to recruit, hire and promote without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, pregnancy, sexual orientations, marital status, military status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Decisions on employment are solely based on an individual's qualifications for the position being filled.

During the recruitment process, reasonable accommodations for disabilities are available upon request. If contacted for an interview, please inform the Recruiter/HR Professional of the accommodation needed.

We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Sind Sie ein qualifizierter oder nahezu qualifizierter Immobilien- und Unfallversicherungsmathematiker, der Ihre technische Expertise in einer Rolle mit breiter organisatorischer Wirkung einsetzen möchte? Treten Sie unserem Group Internal Audit-Team bei, wo Sie dazu beitragen, die Vermögenswerte, den Ruf und die Nachhaltigkeit von Swiss Re durch unabhängige Risikobewertung und aufschlussreiche Empfehlungen zu schützen. Diese Rolle bietet eine außergewöhnliche Sichtbarkeit im gesamten Unternehmen und die Möglichkeit, Themen von organisatorischer Bedeutung zu beeinflussen.
Über die Rolle:
Als Senior Auditor, der sich auf versicherungsmathematische Themen im Bereich Property & Casualty spezialisiert hat, leiten Sie Audits entlang der (Rück-)Versicherungs-Wertschöpfungskette, wobei Sie sich auf Reservierung, Preisgestaltung und Risikomanagement konzentrieren. Sie bewerten die Wirksamkeit der Kontrolle, identifizieren aufkommende Risiken und setzen sich mit hochrangigen Stakeholdern zusammen, um sinnvolle Verbesserungen und Risikomanagementpraktiken voranzutreiben. Coach und Support Teammitglieder beim Aufbau effektiver Stakeholder-Beziehungen. Tragen Sie zu einer starken, zukunftsweisenden Risikokultur bei Swiss Re bei.

Wichtigste Zuständigkeiten

• Führen und liefern Sie ein Portfolio von Audits in der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette von Property & Casualty (Rück-)Versicherung, besitzen Sie End-to-End-Engagements und gewährleisten Sie zeitnahe, qualitativ hochwertige, risikoorientierte Ergebnisse.

• Bewerten Sie die Wirksamkeit von Governance-, Kontroll- und Risikomanagementpraktiken für versicherungsmathematische Themen, einschließlich Reservierung und Preisgestaltung.

• Identifizieren und bewerten Sie wichtige und sich abzeichnende Risiken im P&C-Aktuarbereich.

• Engagieren und fordern Sie hochrangige Stakeholder heraus und fördern Sie transparente und konstruktive Diskussionen, die ein effektives Risikomanagement und eine effektive Entscheidungsfindung unterstützen.

• Coach und Support Teammitglieder beim Aufbau effektiver Stakeholder-Beziehungen.

• Tragen Sie zu einer starken, zukunftsweisenden Risikokultur bei Swiss Re bei.
Über das Team
Group Internal Audit (GIA) bietet eine unabhängige und objektive Zusicherung, um den Verwaltungsrat und das Group Executive Committee beim Schutz von Vermögenswerten, Reputation und Nachhaltigkeit zu unterstützen. Die Vision von GIA ist es, die Widerstandsfähigkeit von Swiss Re zu verbessern, indem wir risikoresponsive Sicherheit bieten und innovative Erkenntnisse liefern, die das Steuerungsumfeld stärken und die Erreichung der Geschäftsziele unterstützen.

Über dich
Sie sind ein detailorientierter Immobilien- und Unfallversicherungsmathematiker mit starken analytischen Fähigkeiten und dem Vertrauen, etablierte Praktiken in Frage zu stellen. Sie zeichnen sich durch die Übersetzung komplexer versicherungsmathematischer Konzepte in aussagekräftige Business Insights aus und können effektiv mit Stakeholdern auf allen Ebenen kommunizieren. Sie haben eine Leidenschaft für Risikomanagement und möchten durch eine unabhängige, objektive Bewertung zur Widerstandsfähigkeit von Swiss Re beitragen.
Wir suchen Kandidaten, die diese Anforderungen erfüllen:

• Nahezu qualifizierter oder qualifizierter P&C-Aktuar

• 7+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Versicherungs- und/oder Rückversicherungsbranche

• Starke Erfahrung in P & C Reservierungs- und / oder Preisgestaltungsmethoden

• Verständnis neuer Risiken und Trends in der P&C (Rück-)Versicherungsbranche

• Solides Verständnis von IFRS 17 und/oder US GAAP Governance, Prozesse und Kontrollen
Dies sind zusätzliche nett zu haben:

• Erfahrung in internen Audit- oder Risikomanagementfunktionen

• Kenntnis der für (Rück-)Versicherungsgesellschaften geltenden regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen

• Erfahrung mit Data Analytics Tools und Techniken

• Projektmanagementfähigkeiten und Erfahrung in der Leitung kleiner Teams
Die geschätzte Basisgehaltsspanne für diese Position für Armonk, NY, beträgt 120.000 bis 200.000 US-Dollar und für Chicago/Schaumburg, IL, beträgt die Spanne 113.000 bis 188.000 US-Dollar. Das spezifische Gehalt, das dafür oder eine bestimmte Rolle angeboten wird, berücksichtigt eine Reihe von Faktoren, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf den Arbeitsplatz, den Umfang der Rolle, die Qualifikationen, die Komplexität / Spezialisierung / Knappheit von Talenten, Erfahrung, Ausbildung und Arbeitgeberbudget. Bei Swiss Re verfolgen wir einen „Gesamtvergütungsansatz, wenn wir Entschädigungsentscheidungen treffen. Dies bedeutet, dass wir alle Komponenten der Entschädigung in ihrer Gesamtheit (wie Grundlohn, kurz- und langfristige Anreize und angebotene Vorteile) bei der Festlegung der individuellen Entschädigung berücksichtigen.
Über Swiss Re
Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen des versicherungsbasierten Risikotransfers und arbeitet daran, die Welt widerstandsfähiger zu machen. Wir antizipieren und managen eine Vielzahl von Risiken, von Naturkatastrophen und Klimawandel bis hin zu Cyberkriminalität. Wir decken sowohl Eigentum & Unfall und Leben & Gesundheit. Durch die Kombination von Erfahrung mit kreativem Denken und modernster Expertise schaffen wir neue Möglichkeiten und Lösungen für unsere Kunden. Dies ist dank der Zusammenarbeit von mehr als 15.000 Mitarbeitern auf der ganzen Welt möglich.

Unser Erfolg hängt von unserer Fähigkeit ab, eine integrative Kultur aufzubauen, die neue Perspektiven und innovatives Denken fördert. Wir nehmen einen Arbeitsplatz an, an dem jeder die gleichen Chancen hat, beruflich zu gedeihen und sich zu entwickeln, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Rasse, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Geschlechtsidentität und / oder Ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, körperlicher oder geistiger Fähigkeit, Fähigkeiten, Gedanken oder anderen Eigenschaften. In unserem integrativen und flexiblen Umfeld kann jeder sein authentisches Selbst und seine Leidenschaft für Nachhaltigkeit mitbringen.

Wenn Sie ein erfahrener Profi sind, der nach einer Berufspause in die Belegschaft zurückkehrt, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich für offene Stellen zu bewerben, die Ihren Fähigkeiten und Ihrer Erfahrung entsprechen.

Schweizer Re ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit. Es ist unsere Praxis, ohne Rücksicht auf Rasse, Religion, Hautfarbe, nationale Herkunft, Geschlecht, Behinderung, Alter, Schwangerschaft, sexuelle Orientierungen, Familienstand, Militärstatus oder andere gesetzlich geschützte Merkmale zu rekrutieren, einzustellen und zu fördern. Entscheidungen über die Beschäftigung basieren ausschließlich auf den Qualifikationen einer Person für die zu besetzende Stelle.

Während des Rekrutierungsprozesses sind angemessene Unterkünfte für Behinderungen auf Anfrage verfügbar. Wenn Sie für ein Interview kontaktiert werden, informieren Sie bitte den Recruiter / HR Professional über die erforderliche Unterkunft.

Wir können KI-basierte Tools verwenden, um die Überprüfung und Bewertung von Anwendungen für diese Position zu unterstützen. Diese Tools bieten unseren Rekrutierungsteams zusätzliche Einblicke, aber alle Einstellungsentscheidungen werden sorgfältig überprüft und von Menschen getroffen. Um mehr darüber zu erfahren, wie wir KI bei der Rekrutierung einsetzen und wie wir mit Ihren personenbezogenen Daten umgehen, lesen Sie bitte unsere Datenschutzerklärung, bevor Sie sich bewerben.
