An opportunity to join a fast-growing, dynamic, foreign insurance company. You will be generating new business and conducting insurance solicitation activities, origination and development with agencies and brokers. Specific responsibility to help lead the distribution management of the Japan branch in the large and middle corporate market through innovative and differentiated insurance products, solutions and digital platforms in coordination with Senior Distribution Manager.

About the role

Position objectives and position summary

Generating new business and conducting insurance solicitation activities, origination and development with agencies and brokers. Maintaining and expanding the relationships with target clients, understanding the full product suite, in order to identify business opportunities.

Main tasks/activities

• Develop and implement strategies for distribution management in Japan

• Understand the business strategy and underwriting appetite of each business line to generate profitable business

• Function as a hub for the Japanese market and underwriting teams to explore localized and effective business flows

• Implement the PDCA cycle to activate the assigned agencies and brokers

• Proactively acquire market trends and communicate them to internal stakeholders

• Influence across teams to further improve branch operations in Japan

• Negotiate tenaciously with internal and external stakeholders

• Generate new revenue streams by deploying products with targeted agencies through digital platforms

• Act as the primary contact for the assigned agencies and brokers

• Collaborate with underwriting and operations to ensure alignment

• Prepare and/or support colleagues to work out insurance solicitation material and various marketing material

• Enter and maintain sales activities (e.g.: initiatives, discussion notes, quotations) in Customer 360 and necessary database

• Contribute to other project work and accept special assignments as and when necessary

• Adhere to all laws and regulations both external and internal

• Representation activities and interaction with other parties

• Represents SRIJ in meetings with clients, agencies, brokers and other intermediaries and organizations

About the team

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions (Swiss Re International SE), Tokyo Office.

Working as part of a dynamic and growing Customer and Distribution team that reports directly to the Head of Japan, helping to deliver innovative solutions to customers, agencies and brokers.

About You

You will ideally have worked in a commercial insurance company or agency in Japan and have the following attributes.

• Minimum 5 years-experience in Japanese agency business handling corporate business

• Good knowledge about the Japanese corporate insurance business as well as agency management and pipeline development.

• Open mindset with good communication skills

• Ability to drive innovation

• Ability to communicate clearly and persuasively internally and externally

• Self-motivated, organized and persistent in achieving goals

• Native Japanese language skills

• English reding/writing capability. Spoken English is an advantage

The base salary range for this position will be shared with you during the interview process.

About Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group. We offer innovative insurance solutions to large and midsized multinational corporations from our approximately 50 locations worldwide. We help clients mitigate their risk exposure, whilst our industry-leading claims service provides them with additional peace of mind.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions embraces a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

 About You
 We're seeking enthusiastic professionals who can be effective leaders with strong functional and operational expertise. You should be an excellent communicator capable of building trust-based relationships within your squad and among partners.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements

• Proven experience with business analysis and requirements engineering

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail

• Knowledge of tools and techniques needed for data analysis and management

• Ability to validate data accuracy and troubleshoot reporting issues

• Experience analyzing large datasets and identifying actionable insights

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to articulate complex technical issues to non-technical audiences

• Ability to work with tight deadlines, prioritize effectively, and adapt to changing organizational objectives

• Confidence in presenting applications/demos to internal and external stakeholders

• Exposure to agile development approaches (e.g., Scrum) and familiarity with tools like Azure DevOps or Confluence

• Business fluency in English

• Experience in the Re-/Insurance industry

Unisciti a noi significa imparare non solo come i premi assicurativi sono modellati e come l'analisi dei dati arricchisce le operazioni aziendali, ma anche migliorare le tue capacità di gestione degli stakeholder, le pratiche di sviluppo agile e la competenza con strumenti che guidano progetti di impatto.

• Esperienza comprovata con l'analisi aziendale e l'ingegneria dei requisiti

• Conoscenza di strumenti e tecniche necessarie per l'analisi e la gestione dei dati

• Capacità di convalidare l'accuratezza dei dati e risolvere i problemi di reporting

• Esperienza nell'analisi di grandi set di dati e nell'individuazione di insight attuabili

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale; capacità di articolare complesse questioni tecniche al pubblico non tecnico

• Capacità di lavorare con scadenze strette, priorità in modo efficace, e adattarsi ai cambiamenti obiettivi organizzativi

• Confidenza nel presentare applicazioni/demo agli stakeholder interni ed esterni

• Esposizione agli approcci di sviluppo agili (ad esempio Scrum) e familiarità con strumenti come Azure DevOps o Confluence

Questi sono ulteriori bello da avere

• Esperienza nel settore Re-/Insurance

• Capacità di identificare punti di forza e di debolezza nei processi aziendali e suggerire aree di miglioramento

• Conoscenza degli strumenti e delle tecniche di visualizzazione dei dati

Per la Slovacchia la gamma di stipendio base per questa posizione è compresa tra 3,200 EUR e 5,300 EUR al mese (per un ruolo a tempo pieno). Lo stipendio specifico offerto considera:

Our team serves as an empowered tech counterpart for business units, responsible for designing and implementing inventive data projects. We develop cutting-edge analytics capabilities and enhance Swiss Re's risk assessment frameworks.
Joining us means learning not just how insurance premiums are modelled and how data analytics enriches business operations, but also improving your stakeholder management skills, agile development practices, and proficiency with tools that drive impactful projects.
About You
We're seeking enthusiastic professionals who can be effective leaders with strong functional and operational expertise. You should be an excellent communicator capable of building trust-based relationships within your squad and among partners.

• Proven experience with business analysis and requirements engineering

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail

• Knowledge of tools and techniques needed for data analysis and management

• Ability to validate data accuracy and troubleshoot reporting issues

• Experience analyzing large datasets and identifying actionable insights

• Business fluency in English

About the Role
 We are seeking a Junior Automation Engineer to join our global Solutions team in Mexico . In this role, you will contribute to the evolution and support of Magnum , Swiss Re’s market-leading automated underwriting solution, currently deployed with more than 70 clients worldwide .
 You will play a key role across the full solution lifecycle — from design and development through testing, validation, and continuous improvement. Working closely with product, underwriting, and technology stakeholders, you will help ensure Magnum continues to deliver reliable, scalable, and best-in-class automated underwriting capabilities that support our clients’ digital transformation journeys.
 Magnum is a strategic Swiss Re product, combining advanced risk knowledge with modern automation technologies to enable efficient, consistent, and high-quality underwriting decisions across Life and Health markets.
 Key Responsibilities

• Participate in the design, development, and delivery of automation solutions aligned with product strategy and client requirements

• Produce clear and well-structured functional and technical specifications

• Develop and maintain underwriting rules, automation logic, and supporting components

• Contribute to ongoing Magnum product enhancements and innovation initiatives

• Apply automation and RPA technologies to streamline and optimize business processes

• Design, execute, and maintain comprehensive test plans, including regression test packs

• Validate development outcomes against defined business and client requirements

• Identify, track, and resolve defects throughout the full development lifecycle

• Actively participate in user acceptance testing (UAT) cycles and release validation activities

• Design, develop, and maintain automated testing frameworks and test suites

• Continuously improve test automation approaches to enhance coverage, reliability, and efficiency

• Collaborate effectively with global stakeholders across multiple time zones
 About You
 Nobody is perfect, and we don’t expect you to meet every requirement. If you meet most of the criteria below and are motivated to learn and grow, we would be happy to meet you.
 Required Experience & Skills

• 2-3 + years of experience in software development, automation engineering, or quality engineering

• Experience working in Insurance, Banking, or Financial Services IT environments

• Experience with Agile delivery methodologies and tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms

• Solid understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)

• Programming experience in Java, JavaScript, C#, or similar languages

• Experience in test design, execution, and defect management

• Familiarity with web technologies, API testing, and SQL databases

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills

• Ability to collaborate effectively in a global, multicultural environment
 Nice to Have

• Experience with automation and RPA tools (UiPath preferred)

• Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks and tools (e.g. BDD, Selenium, Postman, Visual Studio)

• An entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to take ownership and step beyond defined role boundaries

What We Offer
 At Swiss Re, you’ll be part of a purpose-driven organization that values expertise, collaboration, and continuous learning. Based in Mexico, you will work in a global environment while benefiting from a strong local community and support structure.

• A collaborative, inclusive, and diverse workplace where different perspectives are valued

• The opportunity to work on a strategic, market-leading product with global client impact

• Hybrid working model, combining office collaboration in Mexico with flexible remote working

• Flexible working arrangements supporting work–life balance

• Competitive compensation and benefits aligned with the Mexico market
 Our Culture
 Swiss Re’s culture is built on trust, accountability, and respect. We empower our people to take ownership, challenge ideas constructively, and continuously improve how we work.

• An environment where people feel safe to speak up, experiment, and learn from mistakes

• Strong emphasis on teamwork, integrity, and delivery excellence

• Collaboration across global teams and functions in a multicultural setting

• A commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion at all levels of the organization
 Learning, Growth & Wellbeing
 We believe that sustainable performance comes from continuous development and personal wellbeing.

• Access to Swiss Re learning platforms, including digital learning libraries, technical training, and professional development programs

• Opportunities for on-the-job learning, knowledge sharing, and internal mobility across Swiss Re

• Support for personal and professional growth through feedback, coaching, and development conversations

• A strong focus on employee wellbeing, including wellbeing initiatives, mental health support, and a supportive working environment

• Modern office facilities in Mexico, designed to support collaboration, focus, and flexibility
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. In questo ruolo, contribuirai all’evoluzione e al supporto di Magnum , la soluzione di sottoscrizione automatizzata leader nel mercato di Swiss Re, attualmente impiegata con oltre 70 clienti in tutto il mondo.
Si svolgerà un ruolo chiave in tutto il ciclo di vita della soluzione completa — dalla progettazione e sviluppo attraverso test, convalida e miglioramento continuo. Lavorando a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder di prodotto, sottoscrittura e tecnologia, vi aiuterà a garantire che Magnum continui a fornire funzionalità di sottoscrizione automatizzate affidabili, scalabili e di classe migliore che supportano i viaggi di trasformazione digitale dei nostri clienti.
Magnum è un prodotto strategico della Swiss Re, che combina conoscenze di rischio avanzate con le moderne tecnologie di automazione per consentire decisioni di sottoscrizione efficienti, coerenti e di alta qualità nei mercati Life and Health.
Principali responsabilità

• Partecipare alla progettazione, allo sviluppo e alla consegna di soluzioni di automazione allineate con la strategia del prodotto e i requisiti del cliente

• Produrre specifiche funzionali e tecniche chiare e ben strutturate

• Sviluppare e mantenere regole di sottoscrizione, logica di automazione e componenti di supporto

• Contribuire ai miglioramenti dei prodotti Magnum in corso e alle iniziative di innovazione

• Applicare tecnologie di automazione e RPA per semplificare e ottimizzare i processi aziendali

• Progettare, eseguire e mantenere piani di test completi, compresi i pacchetti di test di regressione

• Convalida i risultati di sviluppo contro i requisiti aziendali e client definiti

• Identificare, tracciare e risolvere i difetti durante il ciclo di vita di sviluppo completo

• Partecipa attivamente ai test di accettazione degli utenti (UAT) cicli e attività di validazione del rilascio

• Progettare, sviluppare e mantenere quadri di prova automatizzati e suite di test

• Migliorare costantemente gli approcci di automazione dei test per migliorare la copertura, l'affidabilità e l'efficienza

• Collaborare efficacemente con gli stakeholder globali in più fusi orari
A proposito di te
Nessuno è perfetto, e non ci aspettiamo di soddisfare ogni esigenza. Se si soddisfano la maggior parte dei criteri qui sotto e sono motivati a imparare e crescere, saremmo felici di incontrarvi.
Esperienza e competenze necessarie

About the Role
We are seeking a Junior Automation Engineer to join our global Solutions team in Mexico . In this role, you will contribute to the evolution and support of Magnum , Swiss Re’s market-leading automated underwriting solution, currently deployed with more than 70 clients worldwide .
You will play a key role across the full solution lifecycle — from design and development through testing, validation, and continuous improvement. Working closely with product, underwriting, and technology stakeholders, you will help ensure Magnum continues to deliver reliable, scalable, and best-in-class automated underwriting capabilities that support our clients’ digital transformation journeys.
Magnum is a strategic Swiss Re product, combining advanced risk knowledge with modern automation technologies to enable efficient, consistent, and high-quality underwriting decisions across Life and Health markets.
Key Responsibilities

• Participate in the design, development, and delivery of automation solutions aligned with product strategy and client requirements

• Produce clear and well-structured functional and technical specifications

• Develop and maintain underwriting rules, automation logic, and supporting components

• Contribute to ongoing Magnum product enhancements and innovation initiatives

• Apply automation and RPA technologies to streamline and optimize business processes

• Design, execute, and maintain comprehensive test plans, including regression test packs

• Validate development outcomes against defined business and client requirements

• Identify, track, and resolve defects throughout the full development lifecycle

• Actively participate in user acceptance testing (UAT) cycles and release validation activities

• Design, develop, and maintain automated testing frameworks and test suites

• Continuously improve test automation approaches to enhance coverage, reliability, and efficiency

• Collaborate effectively with global stakeholders across multiple time zones
About You
Nobody is perfect, and we don’t expect you to meet every requirement. If you meet most of the criteria below and are motivated to learn and grow, we would be happy to meet you.
Required Experience & Skills

• 2-3 + years of experience in software development, automation engineering, or quality engineering

• Experience working in Insurance, Banking, or Financial Services IT environments

• Experience with Agile delivery methodologies and tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms

• Solid understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)

• Programming experience in Java, JavaScript, C#, or similar languages

• Experience in test design, execution, and defect management

• Familiarity with web technologies, API testing, and SQL databases

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills

• Ability to collaborate effectively in a global, multicultural environment
Nice to Have

• Experience with automation and RPA tools (UiPath preferred)

• Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks and tools (e.g. BDD, Selenium, Postman, Visual Studio)

• An entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to take ownership and step beyond defined role boundaries

What We Offer
At Swiss Re, you’ll be part of a purpose-driven organization that values expertise, collaboration, and continuous learning. Based in Mexico, you will work in a global environment while benefiting from a strong local community and support structure.

• A collaborative, inclusive, and diverse workplace where different perspectives are valued

• The opportunity to work on a strategic, market-leading product with global client impact

• Hybrid working model, combining office collaboration in Mexico with flexible remote working

• Flexible working arrangements supporting work–life balance

• Competitive compensation and benefits aligned with the Mexico market
Our Culture
Swiss Re’s culture is built on trust, accountability, and respect. We empower our people to take ownership, challenge ideas constructively, and continuously improve how we work.

• An environment where people feel safe to speak up, experiment, and learn from mistakes

• Strong emphasis on teamwork, integrity, and delivery excellence

• Collaboration across global teams and functions in a multicultural setting

• A commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion at all levels of the organization
Learning, Growth & Wellbeing
We believe that sustainable performance comes from continuous development and personal wellbeing.

• Access to Swiss Re learning platforms, including digital learning libraries, technical training, and professional development programs

• Opportunities for on-the-job learning, knowledge sharing, and internal mobility across Swiss Re

• Support for personal and professional growth through feedback, coaching, and development conversations

• A strong focus on employee wellbeing, including wellbeing initiatives, mental health support, and a supportive working environment

• Modern office facilities in Mexico, designed to support collaboration, focus, and flexibility
About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 14,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

jobs.description:
Are you an actuarial university student eager to gain hands-on experience in the insurance world? This is your opportunity to dive into real actuarial work, sharpen your analytical skills, and contribute to meaningful projects that shape how we understand and manage risk across Latin America. If you are curious, driven, and ready to learn, we want to hear from you!

About the Role
 As an Actuarial Portfolio Management Intern within Corporate Solutions, you will be embedded in a dynamic, collaborative environment where your contributions truly matter. From day one, you will support global pricing and portfolio management activities focused on Latin America, working alongside experienced actuaries and business partners. This is a unique chance to apply your academic knowledge to real-world challenges while building a strong foundation for your actuarial career.
 Key Responsibilities

• Develop queries and reports to analyze data from our pricing tools, providing deeper insights into portfolio performance and monitoring changes over time

• Build analytical templates to assess the profitability of key portfolios and support our quarterly profitability review process

• Analyze external data for benchmarking purposes and to identify emerging trends that impact our business across Latin America

• Assist in updating parameters used in our actuarial tools and models to ensure accuracy and relevance of actuarial indications

• Contribute to actuarial projects as needed, gaining broad exposure to different areas of the actuarial function within a global reinsurance environment

About the Team
 We are the Global Pricing and Portfolio Management team within the Underwriting Center at Corporate Solutions, dedicated to supporting Latin America business. Our team plays a critical role in delivering actuarial expertise across multiple lines of business, with core responsibilities spanning loss ratio projections, rating plan development, and parameter updates . We collaborate closely with partners across Underwriting, Product, Finance, Claims, Reserving, and Data Science — making us a central hub of analytical insight within the organization.

About You
 You are an intellectually curious and proactive student who enjoys working with data and solving complex problems. You communicate clearly, take initiative, and are comfortable working in a multicultural, fast-paced environment. You are eager to learn, open to feedback, and motivated to build a career in actuarial science or a related quantitative field.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Currently studying Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, or another quantitative field , with graduation expected in the second semester of 2027 or later

• Advanced English proficiency — you will regularly collaborate with teams across different regions and geographies

• Intermediate to advanced Excel skills , with the ability to build and work with analytical models and templates
 These are additional nice to haves:

• Spanish language skills — desirable for engagement with Latin America stakeholders, though not required

• Knowledge of VBA for automating tasks and enhancing Excel-based tools

• SQL skills for querying and managing large datasets

• Experience with R or Python for statistical analysis and data manipulation

• Strong communication skills — ability to present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

• A genuine interest in the insurance and reinsurance industry and enthusiasm for building an actuarial career

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.

 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group. Questa è la tua opportunità di immergerti in un lavoro attuariale reale, affinare le tue capacità analitiche e contribuire a progetti significativi che modellano come comprendiamo e gestiamo il rischio in tutta l'America Latina. Se siete curiosi, guidati e pronti ad imparare, vogliamo sentire da voi!

Informazioni sul ruolo
In qualità di Interno Actuarial Portfolio Management all'interno di Corporate Solutions, sarete incorporati in un ambiente dinamico e collaborativo in cui i vostri contributi sono veramente importanti. Dal primo giorno, supporterete le attività globali di pricing e gestione del portafoglio incentrate sull'America Latina, lavorando insieme a attuariari esperti e partner commerciali. Questa è una possibilità unica di applicare la vostra conoscenza accademica alle sfide del mondo reale, mentre la costruzione di una solida base per la vostra carriera attuariale.
Principali responsabilità

• Sviluppare query e report per analizzare i dati dai nostri strumenti di pricing, fornendo approfondimenti sulle prestazioni del portafoglio e sui cambiamenti di monitoraggio nel tempo

• Costruisci modelli analitici per valutare la redditività dei portafogli chiave e supporta il nostro processo di revisione trimestrale della redditività

• Analizzare i dati esterni a fini di benchmarking e identificare le tendenze emergenti che influenzano la nostra attività in America Latina

• Assistere nell'aggiornamento dei parametri utilizzati nei nostri strumenti e modelli attuariali per garantire accuratezza e pertinenza delle indicazioni attuariali

• Contribuire a progetti attuariali come necessario, acquisendo ampia esposizione a diverse aree della funzione attuariale all'interno di un ambiente di riassicurazione globale

Informazioni sulla squadra
Siamo il team Global Pricing and Portfolio Management all'interno del Centro di sottoscrittura di Corporate Solutions, dedicato al supporto del business in America Latina. Il nostro team svolge un ruolo fondamentale nella fornitura di competenze attuariali in più linee di business, con responsabilità fondamentali che spaziano a proiezioni di rapporto di perdita, sviluppo del piano di rating e aggiornamenti dei parametri. Collaboriamo a stretto contatto con i partner attraverso la sottoscrizione, il prodotto, le finanze, i reclami, la conservazione e la scienza dei dati - rendendoci un hub centrale di comprensione analitica all'interno dell'organizzazione.

A proposito di te
Sei uno studente intellettualmente curioso e proattivo che gode di lavorare con i dati e risolvere problemi complessi. Si comunica chiaramente, prendere l'iniziativa, e sono confortevoli lavorare in un ambiente multiculturale e veloce. Siete desiderosi di imparare, aprire al feedback, e motivati a costruire una carriera in scienza attuariale o un campo quantitativo relativo.
Siamo alla ricerca di candidati che soddisfano questi requisiti:

• Attualmente studia scienza attuariale, matematica, statistica, scienza dei dati o altro campo quantitativo , con la laurea prevista nel secondo semestre del 2027 o successivo

• Avanzata competenza inglese — collaborerai regolarmente con team di diverse regioni e geografie

• Intermedio a competenze Excel avanzate , con la capacità di costruire e lavorare con modelli e modelli analitici
Questi sono ulteriori bello da avere:

• Competenze di lingua spagnola — auspicabile per l'impegno con gli stakeholder dell'America Latina, anche se non richiesto

• Conoscenza di VBA per automatizzare le attività e migliorare gli strumenti basati su Excel

• Competenze SQL per querying e gestione di grandi dataset

• Esperienza con R o Python per analisi statistiche e manipolazione dei dati

• Forte capacità di comunicazione — capacità di presentare i risultati chiaramente sia al pubblico tecnico che non tecnico

• Un autentico interesse per l'industria dell'assicurazione e della riassicurazione e l'entusiasmo per la costruzione di una carriera attuariale

La nostra azienda ha un modello di lavoro ibrido in cui l'aspettativa è che sarete in ufficio almeno tre giorni alla settimana.
Informazioni su Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione. Prevediamo e gestiamo i rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions è il braccio di assicurazione commerciale del Gruppo Swiss Re. Offriamo soluzioni di assicurazione innovative alle grandi e medie multinazionali dalle nostre circa 50 sedi in tutto il mondo. Aiutiamo i clienti a mitigare la loro esposizione al rischio, mentre il nostro servizio di reclami leader del settore fornisce loro una pace aggiuntiva della mente.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions abbraccia un luogo di lavoro in cui ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il proprio sé autentico al lavoro e alla loro passione per la sostenibilità.

Se sei un professionista esperto di ritorno alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.
Possiamo utilizzare strumenti basati su AI per supportare la revisione e la valutazione delle applicazioni per questa posizione. Questi strumenti forniscono ulteriori informazioni ai nostri team di reclutamento, ma tutte le decisioni di assunzione sono attentamente esaminate e fatte dalle persone. Per saperne di più su come utilizziamo l'IA nel reclutamento e come gestiamo i tuoi dati personali, si prega di rivedere la nostra Informativa sulla privacy dei dati prima di applicare.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you an actuarial university student eager to gain hands-on experience in the insurance world? This is your opportunity to dive into real actuarial work, sharpen your analytical skills, and contribute to meaningful projects that shape how we understand and manage risk across Latin America. If you are curious, driven, and ready to learn, we want to hear from you!

About the Role
As an Actuarial Portfolio Management Intern within Corporate Solutions, you will be embedded in a dynamic, collaborative environment where your contributions truly matter. From day one, you will support global pricing and portfolio management activities focused on Latin America, working alongside experienced actuaries and business partners. This is a unique chance to apply your academic knowledge to real-world challenges while building a strong foundation for your actuarial career.
Key Responsibilities

• Develop queries and reports to analyze data from our pricing tools, providing deeper insights into portfolio performance and monitoring changes over time

• Build analytical templates to assess the profitability of key portfolios and support our quarterly profitability review process

• Analyze external data for benchmarking purposes and to identify emerging trends that impact our business across Latin America

• Assist in updating parameters used in our actuarial tools and models to ensure accuracy and relevance of actuarial indications

• Contribute to actuarial projects as needed, gaining broad exposure to different areas of the actuarial function within a global reinsurance environment

About the Team
We are the Global Pricing and Portfolio Management team within the Underwriting Center at Corporate Solutions, dedicated to supporting Latin America business. Our team plays a critical role in delivering actuarial expertise across multiple lines of business, with core responsibilities spanning loss ratio projections, rating plan development, and parameter updates . We collaborate closely with partners across Underwriting, Product, Finance, Claims, Reserving, and Data Science — making us a central hub of analytical insight within the organization.

About You
You are an intellectually curious and proactive student who enjoys working with data and solving complex problems. You communicate clearly, take initiative, and are comfortable working in a multicultural, fast-paced environment. You are eager to learn, open to feedback, and motivated to build a career in actuarial science or a related quantitative field.
We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Currently studying Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, or another quantitative field , with graduation expected in the second semester of 2027 or later

• Advanced English proficiency — you will regularly collaborate with teams across different regions and geographies

• Intermediate to advanced Excel skills , with the ability to build and work with analytical models and templates
These are additional nice to haves:

• Spanish language skills — desirable for engagement with Latin America stakeholders, though not required

• Knowledge of VBA for automating tasks and enhancing Excel-based tools

• SQL skills for querying and managing large datasets

• Experience with R or Python for statistical analysis and data manipulation

• Strong communication skills — ability to present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

• A genuine interest in the insurance and reinsurance industry and enthusiasm for building an actuarial career

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.
About Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group. We offer innovative insurance solutions to large and midsized multinational corporations from our approximately 50 locations worldwide. We help clients mitigate their risk exposure, whilst our industry-leading claims service provides them with additional peace of mind.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions embraces a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Sind Sie ein versicherungsmathematischer Universitätsstudent, der praktische Erfahrungen in der Versicherungswelt sammeln möchte? Dies ist Ihre Gelegenheit, in echte versicherungsmathematische Arbeit einzutauchen, Ihre analytischen Fähigkeiten zu schärfen und zu sinnvollen Projekten beizutragen, die unser Verständnis und Management von Risiken in ganz Lateinamerika prägen. Wenn Sie neugierig, motiviert und bereit sind zu lernen, möchten wir von Ihnen hören!

Über die Rolle
Als versicherungsmathematischer Portfoliomanagement-Praktikant bei Corporate Solutions sind Sie in ein dynamisches, kollaboratives Umfeld eingebettet, in dem Ihre Beiträge wirklich wichtig sind. Vom ersten Tag an unterstützen Sie globale Preis- und Portfoliomanagementaktivitäten mit Schwerpunkt auf Lateinamerika und arbeiten mit erfahrenen Versicherungsmathematikern und Geschäftspartnern zusammen. Dies ist eine einzigartige Chance, Ihr akademisches Wissen auf reale Herausforderungen anzuwenden und gleichzeitig eine solide Grundlage für Ihre versicherungsmathematische Karriere zu schaffen.
Wichtigste Zuständigkeiten

• Entwicklung von Abfragen und Berichten zur Analyse von Daten aus unseren Preisgestaltungstools, die tiefere Einblicke in die Portfolioleistung und die Überwachung von Veränderungen im Laufe der Zeit bieten

• Erstellen Sie analytische Vorlagen zur Bewertung der Rentabilität wichtiger Portfolios und unterstützen Sie unseren vierteljährlichen Rentabilitätsprüfungsprozess

• Analysieren Sie externe Daten für Benchmarking-Zwecke und zur Identifizierung neuer Trends, die sich auf unser Geschäft in Lateinamerika auswirken

• Unterstützung bei der Aktualisierung der in unseren versicherungsmathematischen Werkzeugen und Modellen verwendeten Parameter, um die Genauigkeit und Relevanz versicherungsmathematischer Angaben sicherzustellen

• Bei Bedarf zu versicherungsmathematischen Projekten beitragen und ein breites Engagement in verschiedenen Bereichen der versicherungsmathematischen Funktion in einem globalen Rückversicherungsumfeld erlangen

Über das Team
Wir sind das Global Pricing and Portfolio Management Team im Underwriting Center von Corporate Solutions, das sich der Unterstützung des lateinamerikanischen Geschäfts widmet. Unser Team spielt eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Bereitstellung versicherungsmathematischer Expertise in mehreren Geschäftsbereichen, wobei die Kernverantwortung die Projektionen der Verlustquote, die Entwicklung von Ratingplänen und Parameteraktualisierungen umfasst. Wir arbeiten eng mit Partnern aus den Bereichen Underwriting, Product, Finance, Claims, Reserving und Data Science zusammen und sind damit ein zentraler Knotenpunkt für analytische Erkenntnisse innerhalb des Unternehmens.

Über dich
Sie sind ein intellektuell neugieriger und proaktiver Student, der gerne mit Daten arbeitet und komplexe Probleme löst. Sie kommunizieren klar, ergreifen Initiative und arbeiten in einer multikulturellen, schnelllebigen Umgebung. Sie sind bestrebt zu lernen, offen für Feedback und motiviert, eine Karriere in der Versicherungsmathematik oder einem verwandten quantitativen Bereich aufzubauen.
Wir suchen Kandidaten, die diese Anforderungen erfüllen:

• Derzeit studieren Aktuarwissenschaften, Mathematik, Statistik, Data Science oder ein anderes quantitatives Feld, wobei der Abschluss im zweiten Semester 2027 oder später erwartet wird

• Erweiterte Englischkenntnisse - Sie arbeiten regelmäßig mit Teams aus verschiedenen Regionen und Regionen zusammen

• Mittlere bis fortgeschrittene Excel-Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit zum Erstellen und Arbeiten mit analytischen Modellen und Vorlagen
Dies sind zusätzliche nett zu haben:

• Spanischkenntnisse - wünschenswert für das Engagement mit lateinamerikanischen Stakeholdern, obwohl nicht erforderlich

• Kenntnisse von VBA zur Automatisierung von Aufgaben und zur Verbesserung von Excel-basierten Tools

• SQL-Fähigkeiten zum Abfragen und Verwalten großer Datensätze

• Erfahrung mit R oder Python für statistische Analyse und Datenmanipulation

• Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten - Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse sowohl für technische als auch für nichttechnische Zielgruppen klar zu präsentieren

• Ein echtes Interesse an der Versicherungs- und Rückversicherungsbranche und Begeisterung für den Aufbau einer versicherungsmathematischen Karriere

Unser Unternehmen hat ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, bei dem erwartet wird, dass Sie mindestens drei Tage pro Woche im Büro sind.
Über Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen der versicherungsbasierten Risikoübertragung. Wir antizipieren und managen Risiken, von Naturkatastrophen und Klimawandel bis hin zu Cyberkriminalität.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions ist der gewerbliche Versicherungszweig der Swiss Re Gruppe. Wir bieten innovative Versicherungslösungen für große und mittlere multinationale Konzerne an unseren rund 50 Standorten weltweit. Wir helfen Kunden, ihre Risikoexposition zu mindern, während unser branchenführender Schadenservice ihnen zusätzliche Sicherheit bietet.

Unser Erfolg hängt von unserer Fähigkeit ab, eine integrative Kultur aufzubauen, die neue Perspektiven und innovatives Denken fördert. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions umfasst einen Arbeitsplatz, an dem jeder die gleichen Chancen hat, beruflich zu gedeihen und sich zu entwickeln, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Rasse, Ethnie, Geschlechtsidentität und / oder Ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, körperlicher oder geistiger Fähigkeiten, Fähigkeiten, Gedanken oder anderen Eigenschaften. In unserem integrativen und flexiblen Umfeld kann jeder sein authentisches Selbst und seine Leidenschaft für Nachhaltigkeit mitbringen.

Wenn Sie ein erfahrener Profi sind, der nach einer Berufspause in die Belegschaft zurückkehrt, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich für offene Stellen zu bewerben, die Ihren Fähigkeiten und Ihrer Erfahrung entsprechen.
Wir können KI-basierte Tools verwenden, um die Überprüfung und Bewertung von Anwendungen für diese Position zu unterstützen. Diese Tools bieten unseren Rekrutierungsteams zusätzliche Einblicke, aber alle Einstellungsentscheidungen werden sorgfältig überprüft und von Menschen getroffen. Um mehr darüber zu erfahren, wie wir KI bei der Rekrutierung einsetzen und wie wir mit Ihren personenbezogenen Daten umgehen, lesen Sie bitte unsere Datenschutzerklärung, bevor Sie sich bewerben.

Êtes-vous un étudiant universitaire actuariel désireux d'acquérir une expérience pratique dans le monde de l'assurance? C'est l'occasion pour vous de plonger dans de véritables travaux actuariels, d'affiner vos compétences analytiques et de contribuer à des projets significatifs qui façonnent notre façon de comprendre et de gérer le risque en Amérique latine. Si vous êtes curieux, motivé et prêt à apprendre, nous voulons vous entendre!

À propos du rôle
En tant que stagiaire en gestion de portefeuille actuariel au sein de Solutions corporatives, vous serez intégré dans un environnement dynamique et collaboratif où vos contributions comptent vraiment. Dès le premier jour, vous soutiendrez les activités mondiales de tarification et de gestion de portefeuille axées sur l'Amérique latine, en collaboration avec des actuaires expérimentés et des partenaires commerciaux. C'est une chance unique d'appliquer vos connaissances académiques aux défis réels tout en construisant une base solide pour votre carrière actuarielle.
Principales responsabilités

• Élaborer des demandes de renseignements et des rapports pour analyser les données de nos outils de tarification, en fournissant des renseignements plus détaillés sur le rendement du portefeuille et en surveillant les changements au fil du temps

• Élaborer des modèles analytiques pour évaluer la rentabilité des portefeuilles clés et soutenir notre processus d'examen trimestriel de la rentabilité

• Analyser les données externes à des fins d'étalonnage et identifier les tendances émergentes qui influent sur nos activités en Amérique latine

• Aider à mettre à jour les paramètres utilisés dans nos outils et modèles actuariels pour assurer l'exactitude et la pertinence des indications actuarielles

• Contribuer aux projets actuariels au besoin, en s'exposant largement à différents domaines de la fonction actuarielle dans un environnement mondial de réassurance

À propos de l'équipe
Nous sommes l'équipe Global Pricing and Portfolio Management au sein du Centre de souscription de Corporate Solutions, dédié au soutien des entreprises latino-américaines. Notre équipe joue un rôle essentiel dans la prestation de l'expertise actuarielle dans plusieurs secteurs d'activité, avec des responsabilités de base couvrant les projections du ratio de perte, l'élaboration de plans de cotation et les mises à jour des paramètres. Nous collaborons étroitement avec des partenaires de l'ensemble de l'organisation en matière de souscription, de produits, de finances, de revendications, de réserves et de science des données.

À propos de toi
Vous êtes un étudiant intellectuellement curieux et proactif qui aime travailler avec les données et résoudre des problèmes complexes. Vous communiquez clairement, prenez des initiatives et vous êtes à l'aise de travailler dans un environnement multiculturel et rapide. Vous êtes impatient d'apprendre, ouvert à la rétroaction et motivé à construire une carrière en science actuarielle ou dans un domaine quantitatif connexe.
Nous cherchons des candidats qui répondent à ces exigences :

• En cours d'études Actuarial Science, Mathématiques, Statistiques, Data Science, ou un autre domaine quantitatif, avec diplôme attendu au second semestre de 2027 ou plus

• Compétence avancée en anglais — vous collaborerez régulièrement avec des équipes de différentes régions et régions

• Compétences Excel intermédiaires à avancées, avec la capacité de construire et de travailler avec des modèles analytiques et des modèles
Ceux-ci sont supplémentaires agréables à avoir:

• Compétences linguistiques en espagnol — désirable pour l'engagement avec les parties prenantes de l'Amérique latine, mais non nécessaire

• Connaissance de l'ABV pour automatiser les tâches et améliorer les outils basés sur Excel

• Compétences SQL pour la requête et la gestion de gros ensembles de données

• Expérience avec R ou Python pour l'analyse statistique et la manipulation des données

• Forte capacité de communication — capacité de présenter clairement les résultats aux publics techniques et non techniques

• Un véritable intérêt pour l'industrie de l'assurance et de la réassurance et un enthousiasme pour construire une carrière actuarielle

Notre entreprise a un modèle de travail hybride où l'on s'attend à ce que vous soyez au bureau au moins trois jours par semaine.
À propos de Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
Suisse Re est l'un des principaux fournisseurs mondiaux de réassurance, d'assurance et d'autres formes de transfert de risque fondé sur l'assurance. Nous anticipons et gérons les risques, des catastrophes naturelles et du changement climatique à la cybercriminalité.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions est la branche assurance commerciale du Groupe Swiss Re. Nous offrons des solutions d'assurance innovantes aux grandes et moyennes multinationales de nos quelque 50 sites dans le monde. Nous aidons les clients à atténuer leur exposition aux risques, tandis que notre service de réclamations leader de l'industrie leur procure une tranquillité d'esprit supplémentaire.

Notre succès dépend de notre capacité à bâtir une culture inclusive qui encourage de nouvelles perspectives et des idées novatrices. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions englobe un lieu de travail où chacun a les mêmes chances de prospérer et de se développer professionnellement, indépendamment de son âge, de son sexe, de sa race, de son appartenance ethnique, de son identité et/ou de son expression, de son orientation sexuelle, de ses aptitudes physiques ou mentales, de ses compétences, de sa pensée ou de toute autre caractéristique. Dans notre environnement inclusif et flexible, chacun peut apporter son authentique soi au travail et sa passion pour la durabilité.

Si vous êtes un professionnel expérimenté qui revient au marché du travail après une interruption de carrière, nous vous encourageons à postuler à des postes ouverts qui correspondent à vos compétences et à votre expérience.
Nous pouvons utiliser des outils alimentés par l'IA pour appuyer l'examen et l'évaluation des demandes pour ce poste. Ces outils fournissent des renseignements supplémentaires à nos équipes de recrutement, mais toutes les décisions d'embauche sont soigneusement examinées et prises par les gens. Pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous utilisons l'IA dans le recrutement et comment nous traitons vos données personnelles, veuillez consulter notre Déclaration de confidentialité des données avant de postuler.

 Join our Life & Health Business Operations team and help deliver accurate, high-quality operational support across our global reinsurance business.  This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working with data, solving problems and collaborating with others in a supportive team environment.
 What you'll do

• Process premium, claims and accounting transactions accurately and within agreed service standards.

• Support cash management and financial accounting activities.

• Build positive relationships with clients and colleagues, responding to queries in a timely and professional manner.

• Monitor data quality and investigate discrepancies with support from the team.

• Follow established processes and controls to ensure accuracy and compliance.

• Contribute ideas to improve processes and ways of working.

• Work collaboratively with colleagues to achieve team objectives.

• Support operational projects and change initiatives where required.

 The Life & Health Business Operations team supports the administration of reinsurance business by processing client accounts, managing financial transactions and maintaining high-quality operational data. Working collaboratively across global teams, we help deliver excellent service to our clients and support Swiss Re's financial performance.

 You'll be someone who:

• Has excellent attention to detail and enjoys working with numbers and data.

• Can prioritise work and manage deadlines.

• Is confident communicating with colleagues and clients.

• Enjoys learning new systems and processes.

• Works well as part of a team and takes a proactive approach to problem solving.

• Is adaptable and keen to develop new skills.
 Skills & experience

Essential

• Experience in an administrative, operational, finance or customer service environment.

• Good analytical and organisational skills.

• Experience using Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
 Desirable

• Experience within insurance, financial services or reinsurance.

• Knowledge of accounting or financial processes.
 Compensation & Work Model

The salary for this position will be shared with you during the interview process.
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.

 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. jobs.description:
Are you a sharp, commercially minded legal professional with deep expertise in financial markets and collateral? This is your opportunity to take on a high-impact role at the heart of Swiss Re's Capital Markets Legal function — advising on complex, multi-jurisdictional matters and shaping the legal framework for one of the world's leading reinsurance groups.
 About the Role
 As Legal Counsel for Securities Finance and Collateral, you will be a trusted legal advisor embedded in a dynamic and internationally connected team. You will provide expert legal counsel to Swiss Re Group and its various Business Units, translating complex business requirements into clear legal processes and actionable guidance. This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of law, finance, and regulation — with real visibility at senior levels of the organisation.
 Key Responsibilities

• Manage day-to-day legal matters related to collateral trading and management, including the drafting and negotiation of master agreements for Securities Financing Transactions (SFTs), triparty collateral agreements, trade confirmations, security agreements, and bespoke collateral arrangements

• Advise on financial markets regulations , with a particular focus on the Swiss regulatory landscape, ensuring Swiss Re remains compliant with evolving legal and regulatory requirements

• Conduct legal and regulatory risk gap assessments and provide timely, well-reasoned legal opinions on operational and legal risks

• Draft and review legal policies and guidelines , ensuring they reflect current regulatory requirements and best practices

• Collaborate closely with Compliance, Credit Risk, Finance, and Asset Management stakeholders to deliver integrated, commercially sound legal solutions

• Engage with market associations such as ICMA and ISLA, representing Swiss Re's interests and staying ahead of industry developments

• Provide periodic updates to Senior Management, Internal Audit, and relevant Committees on legal developments and risk matters

• Coordinate with the governance team for regulatory filings and reporting obligations

• Escalate material issues appropriately to the Head of Global Collateral and the Head of Capital Markets, Finance – Legal

• Lead and support group-wide internal projects and contribute to broader Legal & Compliance initiatives

• Liaise and collaborate with peers across other branches of the legal department, fostering knowledge sharing and consistency

About the Team
 Based in Zurich, you will report to the Head of Capital Markets Finance Legal and join a team of seven talented legal professionals. The team is truly international in character, with members based across Zurich and London, bringing a rich diversity of qualifications, backgrounds, and legal expertise. The team operates in a collaborative and intellectually stimulating environment, advising on some of the most complex and high-profile matters within Swiss Re's legal function. You will have regular interactions with the General Counsel Corporate Center & Group Functions, the Group Treasurer, the Head of Risk & Short-Term Funding, and Swiss Re Senior Management.
 About You
 You are a confident, intellectually curious legal professional who thrives in a fast-paced, international environment. You bring sound legal judgement that goes beyond the letter of the law — you understand the business context, communicate complex concepts with clarity, and build trusted relationships across all levels of an organisation. You are open, collaborative, and willing to share your knowledge and perspective, while remaining receptive to challenge and committed to continuous learning.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Law degree with honours and admission to practice , with a Swiss legal qualification required ; an additional US or UK qualification is strongly preferred

• Minimum 8 years of significant international legal experience in securities lending, repo, and ideally derivatives businesses, gained at a renowned financial services institution and/or a top-tier law firm

• Strong experience in complex, multi-jurisdictional legal matters , with demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality legal advice under pressure

• Fluency in English and German (written and spoken), enabling effective communication with internal and external stakeholders across jurisdictions

• Proven expertise in drafting and negotiating financial market agreements, including GMRA, GMSLA, CSA, and related documentation

These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience interacting with or representing organisations at market associations such as ICMA or ISLA

• Familiarity with Swiss Re's business model or the broader reinsurance/insurance industry

• Experience advising on regulatory filings and liaising with financial regulators

• Demonstrated ability to lead internal legal projects and drive cross-functional initiatives

• Strong influencing and stakeholder management skills, with experience presenting to senior leadership and governance committees

• A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with a measured appetite for risk and a track record of delivering workable outcomes

• Professional references available upon request

For Switzerland, the base salary range for this position is between CHF 132 000 and CHF 198 000 for a full-time role.
 The specific salary offered considers:

• The requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role

• The applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience

In the situation where you do not meet all the requirements or you significantly exceed these, the offered salary may be below or above the advertised range. In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based annual bonus.
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. Sei un professionista legale affilato e commercialmente con profonda esperienza nei mercati finanziari e collaterali? Questa è la vostra occasione per assumere un ruolo di alto impatto nel cuore della funzione legale dei mercati di capitale della Svizzera – consigliando su questioni complesse e multi-giurisdizionali e plasmando il quadro giuridico per uno dei principali gruppi di riassicurazione del mondo.
Informazioni sul ruolo
In qualità di Consigliere Legale per Securities Finance e Collateral, sarai un consulente legale di fiducia incorporato in un team dinamico e connesso a livello internazionale. Fornirai un consulente legale esperto presso Swiss Re Group e le sue varie Business Unit, traducendo i requisiti aziendali complessi in processi legali chiari e di orientamento. Questo ruolo offre l'opportunità di lavorare all'intersezione di legge, finanza e regolamentazione - con visibilità reale a livelli più alti dell'organizzazione.
Principali responsabilità

• Gestire le questioni legali quotidiane relative al trading collaterale e alla gestione, tra cui la redazione e la negoziazione di accordi master per le transazioni di finanziamento (SFT), accordi collaterali triparti, conferme commerciali, accordi di sicurezza e accordi collaterali su misura

• Consigliare la normativa sui mercati finanziari, con particolare attenzione al panorama normativo svizzero, assicurando che Swiss Re rimanga conforme ai requisiti normativi e regolamentari in evoluzione

• Condurre valutazioni legali e regolamentari del gap di rischio e fornire opinioni legali tempestive e ben risolte sui rischi operativi e legali

• Redazione e revisione delle politiche e delle linee guida legali, assicurando loro di riflettere i requisiti normativi attuali e le best practice

• Collabora a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder Compliance, Credit Risk, Finance e Asset Management per fornire soluzioni legali integrate e commercialmente solide

• Impegnarsi con associazioni di mercato come ICMA e ISLA, che rappresentano gli interessi di Swiss Re e che stanno davanti agli sviluppi del settore

• Fornire aggiornamenti periodici a Gestione Senior, Audit Interna e comitati pertinenti per gli sviluppi legali e le questioni di rischio

• Coordinate con il team di governance per i processi normativi e gli obblighi di reporting

• Escalate i problemi materiali in modo appropriato al Capo del Collaterale Globale e al Capo dei Mercati Capitali, Finanza – Legale

• Guidare e sostenere progetti interni a livello di gruppo e contribuire a iniziative legali e di conformità più ampie

• Liaise e collabora con i colleghi di altri rami del dipartimento legale, promuovendo la condivisione e la coerenza della conoscenza

Informazioni sulla squadra
Con sede a Zurigo, si riferirà al capo dei mercati finanziari legali e unire un team di sette professionisti legali di talento. Il team è veramente internazionale, con membri con sede a Zurigo e Londra, portando una ricca varietà di qualifiche, sfondi e competenze legali. Il team opera in un ambiente collaborativo e stimolante intellettualmente, consigliando alcune delle questioni più complesse e di alto profilo all'interno della funzione legale di Swiss Re. Avrai interazioni regolari con il General Counsel Corporate Center & Group Functions, il Group Treasurer, il Head of Risk & Short-Term Funding e la Swiss Re Senior Management.
A proposito di te
Sei un professionista legale sicuro e intellettualmente curioso che prospera in un ambiente internazionale frenetico. Porti un giudizio legale sano che va oltre la lettera della legge - capisci il contesto aziendale, comunichi concetti complessi con chiarezza e costruisci relazioni fidate su tutti i livelli di un'organizzazione. Sei aperto, collaborativo e disposto a condividere le tue conoscenze e le tue prospettive, pur rimanendo ricettivo per sfidare e impegnarti nell'apprendimento continuo.
Siamo alla ricerca di candidati che soddisfano questi requisiti:

• Grado di diritto con lode e ammissione alla pratica , con una qualifica giuridica svizzera richiesta; una qualifica aggiuntiva negli Stati Uniti o nel Regno Unito è fortemente preferita

• Minimo 8 anni di significativa esperienza legale internazionale nelle imprese di prestito, repo e derivati idealmente, acquisite in un rinomato istituto di servizi finanziari e/o uno studio legale di alto livello

• Una forte esperienza in questioni giuridiche complesse e multigiurisdizionali, con dimostrata capacità di gestire le priorità concorrenti e fornire consulenza legale di alta qualità sotto pressione

• Fluency in inglese e tedesco (scritto e parlato), consentendo una comunicazione efficace con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni attraverso le giurisdizioni

• Competenza per la redazione e la negoziazione di accordi di mercato finanziario, tra cui GMRA, GMSLA, CSA e relativa documentazione

Questi sono ulteriori bello da avere:

• Esperienza che interagisce con o che rappresenta organizzazioni presso associazioni di mercato come ICMA o ISLA

• Familiarità con il modello di business della Swiss Re o il più ampio settore di riassicurazione/assicurazione

• Esperienza di consulenza sui sistemi di regolamentazione e di lealizzazione con i regolatori finanziari

• Capacità dimostrata di condurre progetti legali interni e guidare iniziative interfunzionali

• Forte influenza e competenze di gestione degli stakeholder, con esperienza che presenta ai comitati di leadership e governance senior

• Una mentalità proattiva e orientata alle soluzioni con un appetito misurato per il rischio e un track record di risultati lavorabili

• Riferimenti professionali disponibili su richiesta

Per la Svizzera, la fascia salariale di base per questa posizione è compresa tra CHF 132 000 e CHF 198 000 per un ruolo a tempo pieno.
Lo stipendio specifico offerto considera:

• I requisiti, la portata, la complessità e le responsabilità del ruolo

• Il proprio profilo del richiedente, tra cui istruzione/qualifica, competenza, specializzazione, competenze ed esperienza

Nella situazione in cui non si soddisfano tutti i requisiti o si superano significativamente questi, lo stipendio offerto può essere inferiore o superiore alla gamma pubblicizzata. Oltre al tuo stipendio base, potresti essere idoneo per ulteriori ricompense e benefici, tra cui un attraente bonus annuale basato sulle prestazioni.
La nostra azienda ha un modello di lavoro ibrido in cui l'aspettativa è che sarete in ufficio almeno tre giorni alla settimana.
Informazioni su Swiss Re
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione, lavorando per rendere il mondo più resiliente. Aspettiamo e gestiamo una vasta gamma di rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine. Combinando l'esperienza con il pensiero creativo e l'esperienza all'avanguardia, creiamo nuove opportunità e soluzioni per i nostri clienti. Questo è possibile grazie alla collaborazione di oltre 15.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Abbracciamo un posto di lavoro dove ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il proprio sé autentico a lavorare e la loro passione per la sostenibilità.

Se sei un professionista esperto che torna alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.
Possiamo utilizzare strumenti basati su AI per supportare la revisione e la valutazione delle applicazioni per questa posizione. Questi strumenti forniscono ulteriori informazioni ai nostri team di reclutamento, ma tutte le decisioni di assunzione sono attentamente esaminate e fatte dalle persone. Per saperne di più su come utilizziamo l'IA nel reclutamento e come gestiamo i tuoi dati personali, si prega di rivedere la nostra Informativa sulla privacy dei dati prima di applicare.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you a sharp, commercially minded legal professional with deep expertise in financial markets and collateral? This is your opportunity to take on a high-impact role at the heart of Swiss Re's Capital Markets Legal function — advising on complex, multi-jurisdictional matters and shaping the legal framework for one of the world's leading reinsurance groups.
About the Role
As Legal Counsel for Securities Finance and Collateral, you will be a trusted legal advisor embedded in a dynamic and internationally connected team. You will provide expert legal counsel to Swiss Re Group and its various Business Units, translating complex business requirements into clear legal processes and actionable guidance. This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of law, finance, and regulation — with real visibility at senior levels of the organisation.
Key Responsibilities

• Manage day-to-day legal matters related to collateral trading and management, including the drafting and negotiation of master agreements for Securities Financing Transactions (SFTs), triparty collateral agreements, trade confirmations, security agreements, and bespoke collateral arrangements

• Advise on financial markets regulations , with a particular focus on the Swiss regulatory landscape, ensuring Swiss Re remains compliant with evolving legal and regulatory requirements

• Conduct legal and regulatory risk gap assessments and provide timely, well-reasoned legal opinions on operational and legal risks

• Draft and review legal policies and guidelines , ensuring they reflect current regulatory requirements and best practices

• Collaborate closely with Compliance, Credit Risk, Finance, and Asset Management stakeholders to deliver integrated, commercially sound legal solutions

• Engage with market associations such as ICMA and ISLA, representing Swiss Re's interests and staying ahead of industry developments

• Provide periodic updates to Senior Management, Internal Audit, and relevant Committees on legal developments and risk matters

• Coordinate with the governance team for regulatory filings and reporting obligations

• Escalate material issues appropriately to the Head of Global Collateral and the Head of Capital Markets, Finance – Legal

• Lead and support group-wide internal projects and contribute to broader Legal & Compliance initiatives

• Liaise and collaborate with peers across other branches of the legal department, fostering knowledge sharing and consistency

About the Team
Based in Zurich, you will report to the Head of Capital Markets Finance Legal and join a team of seven talented legal professionals. The team is truly international in character, with members based across Zurich and London, bringing a rich diversity of qualifications, backgrounds, and legal expertise. The team operates in a collaborative and intellectually stimulating environment, advising on some of the most complex and high-profile matters within Swiss Re's legal function. You will have regular interactions with the General Counsel Corporate Center & Group Functions, the Group Treasurer, the Head of Risk & Short-Term Funding, and Swiss Re Senior Management.
About You
You are a confident, intellectually curious legal professional who thrives in a fast-paced, international environment. You bring sound legal judgement that goes beyond the letter of the law — you understand the business context, communicate complex concepts with clarity, and build trusted relationships across all levels of an organisation. You are open, collaborative, and willing to share your knowledge and perspective, while remaining receptive to challenge and committed to continuous learning.
We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Law degree with honours and admission to practice , with a Swiss legal qualification required ; an additional US or UK qualification is strongly preferred

• Minimum 8 years of significant international legal experience in securities lending, repo, and ideally derivatives businesses, gained at a renowned financial services institution and/or a top-tier law firm

• Strong experience in complex, multi-jurisdictional legal matters , with demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality legal advice under pressure

• Fluency in English and German (written and spoken), enabling effective communication with internal and external stakeholders across jurisdictions

• Proven expertise in drafting and negotiating financial market agreements, including GMRA, GMSLA, CSA, and related documentation

These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience interacting with or representing organisations at market associations such as ICMA or ISLA

• Familiarity with Swiss Re's business model or the broader reinsurance/insurance industry

• Experience advising on regulatory filings and liaising with financial regulators

• Demonstrated ability to lead internal legal projects and drive cross-functional initiatives

• Strong influencing and stakeholder management skills, with experience presenting to senior leadership and governance committees

• A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with a measured appetite for risk and a track record of delivering workable outcomes

• Professional references available upon request

For Switzerland, the base salary range for this position is between CHF 132 000 and CHF 198 000 for a full-time role.
The specific salary offered considers:

• The requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role

• The applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience

In the situation where you do not meet all the requirements or you significantly exceed these, the offered salary may be below or above the advertised range. In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based annual bonus.
Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.
About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.
