Locations:
Schaumburg, IL, US |
Windsor, CT, US

Location: Open to Windsor, CT - or - Schaumburg, IL
 Accident & Health Underwriting Experience required.
 About the Team:
 As part of the Corporate Solutions (CorSo), North America, Accident & Health Team, you will join a team of experienced underwriters, focused on profit-oriented underwriting for Employer Stop loss coverage of self-funded employer health plans. Our Underwriters analyze claims experience, loss ratio, and other group-specific data to evaluate risk and develop optimal coverage solutions for our clients. We collaborate with the sales team, assigned client groups, and underwriting management to generate proposals, resolve account management issues, and service customers.
 About the Role:
 Underwriting:

• Production underwriter responsible for handling review of policies and procedures for both new and existing risks for self-funded employer health plans Accounts vary from Middle/Upper Middle Market, as well as Fortune 500 businesses.

• Understand and apply commercial insurance principles to complex situations

• Understand and apply data analytics to ensure we are adequately pricing for the risk under consideration

• Consistently demonstrate adherence to authority limits and underwriting controls to effectively manage exposure

• Able to demonstrate an in-depth understanding of both standard and non-standard policy wordings, extensions and limitations. Able to identify when to alter policy terms and the resulting impact

• Understand the drivers of performance within the portfolio and provide recommended steering actions that positively influence outcomes
 Customer Focus:

• Manage the definition, development and delivery of Accident & Health insurance products to ensure alignment with customer needs

• Accurately spot trends in early stages and collaborate to improve product offerings and financial results

• Review and challenge market/customer strategies, applying in-depth market understanding and innovative views

• Inspire a sense of urgency from the customer/ broker and CorSo decision makers to design win-win situations

• Consistently demonstrate effective influencing and negotiation skills to deliver the best outcomes for CorSo
 Team/Relationship Focus:

• Develop and maintain successful relationships with external clients and brokers

• Focus on building relationships across the team and wider organization. Actively work to support the end to end journey

• Coach and mentor less experienced Underwriters

• Inspire colleagues to embrace the mandate of their business areas in achieving Corporate Solutions’ strategy

• Lead internal (technical/organizational) and/or provide technical expertise for external (market/client development) projects and marketing efforts

• Support the business in developing appropriate analytical processes and outputs

• Prioritize new ways of working. Effectively deliver change, considering the full implementation impacts on end-to-end processes and learning from past projects. Recommend measures to reduce the impact of the market/underwriting cycle

About You:
 Educational/Professional:

• Bachelor’s degree in a related field (Finance, Actuarial Science) preferred or equivalent experience

• Minimum 5 years underwriting experience in Accident & Health

• In depth knowledge of insurance, with a focus on commercial Accident & Health underwriting

• Strong connection within the Employer Stop Loss insurance market

• Experience in producing a profitable portfolio of business within your underwriting authority

• Strong analytical skills to assess exposures, coverages, terms and conditions to appropriately assign underwriting decision on risks

• Knowledge and proficiency in the use of underwriting tools, applications, guidelines, and data analytics

• Keeps abreast of market environment and trends
 Values, Abilities, and Skills:

• Strong oral/written communications skills that focus on building relationships across the team, wider organization, and with clients

• Encourage collaboration in support of the end-to-end journey

• Strong negotiation, analytical skills, ability to multi-task with attention to details

• Prioritize new ways of working. Effectively deliver change, considering the full implementation impacts on end-to-end processes and learning from past projects

• Role-models continuous self-learning. Adept at learning and highly motivated to new skills to novel situations, gaining knowledge and expertise

• Constantly looking for the best option, identifying positives and negatives, to make effective decisions in complex and novel situations. Take accountability and support the team to ensure decision making happens at the right level

• Consistently demonstrate personal accountability for decisions, success and failures, challenges the status quo.

• Ideal candidates will distinguish themselves across multiple elements of Swiss Re's Leadership Model (thinks strategically, innovates, responds actively, collaborates, promotes excellence, stays accessible, fosters constructive debate, demonstrates an enterprise mindset, values diversity).
 Miscellaneous:

• Demonstrated proficiency of the English language. Spanish/French a plus

• Travel will be approximately 5% within the US

• Preferred locations are Windsor, CT or Schaumburg, IL. but open for the right candidate

• No relocation assistance will be offered
 For roles located within our Swiss Re offices, our company has a hybrid work model where the expectations is that you will be in the office three days per week on average.
 The estimated base salary range for the Senior Underwriter level in Windsor CT or Schaumburg IL is $128,000 to $192,000. The specific salary offered for this or any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short-and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.
 About Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group. We offer innovative insurance solutions to large and midsized multinational corporations from our approximately 50 locations worldwide. We help clients mitigate their risk exposure, whilst our industry-leading claims service provides them with additional peace of mind.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions embraces a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

Swiss Re is an equal opportunity employer. It is our practice to recruit, hire and promote without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, pregnancy, sexual orientations, marital status, military status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Decisions on employment are solely based on an individual's qualifications for the position being filled.

During the recruitment process, reasonable accommodations for disabilities are available upon request. If contacted for an interview, please inform the Recruiter/HR Professional of the accommodation needed.

We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Join a dynamic and innovative Data Analytics & GenAI Property & Casualty Reinsurance team. Our mission is to harness the power of Data Analytics and Generative AI to create a competitive advantage for our business. By generating actionable insights, we aim to enhance data-driven decision-making and improve business outcomes.

About the Role

As an AI Solution Engineer, you'll contribute the development of AI solutions from concept to production. You'll blend technical expertise with product management skills to deliver user-centric AI applications that solve real business problems. This role offers a unique opportunity to drive innovation while ensuring technical excellence.

For example, you will:

Key responsibilities

• Own and drive AI product development from initial concept through to production deployment and continuous improvement

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical specifications and actionable plans

• Design and develop user-centric AI applications using Python/PySpark, emphasizing exceptional user experience and compelling data storytelling

• Drive and shape data & AI products from business value concepts to production.

• Stay up to date with the latest GenAI technologies and best practices to drive sustainable and efficient data products.

About you

To be successful in the role, you have:

• 2+ years of experience building and deploying AI/ML solutions in production environments

• Strong proficiency in Python and experience with data processing frameworks like PySpark

• Experience in product ownership or product management for technical products

• Demonstrated ability to build data-driven applications with a user-focused mindset and storytelling with data

• Independent self-learner that can navigate ambiguity

• Good fluent communication in English

If you also have the following experience and interests, it is a huge plus:

• Knowledge of Azure, Microsoft Power BI and Typescript

• Project management abilities within agile frameworks

• Experience with Machine Learning and familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs)

For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between EUR 2,400 and EUR 4,100 per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:​

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role, ​

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.​
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.​
 Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.

Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. jobs.description:
Location: Bangalore

Senior Digital Risk Advisor

Join a team of digital risk governance professionals and help drive the evolution of Swiss Re’s Digital Governance Framework (DGF), the central process governing the review and assessment of digital and technology initiatives across the organisation. In this role, you will work with cross-functional stakeholders to evolve framework processes and workflows while supporting strategic governance initiatives across Swiss Re.

About the team

The Digital Risk Governance & Control team is a cornerstone of Swiss Re's resilience strategy. We are dedicated to managing risks related to digital initiatives, ensuring they are properly identified, assessed, and controlled. As owners of the Digital Governance Framework (DGF), we are responsible for shaping and advancing the governance of digital and technology initiatives across Swiss Re. The DGF integrates multiple governance, risk, and control functions into a unified framework and workflow, enabling cross-functional collaboration, governance transparency, and risk-informed decision-making across digital initiatives.

In your role, you will…

• Drive the evolution of the Digital Governance Framework (DGF) by improving governance models, processes, and workflows.

• Design scalable and pragmatic governance solutions that support effective and risk-informed decision-making.

• Identify process inefficiencies, challenge existing approaches, and lead governance and workflow improvements.

• Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to align governance requirements, priorities, and implementation approaches.

• Facilitate governance discussions and drive alignment across technology, risk, security, architecture, and business teams.

• Develop and maintain governance standards, procedures, and audit-ready documentation.

• Prepare executive-level reporting, presentations, and strategic governance materials for senior leadership.

• Translate complex governance and technology topics into clear and actionable communication for diverse audiences.

• Support organisational adoption and awareness of governance practices through stakeholder engagement and internal communications.

What we need from you

• 10+ years of work experience in digital governance, technology risk, governance transformation, process improvement, consulting, operating model design, or related areas.

• Demonstrated experience improving or redesigning governance frameworks, operating models, or cross-functional initiatives within complex technology environments.

• Strong conceptual and analytical thinking skills, with the ability to simplify complexity, connect ideas across domains, and challenge existing approaches.

• Experience driving cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholder groups with competing priorities and perspectives.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, including experience preparing high-quality executive presentations and governance reporting for senior leadership forums.

• Strong facilitation and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to influence discussions, navigate ambiguity, and build alignment across functions.

• Experience preparing structured governance documentation, operating procedures, standards, or audit-ready process artefacts.

• Ability to translate abstract governance and risk concepts into practical, implementable processes and workflows.

• A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, Business Technology, or a related IT field.

Nice-to-have

• Additional certifications in information security, governance, or risk management (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CRISC).

jobs.description:
About the role:
 As a Valuation Risk Analyst within the Financial Model and Valuation Risk Management (FM&VRM) function, you will be a key player in ensuring that Swiss Re's asset valuations are accurate, compliant, and reflective of real market conditions. You will contribute to the Independent Price Verification (IPV) process that sits at the intersection of finance, risk, and trading. Your work will be seen and valued by senior leadership across the organization.
 Key Responsibilites:
 • Work with a multi-location team on valuation risk assessment covering various asset classes including fixed income, equity, insurance-linked derivatives, etc.
 • Perform Independent Price Verification on various cash products like government bonds, corporate bonds, mortgage-backed securities, and financial derivatives like interest rate swaps, swaptions, caps and floors
 • Identify and analyse how changes in the market, inputs or methodologies can lead to uncertainties in valuations.
 • Valuation risk assessment require good understanding of valuation drivers and methods.
 • Work with large data sets using MS Excel.
 • Produce valuation risk analysis reports on monthly basis to communicate the results to senior management.
 About the team:
 The Financial Model and Valuation Risk Management (FM&VRM) team primarily assess model risks and valuation risks. The core mission of Valuation Risk Management (VRM) is to ensure that valuations reflected in financial statements are in line with accounting requirements and industry best practice. Inaccurate valuations distort the decision-making process, and so performing controls ensuring appropriate valuations are reported are an essential part of the firm's operations. To ensure the firm is utilizing appropriate valuations, we developed an Independent Price Verification (IPV) process that formally assesses the quality of our valuations and acts to correct any issues. Valuation feed into our accounts, are at the core of P/L, determine the calibration of models, and form a key part of risk assessment.
 About you:
 • 2-5 years of experience in valuations/product control/quant finance/market risk. The ideal candidate would have experience with the independent price verification (IPV) process to determine whether assets are valued correctly and determine whether valuation adjustments are required for external financial reporting.
 • Strong academic background, preferably an undergraduate or master's degree in a quantitative discipline.
 • CQF/CFA/FRM will be a plus
 • Strong communication skills are required as reporting and presenting analysis is a core part of the job.
 • Good organisational skills, ability to meet tight deadlines.
 • Possess proactive attitude and willingness to apply general technical knowledge to new situations.
 • Exposure to any programming environment is a plus.

As a Valuation Risk Analyst within the Financial Model and Valuation Risk Management (FM&VRM) function, you will be a key player in ensuring that Swiss Re's asset valuations are accurate, compliant, and reflective of real market conditions. You will contribute to the Independent Price Verification (IPV) process that sits at the intersection of finance, risk, and trading. Your work will be seen and valued by senior leadership across the organization.
Key Responsibilites:

• Perform Independent Price Verification on various cash products like government bonds, corporate bonds, mortgage-backed securities, and financial derivatives like interest rate swaps, swaptions, caps and floors
• Identify and analyse how changes in the market, inputs or methodologies can lead to uncertainties in valuations.

• Work with large data sets using MS Excel.

To ensure the firm is utilizing appropriate valuations, we developed an Independent Price Verification (IPV) process that formally assesses the quality of our valuations and acts to correct any issues. Valuation feed into our accounts, are at the core of P/L, determine the calibration of models, and form a key part of risk assessment.

Als Valuation Risk Analyst innerhalb der Funktion Financial Model and Valuation Risk Management (FM&VRM) sind Sie ein wichtiger Akteur, um sicherzustellen, dass die Asset-Bewertungen von Swiss Re korrekt, konform und den realen Marktbedingungen entsprechen. Sie werden zum Independent Price Verification (IPV) Prozess beitragen, der an der Schnittstelle von Finanzen, Risiko und Handel liegt. Ihre Arbeit wird von leitenden Führungskräften in der gesamten Organisation gesehen und geschätzt.
Wichtigste Aufgaben:
• Arbeiten Sie mit einem Team mit mehreren Standorten an der Bewertungsrisikobewertung, die verschiedene Anlageklassen umfasst, darunter Fixed Income, Equity, Versicherungsderivate usw.
• Führen Sie eine unabhängige Preisüberprüfung für verschiedene Bargeldprodukte wie Staatsanleihen, Unternehmensanleihen, hypothekarisch gesicherte Wertpapiere und Finanzderivate wie Zinsswaps, Swaptions, Caps und Floors durch
• Identifizieren und analysieren Sie, wie Veränderungen des Marktes, der Inputs oder der Methoden zu Unsicherheiten bei Bewertungen führen können.
• Die Bewertungsrisikobewertung erfordert ein gutes Verständnis der Bewertungstreiber und -methoden.
• Arbeiten Sie mit großen Datensätzen mit MS Excel.
• Erstellen Sie monatlich Bewertungsrisikoanalyseberichte, um die Ergebnisse der Geschäftsleitung mitzuteilen.
Über das Team:
Das Financial Model and Valuation Risk Management (FM&VRM) Team bewertet in erster Linie Modellrisiken und Bewertungsrisiken. Die Hauptaufgabe von Valuation Risk Management (VRM) besteht darin, sicherzustellen, dass die in den Abschlüssen enthaltenen Bewertungen den Rechnungslegungsanforderungen und den Best Practices der Branche entsprechen. Ungenaue Bewertungen verzerren den Entscheidungsprozess, so dass die Durchführung von Kontrollen, die sicherstellen, dass angemessene Bewertungen gemeldet werden, ein wesentlicher Bestandteil der Geschäftstätigkeit des Unternehmens sind. Um sicherzustellen, dass das Unternehmen angemessene Bewertungen verwendet, haben wir einen unabhängigen Preisüberprüfungsprozess (IPV) entwickelt, der die Qualität unserer Bewertungen formell bewertet und Maßnahmen zur Korrektur von Problemen ergreift. Bewertung Feed in unsere Konten, sind im Kern der P / L, bestimmen die Kalibrierung von Modellen und bilden einen wichtigen Teil der Risikobewertung.
Über dich:
• 2-5 Jahre Erfahrung in Bewertungen/Produktkontrolle/Quant Finance/Marktrisiko. Der ideale Kandidat hätte Erfahrung mit dem unabhängigen Preisüberprüfungsprozess (IPV), um festzustellen, ob Vermögenswerte richtig bewertet werden und ob Bewertungsanpassungen für die externe Finanzberichterstattung erforderlich sind.
• Starker akademischer Hintergrund, vorzugsweise ein Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in einer quantitativen Disziplin.
• CQF / CFA / FRM wird ein Plus sein
• Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sind erforderlich, da die Berichterstattung und Präsentation von Analysen ein zentraler Bestandteil der Arbeit ist.
• Gute organisatorische Fähigkeiten, Fähigkeit, enge Fristen einzuhalten.

• Die Exposition gegenüber jeder Programmierumgebung ist ein Plus.

Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen des versicherungsbasierten Risikotransfers und arbeitet daran, die Welt widerstandsfähiger zu machen. En tant qu'analyste des risques liés à l'évaluation dans le cadre de la fonction Gestion des risques liés au modèle financier et à l'évaluation (FM&VRM), vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l'évaluation des actifs de Swiss Re. Vous contribuerez au processus de vérification des prix indépendants (VPI) qui se trouve à l'intersection de la finance, du risque et du trading. Votre travail sera vu et apprécié par les cadres supérieurs de l'organisation.
Principales responsabilités :
• Collaborer avec une équipe multilocalisée à l'évaluation du risque d'évaluation couvrant diverses catégories d'actifs, y compris le revenu fixe, les capitaux propres, les produits dérivés liés à l'assurance, etc.
• Effectuer une vérification indépendante des prix sur divers produits de trésorerie comme les obligations d'État, les obligations de sociétés, les titres adossés à des prêts hypothécaires et les produits financiers dérivés comme les swaps de taux d'intérêt, les swaps, les plafonds et les planchers
• Identifier et analyser comment les changements sur le marché, les intrants ou les méthodologies peuvent conduire à des incertitudes dans les évaluations.
• L'évaluation des risques d'évaluation exige une bonne compréhension des facteurs et des méthodes d'évaluation.
• Travailler avec de gros ensembles de données en utilisant MS Excel.
• Produire des rapports mensuels d'analyse du risque d'évaluation pour communiquer les résultats à la haute direction.
À propos de l'équipe :
L'équipe du modèle financier et de la gestion des risques liés à l'évaluation évalue principalement les risques liés au modèle et à l'évaluation. La mission principale de la gestion des risques d'évaluation (GRV) est de veiller à ce que les évaluations figurant dans les états financiers soient conformes aux exigences comptables et aux meilleures pratiques de l'industrie. Les évaluations inexactes faussent le processus de prise de décision, et l'exécution de contrôles garantissant que les évaluations appropriées sont déclarées est un élément essentiel des activités de l'entreprise. L'alimentation en évaluation dans nos comptes, sont au cœur de P/L, déterminent l'étalonnage des modèles et constituent une partie essentielle de l'évaluation des risques.

• 2 à 5 ans d'expérience en évaluation/contrôle des produits/financement quantitatif/risque de marché. Le candidat idéal aurait l'expérience du processus de vérification indépendante des prix (VPI) pour déterminer si les actifs sont évalués correctement et si des ajustements d'évaluation sont nécessaires pour l'établissement de rapports financiers externes.

Notre succès dépend de notre capacité à bâtir une culture inclusive favorisant de nouvelles perspectives et une pensée novatrice. About the Team and our Scope

At L&H Claims Solutions, we build and commercialize cloud-native SaaS offerings for Swiss Re Life & Health insurance clients. We offer a portfolio of about three products, in the L&H claims domain offered to clients worldwide. We are a software house within Swiss Re.

Our team consists of more than 50+ technical professionals with multidisciplinary skills, located in multiple countries, working on these multi-regional, highly available software solutions.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Solution Architect to lead the design and development of scalable, secure, and high-performance enterprise solutions.

You will work closely with product leaders, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to build secure, high-performance applications based on modern architectural principles.

You should have deep expertise in modern Java-based service-based architectures, full-stack development, and cloud-native design, with a strong emphasis on Microsoft Azure and enterprise-scale solution development.

Your responsibilities will be:

• Define and evolve application architecture aligned with enterprise standards like scalability, maintainability and cost effectiveness.

• Design mission critical solutions using 12-factor App development principles with Spring and Spring Boot

• Design and develop secure authentication (e.g., Okta, Azure AD) and robust authorization mechanisms

• Design and document scalable cloud-native infrastructure on Microsoft Azure

• Establish and enforce coding standards, design patterns, and architecture best practices

• Evaluate and integrate third-party solutions, open-source tools, and cloud-managed services

• Translate complex business requirements into scalable and maintainable solution designs

• Lead and mentor engineering teams on architecture, design, coding, and deployment

• Perform architecture and code reviews to ensure adherence to quality and security standards

• Collaborate with DevOps teams to streamline CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes

• Oversee vulnerability assessments , open-source license usage , and secure coding practices

• Ensure compliance with governance, data privacy, and industry regulations

About You

If you possess traits and experience that match most of the below, we’d love to hear from you:

• Overall 12+ years' hands on experience in java/J2EE based enterprise software

• 5+ years' experience in application/solution architecture roles with hands-on involvement

• Experience in agile environments.

• Proactive and Collaborative , with a strong sense of ownership and a willingness to go the extra mile to deliver quality solutions.

• Top notch team player with the ambition and skill to bring the entire team to the next level.

Must have excellent technical proficiency in…

• Technical leadership capable of designing, motivating and driving a vision

• Technical coaching willing of inspiring, coaching and driving technical colleagues

• Expert-level proficiency in Java/J2EE, Spring Framework, Spring Boot, Spring Security

• Extensive experience designing and building scalable architectures and solutions

• Experience with authentication and authorization using Okta , Azure AD , and OAuth2/OpenID Connect

• Proficient in REST APIs, Multithreading, Hibernate ORM/JPA , SQL, RDBMS (PostgreSQL, MS SQL)

• Strong integration experience ( REST, SOAP, ESB, Kafka, RabbitMQ )

• Experience using IDEs such as IntelliJ IDEA

• Experience in SaaS product development and multi-tenant architecture

• Solid grasp of secure coding standards , governance frameworks, and regulatory and compliance practices

• Knowledge of profiling and debugging tools like JMeter, App Insights

Preferable knowledge also about…

• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure Cloud (including services like AKS, Key Vault, Storage Accounts, etc.)

• Knowledge of containerization and orchestration tools – Docker, Kubernetes (AKS)

• Expertise in CI/CD and Maven/Gradle

• Bonus: Familiarity with UML and tools like Enterprise Architect, Microsoft Visio

• Bonus: Previous experience with modern Java Script front end frameworks

• Bonus: Knowledge in Insurance Underwriting, Quartz Scheduler, distributed caching (e.g. Redis, Hazelcast)

For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between EUR 3,800 and EUR 6,300 per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:​
· the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role, ​
· the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.​

In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.​
Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.

About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 14,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. • Erfahrung mit IDEs wie IntelliJ IDEA

jobs.description:
Part-time internship (morning)
 6-month duration
 We are looking for an intern with strong technical and interpersonal skills, a can-do mindset, and a strong willingness to learn, broaden their knowledge and expertise, and make a difference. This is an exciting opportunity for a student or recent Engineering graduate who wants to build a professional career in the Property Underwriting sector.
 About the Role
 As a Junior Property Underwriter Intern, you will support the team in daily underwriting activities and operational tasks, including risk research, analysis of risk exposure, documentation and file processing, analysis of policy conditions, and participation in commercial activities and negotiations.
 Key Responsibilities

• Maintain the portfolio database and ensure it is kept up to date.

• Follow up on portfolio renewals and related documentation.

• Support underwriting analyses of new submissions, business practices, and risk assessments for new and existing clients.

• Assist with the preparation of insurance proposals, documentation, marketing materials, and sales presentations.

• Contribute to document management and organization to ensure files are complete and accurately processed in our systems.
 About You
 We are looking for a well-organized, open-minded, and curious individual with a strong interest in learning about insurance and a wide range of related topics.
 You should have:

• Fluency in Spanish and English.

• A proactive approach to problem-solving and ownership of tasks.

• Experience working within a team and collaborating with internal and external stakeholders.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Good organizational and analytical skills.

• Some experience with commercial insurance lines of business and related products would be an advantage.

About Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group. We offer innovative insurance solutions to large and midsized multinational corporations from our approximately 50 locations worldwide. We help clients mitigate their risk exposure, whilst our industry-leading claims service provides them with additional peace of mind.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions embraces a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
 We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.
 #corso

descriptionByLocale.it:
Stage part-time (morning)
Durata di 6 mesi
Siamo alla ricerca di uno stagista con forti competenze tecniche e interpersonali, una mentalità can-do, e una forte volontà di imparare, ampliare le loro conoscenze e competenze, e fare la differenza. Questa è un'opportunità emozionante per uno studente o laureato di ingegneria recente che vuole costruire una carriera professionale nel settore della sottoscrizione di proprietà.
Informazioni sul ruolo
In qualità di Junior Property Underwriter Intern, supporterai il team nelle attività quotidiane di sottoscrizione e nei compiti operativi, tra cui la ricerca sul rischio, l'analisi dell'esposizione al rischio, la documentazione e l'elaborazione dei file, l'analisi delle condizioni politiche e la partecipazione a attività commerciali e trattative.
Principali responsabilità

• Mantenere il database di portafoglio e assicurarsi che sia mantenuto aggiornato.

• Seguire i rinnovi del portafoglio e la relativa documentazione.

• Sostenere le analisi di sottoscrizione di nuove presentazioni, pratiche commerciali e valutazioni di rischio per i clienti nuovi e esistenti.

• Assistere con la preparazione di proposte di assicurazione, documentazione, materiali di marketing e presentazioni di vendita.

• Contribuisci alla gestione e all'organizzazione dei documenti per garantire che i file siano completi e accuratamente elaborati nei nostri sistemi.
A proposito di te
Siamo alla ricerca di un individuo ben organizzato, aperto e curioso, con un forte interesse a conoscere l'assicurazione e una vasta gamma di argomenti correlati.
Avresti dovuto:

• Fluenza in spagnolo e inglese.

• Un approccio proattivo alla risoluzione dei problemi e alla proprietà dei compiti.

• Esperienza di lavoro all'interno di un team e collaborazione con stakeholder interni ed esterni.

• Forte capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale.

• Buone capacità organizzative e analitiche.

• Una certa esperienza con le linee di assicurazione commerciale di affari e prodotti correlati sarebbe un vantaggio.

Informazioni su Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione. Prevediamo e gestiamo i rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions è il braccio di assicurazione commerciale del Gruppo Swiss Re. Offriamo soluzioni di assicurazione innovative a grandi e medie multinazionali dalle nostre circa 50 sedi in tutto il mondo. Aiutiamo i clienti a mitigare la loro esposizione al rischio, mentre il nostro servizio di reclami leader del settore fornisce loro un'ulteriore pace della mente.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions abbraccia un posto di lavoro in cui ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il proprio sé autentico a lavorare e la loro passione per la sostenibilità.

Se sei un professionista esperto che torna alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.
Possiamo utilizzare strumenti basati su AI per supportare la revisione e la valutazione delle applicazioni per questa posizione. Questi strumenti forniscono ulteriori informazioni ai nostri team di reclutamento, ma tutte le decisioni di assunzione sono attentamente esaminate e fatte dalle persone. Per saperne di più su come utilizziamo l'IA nel reclutamento e come gestiamo i tuoi dati personali, si prega di rivedere la nostra Informativa sulla privacy dei dati prima di applicare.
#corso #

Teilzeitpraktikum (morgens)
6 Monate Laufzeit
Wir suchen einen Praktikanten mit starken technischen und zwischenmenschlichen Fähigkeiten, einer Can-Do-Mentalität und einer starken Bereitschaft zu lernen, ihr Wissen und Fachwissen zu erweitern und einen Unterschied zu machen. Dies ist eine aufregende Gelegenheit für einen Studenten oder einen kürzlichen Ingenieurabsolventen, der eine professionelle Karriere im Immobilienversicherungssektor aufbauen möchte.
Über die Rolle
Als Junior Property Underwriter Intern unterstützen Sie das Team bei täglichen Underwriting-Aktivitäten und operativen Aufgaben, einschließlich Risikoforschung, Analyse der Risikoexposition, Dokumentation und Dateiverarbeitung, Analyse der politischen Bedingungen und Teilnahme an kommerziellen Aktivitäten und Verhandlungen.
Hauptzuständigkeiten

• Pflegen Sie die Portfolio-Datenbank und stellen Sie sicher, dass sie auf dem neuesten Stand ist.

• Follow-up zu Portfolioverlängerungen und zugehörige Dokumentation.

• Unterstützung von Underwriting-Analysen neuer Einreichungen, Geschäftspraktiken und Risikobewertungen für neue und bestehende Kunden.

• Unterstützung bei der Vorbereitung von Versicherungsvorschlägen, Dokumentationen, Marketingmaterialien und Verkaufspräsentationen.

• Tragen Sie zur Dokumentenverwaltung und -organisation bei, um sicherzustellen, dass die Dateien in unseren Systemen vollständig und genau verarbeitet werden.
Über dich
Wir suchen eine gut organisierte, aufgeschlossene und neugierige Person mit einem starken Interesse daran, über Versicherungen und eine breite Palette verwandter Themen zu lernen.
Sie sollten:

• fließend in Spanisch und Englisch.

• Ein proaktiver Ansatz zur Problemlösung und Verantwortung für Aufgaben.

• Erfahrung in der Arbeit im Team und in der Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Stakeholdern.

• Starke schriftliche und verbale Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

• Gute organisatorische und analytische Fähigkeiten.

• Einige Erfahrungen mit gewerblichen Versicherungszweigen und verwandten Produkten wären von Vorteil.

Über Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen der versicherungsbasierten Risikoübertragung. Wir antizipieren und managen Risiken, von Naturkatastrophen und Klimawandel bis hin zu Cyberkriminalität.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions ist der gewerbliche Versicherungszweig der Swiss Re Gruppe. Wir bieten innovative Versicherungslösungen für große und mittlere multinationale Konzerne an unseren rund 50 Standorten weltweit. Wir helfen Kunden, ihre Risikoexposition zu mindern, während unser branchenführender Schadenservice ihnen zusätzliche Sicherheit bietet.

Unser Erfolg hängt von unserer Fähigkeit ab, eine integrative Kultur aufzubauen, die neue Perspektiven und innovatives Denken fördert. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions umfasst einen Arbeitsplatz, an dem jeder die gleichen Chancen hat, beruflich zu gedeihen und sich zu entwickeln, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Rasse, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Geschlechtsidentität und / oder Ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, körperlicher oder geistiger Fähigkeiten, Fähigkeiten, Gedanken oder anderen Eigenschaften. In unserem integrativen und flexiblen Umfeld kann jeder sein authentisches Selbst und seine Leidenschaft für Nachhaltigkeit mitbringen.

Wenn Sie ein erfahrener Profi sind, der nach einer Berufspause in die Belegschaft zurückkehrt, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich für offene Stellen zu bewerben, die Ihren Fähigkeiten und Ihrer Erfahrung entsprechen.
Wir können KI-basierte Tools verwenden, um die Überprüfung und Bewertung von Anwendungen für diese Position zu unterstützen. Diese Tools bieten unseren Rekrutierungsteams zusätzliche Einblicke, aber alle Einstellungsentscheidungen werden sorgfältig überprüft und von Menschen getroffen. Um mehr darüber zu erfahren, wie wir KI bei der Rekrutierung einsetzen und wie wir mit Ihren personenbezogenen Daten umgehen, lesen Sie bitte unsere Datenschutzerklärung, bevor Sie sich bewerben.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Stage à temps partiel (matin)
Durée de 6 mois
Nous sommes à la recherche d'un stagiaire doté de solides compétences techniques et interpersonnelles, d'un état d'esprit capable et d'une forte volonté d'apprendre, d'élargir leurs connaissances et leur expertise et de faire une différence. C'est une opportunité passionnante pour un étudiant ou récent diplômé en génie qui veut construire une carrière professionnelle dans le secteur de la souscription de propriété.
À propos du rôle
En tant que stagiaire adjoint en propriété, vous accompagnerez l'équipe dans les activités quotidiennes de souscription et les tâches opérationnelles, y compris la recherche sur les risques, l'analyse de l'exposition aux risques, la documentation et le traitement des dossiers, l'analyse des conditions de la politique et la participation aux activités commerciales et aux négociations.
Principales responsabilités

• Tenir à jour la base de données du portefeuille.

• Suivi des renouvellements de portefeuille et de la documentation connexe.

• Appuyer les analyses de souscription des nouvelles présentations, des pratiques opérationnelles et des évaluations des risques pour les clients nouveaux et existants.

• Aider à la préparation de propositions d'assurance, de documentation, de matériel de marketing et de présentations de ventes.

• Contribuer à la gestion des documents et à l'organisation pour s'assurer que les dossiers sont complets et traités avec précision dans nos systèmes.
À propos de toi
Nous sommes à la recherche d'une personne bien organisée, ouverte d'esprit et curieuse qui s'intéresse beaucoup à l'assurance et à un large éventail de sujets connexes.
Vous auriez dû :

• La fluidité en espagnol et en anglais.

• Une approche proactive de la résolution des problèmes et de l'appropriation des tâches.

• Expérience de travail au sein d'une équipe et collaboration avec des intervenants internes et externes.

• Forte capacité de communication écrite et verbale.

• Bonnes aptitudes organisationnelles et analytiques.

• Une certaine expérience des secteurs d'activité et des produits connexes de l'assurance commerciale serait un avantage.

À propos de Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
Suisse Re est l'un des principaux fournisseurs mondiaux de réassurance, d'assurance et d'autres formes de transfert de risque fondé sur l'assurance. Nous anticipons et gérons les risques, des catastrophes naturelles et du changement climatique à la cybercriminalité.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions est la branche assurance commerciale du Groupe Swiss Re. Nous offrons des solutions d'assurance innovantes aux grandes et moyennes multinationales de nos 50 sites dans le monde. Nous aidons les clients à atténuer leur exposition aux risques, tandis que notre service de réclamation leader de l'industrie leur procure une plus grande tranquillité d'esprit.

Notre succès dépend de notre capacité à bâtir une culture inclusive favorisant de nouvelles perspectives et une pensée novatrice. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions embrasse un lieu de travail où chacun a les mêmes chances de prospérer et de se développer professionnellement, quel que soit son âge, son sexe, sa race, son appartenance ethnique, son identité et/ou son expression, son orientation sexuelle, ses aptitudes physiques ou mentales, ses compétences, sa pensée ou d'autres caractéristiques. Dans notre environnement inclusif et flexible, tout le monde peut apporter son authentique soi au travail et sa passion pour la durabilité.

Si vous êtes un professionnel expérimenté qui revient au marché du travail après une interruption de carrière, nous vous encourageons à postuler à des postes ouverts qui correspondent à vos compétences et à votre expérience.
Nous pouvons utiliser des outils alimentés par l'IA pour appuyer l'examen et l'évaluation des demandes pour ce poste. Ces outils fournissent des renseignements supplémentaires à nos équipes de recrutement, mais toutes les décisions d'embauche sont soigneusement examinées et prises par les gens. Pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous utilisons l'IA dans le recrutement et comment nous traitons vos données personnelles, veuillez consulter notre Déclaration de confidentialité des données avant de postuler.
#corso

jobs.description:
Have you ever dreamed of handling piles of money? Then this is the right career opportunity for you. Why do we believe so? Well, we are the payments and receipts team, responsible for all incoming and outgoing payments of Swiss Re. We ensure that we pay out that hundred million dollar claim on time, but also that we don't miss a ten euro invoice for apples brought to our offices.

About the Role

If you join us, you will perform various tasks. Among others, you will process payments, perform account reconciliations, divide and accurate previously received installments. You will also actively communicate with banks investigating and resolving discrepancies in account movements. You will become a part of an outstanding team with team members that support each other and help new-joiners assimilate quickly. Team spirit is not just a phrase here.

Key responsibilities:
 • You will get your own portfolio of bank accounts, which will allow you to build professional relationships with your business partners.
 • Your main everyday tasks will be: control all entries on the bank account posted into the system, as well as reconcile bank statement balances with system balances to ensure they equal.
 • During first months in the team, experienced colleagues will train you to perform additional tasks, such as setup of partner´s banking details into internal master data system, splitting of received incomings from clients, or evaluating compliance risk for outgoing payments.
 • You will liaise with banks to make sure all payment details are clear and precise. We are positive that you will find exploring the way how banks communicate in their banking environment amazing.
 • At the end of every single day, month and quarter we will expect you to check if everything you processed was accurately posted and that all balances are on target.
 • The best part of our job is helping internal staff and external parties (suppliers, banks) resolve their queries. We make sure that you feel energized by rotating your daily agenda.

About the Team
 The Payments & Receipt team consists of 23 members of different ages and nationalities. The scope of our team covers Europe, and South Africa. Another aspect of our work is involvement in both global and team projects and initiatives. This gives everyone a chance to take part in sculpting the future way of doing things, it will inspire you to come up with and develop new ideas and creative solutions. We value team work, but also individuality and self-realization. So, do you go for it now?

About You
 Essentials:
 • Graduate of Secondary Economic School or Secondary Grammar school or University degree preferably in the area of finance, banking, accounting, economics.
 • Able to communicate in English fluently and see no challenge in writing emails or having phone conversations.
 • Familiar with MS Office (e.g. Excel, Word, Power Point) and have good verbal and written business social skills.

Nice to Haves:
 • Experience within finance/accounting/payments department.
 • Previous Experience with SAP system
 • Fluent in any other European language is an advantage for you.
 For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between EUR 1300 and EUR 2200 per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:
 • the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,
 • the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialization, skills and experience.
 In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based bonus.

We provide feedback to all candidates via email. If you have not heard back from us, please check your spam folder.
 #LI-Hybrid
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 14,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Hai mai sognato di gestire pile di soldi? Allora questa è la giusta opportunità di carriera per voi. Perche' lo crediamo? Siamo il team dei pagamenti e delle ricevute, responsabile di tutti i pagamenti in entrata e in uscita di Swiss Re. Ci assicuriamo di pagare in tempo quel cento milioni di dollari, ma anche di non perdere una fattura di dieci euro per le mele portate ai nostri uffici.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Se ti unisci a noi, eseguirai vari compiti. Tra gli altri, elaborerai pagamenti, eseguirai riconciliazioni account, dividi e accurate rate precedentemente ricevute. Potrai anche comunicare attivamente con le banche che indagano e risolvono discrepanze nei movimenti del conto. Diventerai una parte di un team eccezionale con i membri del team che si sostengono l'un l'altro e aiuteranno i nuovi-joiners a assimilare rapidamente. Lo spirito di squadra non è solo una frase qui.

Responsabilità chiave:
• Si otterrà il proprio portafoglio di conti bancari, che vi permetterà di costruire relazioni professionali con i vostri partner commerciali.
• I vostri compiti quotidiani principali saranno: controllare tutte le voci sul conto bancario pubblicato nel sistema, così come conciliare i saldi di dichiarazione bancari con i bilanci di sistema per garantire che siano uguali.
• Durante i primi mesi del team, i colleghi esperti ti addestrano a svolgere ulteriori compiti, come la configurazione dei dettagli bancari del partner nel sistema di dati master interni, la divisione delle entrate ricevute dai clienti, o la valutazione del rischio di conformità per i pagamenti in uscita.
• Si legherà con le banche per assicurarsi che tutti i dettagli di pagamento sono chiari e precisi. Siamo positivi che troverete esplorare il modo in cui le banche comunicano nel loro ambiente bancario incredibile.
• Alla fine di ogni singolo giorno, mese e trimestre ci aspettiamo che controlliate se tutto ciò che avete elaborato è stato accuratamente pubblicato e che tutti i bilanci sono sul bersaglio.
• La parte migliore del nostro lavoro è aiutare il personale interno e le parti esterne (fornitori, banche) risolvere le loro domande. Ci assicuriamo che ti senti eccitato ruotando la tua agenda quotidiana.

Informazioni sulla squadra
Il team Payments & Receipt è composto da 23 membri di età e nazionalità diverse. Il nostro team copre l'Europa e il Sudafrica. Un altro aspetto del nostro lavoro è il coinvolgimento in progetti e iniziative globali e di team. Questo dà a tutti la possibilità di prendere parte a scolpire il futuro modo di fare le cose, vi ispirerà a venire con e sviluppare nuove idee e soluzioni creative. Apprezziamo il lavoro di squadra, ma anche l'individualità e l'autorealizzazione. Allora, ci vai adesso?

A proposito di te
Elementi essenziali:
• Laureato in Scuola Economica secondaria o Scuola di Grammatica secondaria o laurea universitaria preferibilmente nel settore della finanza, bancario, contabile, economia.
• In grado di comunicare in inglese fluentemente e non vedere nessuna sfida nella scrittura e-mail o avere conversazioni telefoniche.
• Familiare con MS Office (ad esempio Excel, Word, Power Point) e avere buone capacità sociali verbali e scritte.

Che bello avere:
• Esperienza all'interno del reparto finanza / contabilità / pagamenti.
• Esperienza precedente con sistema SAP
• Fluente in qualsiasi altra lingua europea è un vantaggio per voi.
Per la Slovacchia la fascia salariale di base per questa posizione è compresa tra EUR 1300 e EUR 2200 al mese (per un ruolo a tempo pieno). Lo stipendio specifico offerto considera:
• i requisiti, la portata, la complessità e le responsabilità del ruolo,
• il proprio profilo del richiedente, tra cui istruzione/qualifica, competenza, specializzazione, competenze ed esperienza.
Oltre al vostro stipendio base, si può essere idonei per ulteriori ricompense e benefici, tra cui un attraente bonus basato sulle prestazioni.

Forniamo feedback a tutti i candidati via e-mail. Se non avete sentito indietro da noi, si prega di controllare la cartella spam.

Have you ever dreamed of handling piles of money? Then this is the right career opportunity for you. Why do we believe so? Well, we are the payments and receipts team, responsible for all incoming and outgoing payments of Swiss Re. We ensure that we pay out that hundred million dollar claim on time, but also that we don't miss a ten euro invoice for apples brought to our offices.

About the Role

If you join us, you will perform various tasks. Among others, you will process payments, perform account reconciliations, divide and accurate previously received installments. You will also actively communicate with banks investigating and resolving discrepancies in account movements. You will become a part of an outstanding team with team members that support each other and help new-joiners assimilate quickly. Team spirit is not just a phrase here.

Key responsibilities:
• You will get your own portfolio of bank accounts, which will allow you to build professional relationships with your business partners.
• Your main everyday tasks will be: control all entries on the bank account posted into the system, as well as reconcile bank statement balances with system balances to ensure they equal.
• During first months in the team, experienced colleagues will train you to perform additional tasks, such as setup of partner´s banking details into internal master data system, splitting of received incomings from clients, or evaluating compliance risk for outgoing payments.
• You will liaise with banks to make sure all payment details are clear and precise. We are positive that you will find exploring the way how banks communicate in their banking environment amazing.
• At the end of every single day, month and quarter we will expect you to check if everything you processed was accurately posted and that all balances are on target.
• The best part of our job is helping internal staff and external parties (suppliers, banks) resolve their queries. We make sure that you feel energized by rotating your daily agenda.

About the Team
The Payments & Receipt team consists of 23 members of different ages and nationalities. The scope of our team covers Europe, and South Africa. Another aspect of our work is involvement in both global and team projects and initiatives. This gives everyone a chance to take part in sculpting the future way of doing things, it will inspire you to come up with and develop new ideas and creative solutions. We value team work, but also individuality and self-realization. So, do you go for it now?

About You
Essentials:
• Graduate of Secondary Economic School or Secondary Grammar school or University degree preferably in the area of finance, banking, accounting, economics.
• Able to communicate in English fluently and see no challenge in writing emails or having phone conversations.
• Familiar with MS Office (e.g. Excel, Word, Power Point) and have good verbal and written business social skills.

Nice to Haves:
• Experience within finance/accounting/payments department.
• Previous Experience with SAP system
• Fluent in any other European language is an advantage for you.
For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between EUR 1300 and EUR 2200 per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:
• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,
• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialization, skills and experience.
In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based bonus.

jobs.description:
About the role:
 Quantitative Risk Analyst plays a pivotal role in safeguarding the integrity of the models that drive critical financial decisions. You'll be part of a collaborative, multi-location team spanning Bangalore, London, and Zurich, reviewing derivatives pricing to insurance-linked risk models. This is a role where your analytical rigor, curiosity, and technical depth will directly influence how Swiss Re understands and manages financial risk at a global scale.
 Key Responsibilities:

• Validate valuation and risk measurement models across a wide range of asset classes including fixed income, equity, derivatives, and insurance-linked derivatives, working closely with colleagues in London and Zurich

• Review and critically assess risk aggregation methodologies such as Value at Risk (VaR), Stress Testing, and Credit Risk Measurement to ensure mathematical soundness and practical accuracy

• Evaluate financial risk representations embedded in insurance products, bridging the gap between actuarial and quantitative finance disciplines

• Conduct independent model testing and alternative model analysis, including building independent model implementations where necessary, to quantify and communicate model risk

• Prepare clear, thorough validation documentation summarising findings, conclusions, and recommendations in line with approved standards — ensuring technical rigour meets business clarity

• Track and follow up on identified model issues, ensuring timely resolution or appropriate risk containment measures are in place

• Collaborate across teams and geographies, engaging with model developers, risk managers, and IT stakeholders to deliver robust, fit-for-purpose solutions
 About the team:
 The Financial Model & Valuation Risk Management (FM&VRM) team is part of Swiss Re's Group Risk Management division, with presence across London, Zurich, and Bangalore. The team is responsible for ensuring that every material model or tool used to determine the valuation or risk characteristics of financial instruments is grounded in sound mathematical and economic principles, correctly implemented, and producing accurate results.
 Beyond model validation, the team plays an active role in developing and maintaining the risk methodologies used by Financial Risk Management (FRM), and works in close partnership with IT to build robust, scalable platforms that power FRM's work. It's a team that values intellectual curiosity, precision, and a collaborative spirit — where every team member's contribution makes a real difference.
 About you:
 You are a detail-oriented, intellectually curious quantitative professional who brings both technical depth and strong communication skills to the table. You're comfortable navigating complexity, enjoy learning new modelling approaches, and take pride in producing well-structured, insightful technical documentation. You work well across cultures and time zones, and you're energized by the opportunity to contribute to a high-impact global team.
 Requirements:

• Strong academic background with an undergraduate or master's degree in a quantitative discipline such as quantitative finance, mathematics, statistics, physics, or engineering

• 4+ years of experience in a quantitative role within a financial institution, with hands-on exposure to financial modelling, risk measurement, or model validation

• Demonstrated written communication skills, with the ability to produce clear, structured technical reports — a sample technical report will be requested as part of the screening process

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain high-quality output under pressure

• Proactive, self-driven attitude with a genuine willingness to explore unfamiliar areas and apply general technical knowledge to new, specific challenges
 Nice to haves:

• Strong understanding of derivatives pricing theory and numerical methods (e.g., Monte Carlo simulation, finite difference methods, analytical approximations)

• Experience with risk aggregation frameworks such as VaR, stress testing, or economic capital models within a financial or insurance context

• Actuarial qualifications or professional experience in the (re)insurance industry, bridging quantitative finance and insurance risk

• Exposure to programming environments such as Python, R, MATLAB, or C++ for model testing and independent implementation
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.
 About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
 We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Riguardo al ruolo:
Quantitativo Risk Analyst svolge un ruolo fondamentale nella salvaguardia dell'integrità dei modelli che guidano decisioni finanziarie critiche. Farai parte di un team collaborativo e multi-location che si occupa di Bangalore, Londra e Zurigo, riesaminando i prezzi dei derivati ai modelli di rischio collegati all'assicurazione. Questo è un ruolo in cui il rigore analitico, la curiosità e la profondità tecnica influenzeranno direttamente come Swiss Re comprende e gestisce il rischio finanziario a livello globale.
Responsabilità chiave:

• Convalida modelli di valutazione e di misura del rischio in una vasta gamma di classi di asset, tra cui reddito fisso, equità, derivati e derivati collegati alle assicurazioni, lavorando a stretto contatto con i colleghi di Londra e Zurigo

• Valutazione e valutazione critica delle metodologie di aggregazione dei rischi come il valore al rischio (VaR), il test di stress e la misurazione del rischio di credito per garantire la solidità matematica e la precisione pratica

• Valutare le rappresentanze dei rischi finanziari incorporate nei prodotti assicurativi, colmare il divario tra discipline attuariali e finanziarie quantitative

• Condurre test di modello indipendente e analisi di modelli alternativi, tra cui la costruzione di implementazioni di modelli indipendenti, se necessario, per quantificare e comunicare il rischio di modello

• Preparare la documentazione chiara e approfondita di convalida riassumendo i risultati, le conclusioni e le raccomandazioni in linea con gli standard approvati — assicurando rigore tecnico soddisfa la chiarezza aziendale

• Tracciare e seguire i temi identificati del modello, assicurando una risoluzione tempestiva o adeguate misure di contenimento del rischio sono in atto

• Collabora tra team e geografie, impegnandosi con sviluppatori di modelli, responsabili dei rischi e stakeholder IT per fornire soluzioni robuste e fit-per-purpose
Informazioni sulla squadra:
Il team Financial Model & Valuation Risk Management (FM&VRM) fa parte della divisione Swiss Re's Group Risk Management, con presenza in tutta Londra, Zurigo e Bangalore. Il team è responsabile di garantire che ogni modello o strumento materiale utilizzato per determinare le caratteristiche di valutazione o di rischio degli strumenti finanziari sia fondato in sani principi matematici ed economici, correttamente implementati e producendo risultati accurati.
Oltre alla validazione del modello, il team svolge un ruolo attivo nello sviluppo e nel mantenimento delle metodologie di rischio utilizzate da Financial Risk Management (FRM), e lavora in stretta collaborazione con IT per costruire piattaforme robuste e scalabili che alimentano il lavoro di FRM. È un team che valorizza la curiosità intellettuale, la precisione e lo spirito collaborativo, dove il contributo di ogni membro del team fa una vera differenza.
Su di te:
Sei un professionista quantitativo orientato al dettaglio, intellettualmente curioso che porta sia la profondità tecnica che le forti capacità di comunicazione al tavolo. Sei comodo navigare nella complessità, godere di imparare nuovi approcci di modellazione, e vantarsi di produrre documentazione tecnica ben strutturata e intuitiva. Lavori bene in culture e fusi orari, e sei eccitato dall'opportunità di contribuire a un team globale ad alto impatto.
Requisiti:

• Forte background accademico con una laurea o master in una disciplina quantitativa come la finanza quantitativa, matematica, statistiche, fisica o ingegneria

• 4+ anni di esperienza in un ruolo quantitativo all'interno di un istituto finanziario, con esposizione pratica alla modellazione finanziaria, alla misurazione del rischio o alla validazione del modello

• Dimostrate competenze di comunicazione scritta, con la capacità di produrre rapporti tecnici chiari e strutturati, sarà richiesta una relazione tecnica campione nell'ambito del processo di screening

• Forte capacità organizzative con la capacità di gestire più priorità, rispettare le scadenze e mantenere la produzione di alta qualità sotto pressione

• Atteggiamento proattivo e autodidatta con una sincera volontà di esplorare aree non familiari e applicare conoscenze tecniche generali a nuove e specifiche sfide
Bello da avere:

• Forte comprensione della teoria dei prezzi dei derivati e dei metodi numerici (ad esempio, simulazione Monte Carlo, metodi di differenza finita, approssimazioni analitiche)

• Esperienza con sistemi di aggregazione dei rischi come VaR, test di stress o modelli di capitale economico in un contesto finanziario o assicurativo

• Le qualifiche attuariali o l'esperienza professionale nell'industria dell'assicurazione (re), che corrobora il rischio di finanziamento quantitativo e di assicurazione

• Esposizione ad ambienti di programmazione quali Python, R, MATLAB o C++ per test di modelli e implementazione indipendente
La nostra azienda ha un modello di lavoro ibrido in cui l'aspettativa è che sarete in ufficio almeno tre giorni alla settimana.
Informazioni su Swiss Re
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione, lavorando per rendere il mondo più resiliente. Aspettiamo e gestiamo una vasta gamma di rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine. Copriamo sia Proprietà & Casuale e Vita & Salute. Combinando l'esperienza con il pensiero creativo e l'esperienza all'avanguardia, creiamo nuove opportunità e soluzioni per i nostri clienti. Questo è possibile grazie alla collaborazione di oltre 15.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo.

About the role:
Quantitative Risk Analyst plays a pivotal role in safeguarding the integrity of the models that drive critical financial decisions. You'll be part of a collaborative, multi-location team spanning Bangalore, London, and Zurich, reviewing derivatives pricing to insurance-linked risk models. This is a role where your analytical rigor, curiosity, and technical depth will directly influence how Swiss Re understands and manages financial risk at a global scale.
Key Responsibilities:

• Validate valuation and risk measurement models across a wide range of asset classes including fixed income, equity, derivatives, and insurance-linked derivatives, working closely with colleagues in London and Zurich

• Review and critically assess risk aggregation methodologies such as Value at Risk (VaR), Stress Testing, and Credit Risk Measurement to ensure mathematical soundness and practical accuracy

• Evaluate financial risk representations embedded in insurance products, bridging the gap between actuarial and quantitative finance disciplines

• Conduct independent model testing and alternative model analysis, including building independent model implementations where necessary, to quantify and communicate model risk

• Prepare clear, thorough validation documentation summarising findings, conclusions, and recommendations in line with approved standards — ensuring technical rigour meets business clarity

• Track and follow up on identified model issues, ensuring timely resolution or appropriate risk containment measures are in place

• Collaborate across teams and geographies, engaging with model developers, risk managers, and IT stakeholders to deliver robust, fit-for-purpose solutions
About the team:
The Financial Model & Valuation Risk Management (FM&VRM) team is part of Swiss Re's Group Risk Management division, with presence across London, Zurich, and Bangalore. The team is responsible for ensuring that every material model or tool used to determine the valuation or risk characteristics of financial instruments is grounded in sound mathematical and economic principles, correctly implemented, and producing accurate results.
Beyond model validation, the team plays an active role in developing and maintaining the risk methodologies used by Financial Risk Management (FRM), and works in close partnership with IT to build robust, scalable platforms that power FRM's work. It's a team that values intellectual curiosity, precision, and a collaborative spirit — where every team member's contribution makes a real difference.
About you:
You are a detail-oriented, intellectually curious quantitative professional who brings both technical depth and strong communication skills to the table. You're comfortable navigating complexity, enjoy learning new modelling approaches, and take pride in producing well-structured, insightful technical documentation. You work well across cultures and time zones, and you're energized by the opportunity to contribute to a high-impact global team.
Requirements:

• Strong academic background with an undergraduate or master's degree in a quantitative discipline such as quantitative finance, mathematics, statistics, physics, or engineering

• 4+ years of experience in a quantitative role within a financial institution, with hands-on exposure to financial modelling, risk measurement, or model validation

• Demonstrated written communication skills, with the ability to produce clear, structured technical reports — a sample technical report will be requested as part of the screening process

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain high-quality output under pressure

• Proactive, self-driven attitude with a genuine willingness to explore unfamiliar areas and apply general technical knowledge to new, specific challenges
Nice to haves:

• Strong understanding of derivatives pricing theory and numerical methods (e.g., Monte Carlo simulation, finite difference methods, analytical approximations)

• Experience with risk aggregation frameworks such as VaR, stress testing, or economic capital models within a financial or insurance context

• Actuarial qualifications or professional experience in the (re)insurance industry, bridging quantitative finance and insurance risk

• Exposure to programming environments such as Python, R, MATLAB, or C++ for model testing and independent implementation
Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.
About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.
