Façonner l'avenir de la technologie financière

Les opérations financières fiables dépendent des applications modernes de l'entreprise, des données fiables et de l'automatisation intelligente. En combinant l'ingénierie logicielle, l'automatisation des flux de travail et des plates-formes de données modernes, nous développons des solutions qui simplifient les processus opérationnels, améliorent la résilience opérationnelle et permettent une prise de décision éclairée dans toutes les fonctions financières essentielles.
Nous sommes à la recherche d'un ingénieur d'application senior qui combine de solides compétences en génie logiciel avec la compréhension des affaires pour concevoir, construire et exploiter des applications d'entreprise, des solutions de workflow et des produits axés sur les données qui soutiennent des processus financiers et opérationnels critiques.
À propos du rôle

En tant qu'ingénieur principal des applications, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la conception et la livraison d'applications d'entreprise qui soutiennent les processus financiers critiques pour les entreprises. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes, les architectes de solutions, les propriétaires de produits et les équipes d'ingénierie pour transformer les exigences opérationnelles complexes en solutions évolutives, durables et axées sur l'utilisateur.
Ce rôle combine l'ingénierie logicielle, l'automatisation des flux de travail, l'ingénierie des données et l'architecture des solutions. Vous concevrez et développerez des applications, automatiserez les processus d'affaires, intégrerez les systèmes d'entreprise et créerez des capacités axées sur les données qui améliorent l'efficacité opérationnelle et la transparence.
Vous travaillerez à travers un paysage technologique moderne qui comprend Palantir Foundry , Camunda , Python-based services , API , technologies cloud , et d'autres plates-formes d'entreprise en fonction des besoins des entreprises. Bien que l'expérience avec Palantir Foundry soit très appréciée, nous accueillons des ingénieurs possédant une expérience dans des plateformes modernes comparables qui sont impatients d'apprendre.
À propos de l'équipe

L'équipe Tech & Data Management est composée de professionnels de Zurich, Bratislava et Kansas City. Nous développons et exploitons des solutions technologiques et de données qui améliorent l'efficacité opérationnelle, renforcent la résilience et soutiennent des processus financiers et opérationnels critiques.
Nous combinons l'expertise en ingénierie de données, en analyse, en ingénierie de logiciels et en architecture de solutions pour offrir une valeur commerciale dans un paysage technologique d'entreprise diversifié.
Principales responsabilités

Ingénierie et architecture

• Concevoir, développer et maintenir des applications d'entreprise, l'automatisation des flux de travail, les API, les intégrations et les solutions axées sur les données qui soutiennent les processus financiers et opérationnels.

• Construisez des pipelines de données évolutives, des transformations, des modèles de données et des produits de données réutilisables à l'aide de plateformes modernes comme Palantir Foundry, Camunda et Python.

• Définir les architectures d'application et de données de bout en bout, les modèles d'intégration, les flux de travail et les flux de données alignés sur les objectifs opérationnels, les normes d'entreprise et les meilleures pratiques d'ingénierie.

• Promouvoir des normes d'ingénierie de haute qualité, la qualité des logiciels, les contrôles de sécurité, DevSecOps et les pratiques d'automatisation.

• Appuyer les initiatives d'IC/DC, de modernisation de la plateforme et d'amélioration continue.

• Les ingénieurs mentors et les équipes d'aide fournissent des solutions d'entreprise évolutives et durables.
Engagement des parties prenantes

• Établir des partenariats avec les intervenants pour comprendre les objectifs, les défis et les exigences.

• Faciliter les ateliers et traduire les besoins des entreprises en solutions techniques évolutives.

• Expliquer clairement les concepts techniques et donner des conseils sur les applications, l'automatisation, l'ingénierie des données et la conception des solutions.

Compétences

Requis

• Expérience de développement d'applications logicielles d'entreprise, d'applications commerciales ou de solutions à forte intensité de données.

• Forte expérience pratique avec Python pour le développement d'applications, l'automatisation et les services de backend.

• Expérience de conception d'applications d'entreprise évolutives et d'intégrations de systèmes.

• Expérience de travail avec les API REST, les modèles d'intégration et les systèmes distribués.

• Compréhension solide des principes d'ingénierie logicielle, de l'architecture des solutions et de la conception d'applications modernes.

• Expérience avec SQL, bases de données relationnelles et travail avec de gros ensembles de données.

• Compréhension des concepts d'ingénierie des données, y compris les pipelines de données, la modélisation des données, les transformations et la qualité des données.

• Capacité de traduire des exigences opérationnelles complexes en solutions techniques évolutives.

• Fortes compétences en communication, facilitation et gestion des intervenants.

Sympa d'avoir

• Expérience avec des plateformes d'entreprise telles que Palantir Foundry, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake, ou des technologies similaires.

• Expérience avec Camunda ou des plateformes similaires pour l'automatisation des flux de travail ou la gestion des processus d'affaires

• Expérience de la construction d'applications commerciales, d'applications analytiques ou d'outils internes d'entreprise.

• Expérience des services Azure, des architectures cloud-native, des pratiques DevOps et des pipelines CI/CD.

• Connaissance des services financiers, des opérations financières ou des processus opérationnels d'entreprise.
Remarque: une expérience directe avec Palantir Foundry ou Camunda n'est pas requise. Nous accueillons les candidats ayant une solide expérience en ingénierie logicielle qui ont travaillé avec des plateformes d'entreprise comparables et qui sont impatients d'apprendre de nouvelles technologies

Pour la Slovaquie, l'échelle salariale de base pour ce poste se situe entre [2 800 EUR] et [4 600 EUR] par mois (pour un rôle à temps plein). Le salaire spécifique offert tient compte:

• les exigences, la portée, la complexité et les responsabilités du rôle,

• le profil propre du candidat, y compris l'éducation/qualifications, l'expertise, la spécialisation, les compétences et l'expérience.
En plus de votre salaire de base, Swiss Re offre une composante de rémunération variable axée sur la performance, conçue pour reconnaître vos réalisations. De plus, vous bénéficierez d'une variété d'avantages globaux et spécifiques à l'emplacement.
L'éligibilité peut varier en fonction des conditions des politiques Swiss Re et de votre contrat de travail.
À propos de Swiss Re
Suisse Re est l'un des principaux fournisseurs de réassurance, d'assurance et d'autres formes de transfert de risque fondé sur l'assurance, travaillant à rendre le monde plus résilient. Nous anticipons et gérons une grande variété de risques, des catastrophes naturelles et du changement climatique à la cybercriminalité. Combinant l'expérience avec la pensée créative et l'expertise de pointe, nous créons de nouvelles opportunités et solutions pour nos clients. Cela est possible grâce à la collaboration de plus de 15 000 employés à travers le monde.

Notre succès dépend de notre capacité à bâtir une culture inclusive favorisant de nouvelles perspectives et une pensée novatrice. Nous embrassons un lieu de travail où chacun a les mêmes chances de prospérer et de se développer professionnellement, quel que soit son âge, son sexe, sa race, son appartenance ethnique, son identité et/ou son expression, son orientation sexuelle, ses aptitudes physiques ou mentales, ses compétences, sa pensée ou d'autres caractéristiques. Dans notre environnement inclusif et flexible, tout le monde peut apporter son authentique soi au travail et sa passion pour la durabilité.

Si vous êtes un professionnel expérimenté qui revient au marché du travail après une interruption de carrière, nous vous encourageons à postuler à des postes ouverts qui correspondent à vos compétences et à votre expérience.
Nous pouvons utiliser des outils alimentés par l'IA pour appuyer l'examen et l'évaluation des demandes pour ce poste. Ces outils fournissent des renseignements supplémentaires à nos équipes de recrutement, mais toutes les décisions d'embauche sont soigneusement examinées et prises par les gens. Pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous utilisons l'IA dans le recrutement et comment nous traitons vos données personnelles, veuillez consulter notre Déclaration de confidentialité des données avant de postuler.

Engineering Manager (Technical)
 Location: Hyderabad, India

Are you a technically-driven engineering leader who thrives at the intersection of hands-on architecture and people leadership? Do you want to shape the future of cloud-native insurance technology at a global scale? If you're passionate about building high-performing teams, championing modern engineering practices and driving AI-powered transformation — this is the role for you.

About the Role
 As an Engineering Manager (Technical) within L&H Solutions, you'll be at the heart of engineering delivery — balancing deep technical leadership with the inspiration and development of a talented, globally distributed team. This is not a role where you step away from the code; you'll remain hands-on, leading by example while driving architectural excellence, AI-enabled engineering practices and the delivery of secure, scalable and resilient solutions that matter to clients worldwide.
 Working closely with Product Owners, Architects, Platform Engineering teams and Engineering Leadership, you'll have real influence over technical strategy while building a culture where engineers thrive, innovate and grow.

 Technical Leadership (70%)

• Lead architecture, design and engineering decisions across the full Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), setting the technical direction for L&H Solutions.

• Drive the adoption of AI-assisted software engineering practices , including AI-supported coding, testing, code reviews, documentation and developer productivity tooling.

• Champion modern engineering practices such as Cloud-native development, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), DevSecOps, CI/CD, Platform Engineering and Observability.

• Stay hands-on by actively contributing to solution design, code reviews, technical problem-solving and the definition of engineering standards.

• Promote engineering quality through automation, security-first thinking, performance optimisation and a culture of continuous improvement.

Engineering Management (30%)

• Build, lead, coach and mentor a high-performing engineering team, fostering individual growth and collective excellence.

• Partner with Product Owners and business stakeholders to align engineering delivery with strategic initiatives and business outcomes.

• Drive Agile delivery , engineering KPIs and continuous improvement practices across teams.

• Foster a culture of innovation, ownership and collaboration , where technical excellence is celebrated and engineers are empowered to do their best work.

You are energised by complexity, driven by quality and excited about the transformative potential of AI in modern software engineering. You communicate with clarity, collaborate across boundaries and bring out the best in every team member.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• 12–15+ years of software engineering experience , including a minimum of 5 years leading engineering teams in a hands-on technical leadership capacity.

• Strong hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, APIs and distributed systems , with a proven track record of designing scalable, secure and cloud-native enterprise applications.

• Deep knowledge of software architecture, design patterns, CI/CD, DevSecOps, Kubernetes and Azure , combined with practical experience in Platform Engineering, Observability, automated testing and resilient system design.

These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience with AI-enabled SDLC practices and hands-on use of AI developer tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot or similar) to improve engineering productivity and software quality.

• Demonstrated passion for mentoring engineers and driving engineering transformation at an organisational level.

• Experience working in Agile, globally distributed engineering organisations , with the ability to navigate complexity across time zones and cultures.

• Excellent communication, stakeholder management and problem-solving skills , with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.

• Exposure to the insurance or financial services industry , particularly Life & Health domains, is a plus.

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.

We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. In qualità di Engineering Manager (Technical) all'interno di L&H Solutions, sarete al centro della fornitura di ingegneria - bilanciando la leadership tecnica profonda con l'ispirazione e lo sviluppo di un team di talento, globalmente distribuito. Informazioni sulla squadra

A proposito di te

Sei stimolato dalla complessità, guidato dalla qualità e entusiasta del potenziale trasformativo di AI nell'ingegneria software moderna. Comunichi con chiarezza, collabori attraverso i confini e tiri fuori il meglio in ogni membro del team.
Siamo alla ricerca di candidati che soddisfano questi requisiti:

• 12-15 anni di esperienza nell'ingegneria del software, tra cui un minimo di 5 anni leader team di ingegneria in una capacità di leadership tecnica pratica.

• Forte esperienza pratica con Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, API e sistemi distribuiti, con una comprovata traccia di progettazione di applicazioni enterprise scalabili, sicure e cloud-native.

• Conoscenza profonda dell'architettura software, modelli di progettazione, CI/CD, DevSecOps, Kubernetes e Azure , combinati con esperienza pratica in Platform Engineering, Osservabilità, test automatizzati e progettazione del sistema resiliente.

Questi sono ulteriori bello da avere:

• Esperienza di lavoro in Agile, organizzazioni ingegneristiche distribuite a livello globale, con la capacità di navigare nella complessità tra fusi orari e culture.

• Ottima comunicazione, gestione delle parti interessate e capacità di problem solving, con la capacità di tradurre concetti tecnici per il pubblico non tecnico.

La nostra azienda ha un modello di lavoro ibrido in cui l'aspettativa è che sarete in ufficio almeno tre giorni alla settimana.
Informazioni su Swiss Re
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione, lavorando per rendere il mondo più resiliente. Aspettiamo e gestiamo una vasta gamma di rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine. Copriamo sia Proprietà & Casuale e Vita & Salute. Combinando l'esperienza con il pensiero creativo e l'esperienza all'avanguardia, creiamo nuove opportunità e soluzioni per i nostri clienti. Questo è possibile grazie alla collaborazione di oltre 15.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il proprio sé autentico a lavorare e la loro passione per la sostenibilità.

Se sei un professionista esperto che torna alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.
Possiamo utilizzare strumenti basati su AI per supportare la revisione e la valutazione delle applicazioni per questa posizione. Questi strumenti forniscono ulteriori informazioni ai nostri team di reclutamento, ma tutte le decisioni di assunzione sono attentamente esaminate e fatte dalle persone. Per saperne di più su come utilizziamo l'IA nel reclutamento e come gestiamo i tuoi dati personali, si prega di rivedere la nostra Informativa sulla privacy dei dati prima di applicare.

Engineering Manager (Technical)
Location: Hyderabad, India

Are you a technically-driven engineering leader who thrives at the intersection of hands-on architecture and people leadership? Do you want to shape the future of cloud-native insurance technology at a global scale? If you're passionate about building high-performing teams, championing modern engineering practices and driving AI-powered transformation — this is the role for you.

About the Role
As an Engineering Manager (Technical) within L&H Solutions, you'll be at the heart of engineering delivery — balancing deep technical leadership with the inspiration and development of a talented, globally distributed team. This is not a role where you step away from the code; you'll remain hands-on, leading by example while driving architectural excellence, AI-enabled engineering practices and the delivery of secure, scalable and resilient solutions that matter to clients worldwide.
Working closely with Product Owners, Architects, Platform Engineering teams and Engineering Leadership, you'll have real influence over technical strategy while building a culture where engineers thrive, innovate and grow.
Key Responsibilities
Technical Leadership (70%)

• Lead architecture, design and engineering decisions across the full Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), setting the technical direction for L&H Solutions.

• Drive the adoption of AI-assisted software engineering practices , including AI-supported coding, testing, code reviews, documentation and developer productivity tooling.

• Champion modern engineering practices such as Cloud-native development, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), DevSecOps, CI/CD, Platform Engineering and Observability.

• Stay hands-on by actively contributing to solution design, code reviews, technical problem-solving and the definition of engineering standards.

• Promote engineering quality through automation, security-first thinking, performance optimisation and a culture of continuous improvement.

Engineering Management (30%)

• Build, lead, coach and mentor a high-performing engineering team, fostering individual growth and collective excellence.

• Partner with Product Owners and business stakeholders to align engineering delivery with strategic initiatives and business outcomes.

• Drive Agile delivery , engineering KPIs and continuous improvement practices across teams.

• Foster a culture of innovation, ownership and collaboration , where technical excellence is celebrated and engineers are empowered to do their best work.

About the Team
At L&H Solutions , we build and commercialise cloud-native (Azure-based) SaaS/PaaS solutions for Swiss Re's Life & Health insurance clients. Our portfolio spans more than six products — including the well-established Magnum , trusted by over 60 active clients worldwide, and innovative offerings such as UW Ease . Operating as a software house within Swiss Re, we bring together more than 150 technical professionals with multidisciplinary skills across multiple countries, delivering multi-regional, highly available solutions that are transforming the insurance industry.
Joining L&H Solutions means becoming part of a collaborative, innovative environment where your expertise directly shapes the quality and reliability of products used by clients around the globe. We value diverse perspectives, bold ideas and the kind of engineering rigour that turns ambition into impact.

About You
You are a seasoned engineering leader who leads with both technical depth and human empathy. You bring a rare combination of architectural vision, hands-on coding capability and the ability to inspire and grow the people around you. You are energised by complexity, driven by quality and excited about the transformative potential of AI in modern software engineering. You communicate with clarity, collaborate across boundaries and bring out the best in every team member.
We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• 12–15+ years of software engineering experience , including a minimum of 5 years leading engineering teams in a hands-on technical leadership capacity.

• Strong hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, APIs and distributed systems , with a proven track record of designing scalable, secure and cloud-native enterprise applications.

• Deep knowledge of software architecture, design patterns, CI/CD, DevSecOps, Kubernetes and Azure , combined with practical experience in Platform Engineering, Observability, automated testing and resilient system design.

These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience with AI-enabled SDLC practices and hands-on use of AI developer tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot or similar) to improve engineering productivity and software quality.

• Demonstrated passion for mentoring engineers and driving engineering transformation at an organisational level.

• Experience working in Agile, globally distributed engineering organisations , with the ability to navigate complexity across time zones and cultures.

• Excellent communication, stakeholder management and problem-solving skills , with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.

• Exposure to the insurance or financial services industry , particularly Life & Health domains, is a plus.

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.
About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Technische Führung (70%)

• Fahren Sie Agile Delivery, Engineering KPIs und kontinuierliche Verbesserungspraktiken in allen Teams.

• Fördern Sie eine Kultur der Innovation, des Eigentums und der Zusammenarbeit, in der technische Exzellenz gefeiert wird und Ingenieure ihre beste Arbeit leisten können.

Über das Team
Bei L&H Solutions bauen und vermarkten wir Cloud-native (Azure-basierte) SaaS/PaaS-Lösungen für die Kunden der Lebens- und Krankenversicherung von Swiss Re. Unser Portfolio umfasst mehr als sechs Produkte – darunter das etablierte Magnum, dem über 60 aktive Kunden weltweit vertrauen, und innovative Angebote wie UW Ease. Als Softwarehaus bei Swiss Re bringen wir mehr als 150 technische Fachkräfte mit multidisziplinären Fähigkeiten in mehreren Ländern zusammen und liefern multiregionale, hochverfügbare Lösungen, die die Versicherungsbranche verändern.

Wir schätzen verschiedene Perspektiven, mutige Ideen und die Art von technischer Strenge, die Ehrgeiz in Wirkung verwandelt.

Über dich
Sie sind ein erfahrener Ingenieurführer, der sowohl mit technischer Tiefe als auch mit menschlicher Empathie führt. Sie bringen eine seltene Kombination aus architektonischer Vision, praktischer Programmierfähigkeit und der Fähigkeit, die Menschen um Sie herum zu inspirieren und zu wachsen. Sie werden von Komplexität angetrieben, von Qualität angetrieben und vom transformativen Potenzial von KI im modernen Software Engineering begeistert. Sie kommunizieren mit Klarheit, arbeiten über Grenzen hinweg zusammen und bringen das Beste aus jedem Teammitglied heraus.
Wir suchen Kandidaten, die diese Anforderungen erfüllen:

• 12–15+ Jahre Software-Engineering-Erfahrung, darunter mindestens 5 Jahre führende Engineering-Teams in einer praktischen technischen Führungsposition.

• Starke praktische Erfahrung mit Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, APIs und verteilten Systemen mit einer nachgewiesenen Erfolgsbilanz bei der Entwicklung skalierbarer, sicherer und Cloud-nativer Unternehmensanwendungen.

• Tiefes Wissen über Softwarearchitektur, Design Patterns, CI/CD, DevSecOps, Kubernetes und Azure, kombiniert mit praktischer Erfahrung in Platform Engineering, Observability, automatisiertem Testen und resilientem Systemdesign.

Dies sind zusätzliche nett zu haben:

• Erfahrung mit KI-fähigen SDLC-Praktiken und dem praktischen Einsatz von KI-Entwicklertools (z. B. GitHub Copilot oder ähnliches), um die Produktivität und Softwarequalität zu verbessern.

• Demonstrierte Leidenschaft für die Betreuung von Ingenieuren und die Förderung der technischen Transformation auf organisatorischer Ebene.

• Erfahrung in agilen, global verteilten Engineering-Organisationen mit der Fähigkeit, Komplexität über Zeitzonen und Kulturen hinweg zu navigieren.

• Hervorragende Kommunikation, Stakeholder-Management und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, technische Konzepte für nicht-technische Zielgruppen zu übersetzen.

• Die Exposition gegenüber der Versicherungs- oder Finanzdienstleistungsbranche, insbesondere Life & Health-Domänen, ist ein Plus.

Unser Unternehmen hat ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, bei dem erwartet wird, dass Sie mindestens drei Tage pro Woche im Büro sind.
Über Swiss Re
Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen des versicherungsbasierten Risikotransfers und arbeitet daran, die Welt widerstandsfähiger zu machen. Wir nehmen einen Arbeitsplatz an, an dem jeder die gleichen Chancen hat, beruflich zu gedeihen und sich zu entwickeln, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Rasse, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Geschlechtsidentität und / oder Ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, körperlicher oder geistiger Fähigkeit, Fähigkeiten, Gedanken oder anderen Eigenschaften. In unserem integrativen und flexiblen Umfeld kann jeder sein authentisches Selbst und seine Leidenschaft für Nachhaltigkeit mitbringen.

Wenn Sie ein erfahrener Profi sind, der nach einer Berufspause in die Belegschaft zurückkehrt, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich für offene Stellen zu bewerben, die Ihren Fähigkeiten und Ihrer Erfahrung entsprechen.

• Favoriser l'adoption de pratiques de génie logiciel assistées par l'IA, y compris le codage, les essais, les examens de codes, la documentation et l'outillage de productivité des développeurs.

• Établir des partenariats avec les propriétaires de produits et les intervenants commerciaux afin d'harmoniser la prestation des services d'ingénierie avec les initiatives stratégiques et les résultats opérationnels.

En tant que maison de logiciels au sein de Swiss Re, nous réunissons plus de 150 professionnels techniques possédant des compétences multidisciplinaires dans de nombreux pays, offrant des solutions multirégionales et hautement disponibles qui transforment le secteur de l'assurance.

Nous apprécions diverses perspectives, des idées audacieuses et le genre de rigueur technique qui transforme l'ambition en impact.

À propos de toi
Vous êtes un leader expérimenté de l'ingénierie qui mène avec la profondeur technique et l'empathie humaine. Vous apportez une rare combinaison de vision architecturale, la capacité de codage pratique et la capacité d'inspirer et de développer les gens autour de vous. Vous êtes énergisé par la complexité, animé par la qualité et excité par le potentiel de transformation de l'IA dans l'ingénierie logicielle moderne. • 12 à 15 ans d'expérience en génie logiciel , dont un minimum de 5 ans d'équipes d'ingénierie de premier plan dans une capacité pratique de leadership technique.

• Connaissance approfondie de l'architecture logicielle, des modèles de conception, CI/CD, DevSecOps, Kubernetes et Azure, associée à une expérience pratique en ingénierie de la plate-forme, l'observation, les tests automatisés et la conception de systèmes résistants.

Cela est possible grâce à la collaboration de plus de 15 000 employés à travers le monde.

jobs.description:
About the Role

Are you passionate about re-/insurance supervisory and regulatory topics? Do you want to be at the forefront of the relationship with our group-wide supervisor FINMA and cover the supervisory angle of everything that moves Swiss Re? We are looking for a Senior Regulatory Affairs Manager who takes a leading role in the team managing key supervisory processes and projects in collaboration with the relevant internal stakeholders, incl. senior management. In your role you will also analyze regulatory developments affecting Swiss Re's business and represent Swiss Re's interests towards regulatory expert groups and industry associations.

Your main tasks and responsibilities will include:

• Manage the relationship with FINMA together with the team and assume responsibility for supervisory requests, filings and regulatory reports.

• Lead or contribute to ad-hoc interdisciplinary teams related to projects, transactions and situations with a supervisory dimension.

• Lead the preparation of regulatory interactions such as the FINMA Supervisory College meetings, FINMA on-site inspections, regular senior level meetings, and ad-hoc exchanges.

• Contribute to and coordinate data calls, field testing exercises, or consultations.

• Identify, assess and monitor key regulatory developments and risks. Facilitate internal understanding of the impacts and subsequent preparation for upcoming regulatory requirements.

• Maintain close contact and cooperation with key internal stakeholders across Business Units, Finance, Legal & Compliance, Risk Management and other relevant internal functions.

• Support the preparation of briefing materials and presentations for members of Swiss Re's Executive Committee and/or Board of Directors.

• Contribute to and coordinate internal reports and presentation.

• Participate in specific industry events and meetings (e.g. Swiss Insurance Association) and represent Swiss Re's views as relevant.

About the Team

The Regulatory Affairs Switzerland team is responsible for managing the relationship with our group-wide supervisor FINMA and key authorities in Switzerland, ensuring constructive relationships while supporting the organization's business objectives. The team also manages risks arising from changes to existing or new regulatory and supervisory requirements that could materially affect Swiss Re.

About You

• Solid understanding of the re-/insurance regulatory framework and supervisory practice in Switzerland and/or another relevant jurisdiction.

• Proven track record in the (re)insurance industry or relevant authorities with touch points in Supervision, Regulatory, Risk Management, Finance, Legal, Compliance, or Treasury/Capital Management.

• A master's degree in either Law, Actuarial Sciences, Natural Science, Mathematics, Economics, Business Administration, Political Science or another relevant field.

• Excellent analytical skills, as well as a proven understanding of the foundations of (re)insurance and the pre-requisites required for it to be able to fulfil its role in society.

• Ability to summarise complex issues into concise memos/presentations.

• Ability to present and communicate well orally and in writing in both German and English.

• Strong interpersonal skills with experience in dealing with external stakeholders and top management.

• Strong team player, willing to share knowledge and information and who naturally brings individuals together as needed, from across countries and functions.

• Strong organisational and project management skills.

For Switzerland, the base salary range for this position is between CHF 128,000 and CHF 192,000 for a full-time role.
 The specific salary offered considers:

• The requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role

• The applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience

In the situation where you do not meet all the requirements or you significantly exceed these, the offered salary may be below or above the advertised range. In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based annual bonus.

About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
 We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Informazioni sul ruolo

Sei appassionato di supervisione di riassicurazione e temi normativi? Vuoi essere in prima linea nel rapporto con il nostro supervisore di gruppo FINMA e coprire l'angolo di supervisione di tutto ciò che muove Swiss Re? Siamo alla ricerca di un Senior Regulatory Affairs Manager che assume un ruolo di primo piano nella gestione dei processi e dei progetti di supervisione chiave in collaborazione con le pertinenti parti interessate interne, inclusa la gestione senior. Nel vostro ruolo potrete anche analizzare gli sviluppi normativi che interessano il business di Swiss Re e rappresentare gli interessi di Swiss Re verso gruppi di esperti e associazioni di settore regolamentari.

I compiti e le responsabilità principali includono:

• Gestire il rapporto con la FINMA insieme al team e assumersi la responsabilità di richieste di supervisione, archiviazione e rapporti normativi.

• Condurre o contribuire a team interdisciplinari ad hoc relativi a progetti, transazioni e situazioni con una dimensione di supervisione.

• Guidare la preparazione di interazioni normative come le riunioni del FINMA Supervisory College, le ispezioni in loco della FINMA, le riunioni regolari di livello senior e gli scambi ad-hoc.

• Contribuisci e coordina le chiamate dei dati, gli esercizi di test sul campo o le consultazioni.

• Identificare, valutare e monitorare i principali sviluppi e rischi normativi. Facilita la comprensione interna degli impatti e la successiva preparazione per i prossimi requisiti normativi.

• Mantenere stretto contatto e cooperazione con le principali parti interessate interne di Business Units, Finanza, Legale & Compliance, Risk Management e altre funzioni interne rilevanti.

• Sostenere la preparazione di materiale informativo e presentazioni per i membri del Comitato Esecutivo e/o del Consiglio di Amministrazione di Swiss Re.

• Contribuisci e coordina report e presentazione interni.

• Partecipare a specifici eventi e incontri del settore (ad esempio Swiss Insurance Association) e rappresentare le opinioni di Swiss Re come rilevanti.

Informazioni sulla squadra

Il team di Regulatory Affairs Svizzera è responsabile della gestione del rapporto con il nostro supervisore di gruppo FINMA e le autorità chiave in Svizzera, assicurando relazioni costruttive e sostenendo gli obiettivi aziendali dell'organizzazione. Il team gestisce anche i rischi derivanti dalle modifiche ai requisiti normativi e di vigilanza esistenti o nuovi che potrebbero influenzare materialmente Swiss Re.

A proposito di te

• Solida comprensione del quadro normativo di riassicurazione e della prassi di vigilanza in Svizzera e/o di un'altra giurisdizione rilevante.

• Provato il record di traccia nel (re) industria di assicurazione o autorità competenti con punti di contatto in Supervisione, Regolazione, Gestione del rischio, Finanza, Legale, Compliance, o Gestione del Tesoro / Capitale.

• Laurea Magistrale in Giurisprudenza, Scienze Actuariali, Scienze Naturali, Matematica, Economia, Business Administration, Scienze Politiche o un altro campo rilevante.

• Competenze analitiche eccellenti, nonché una comprovata comprensione delle fondazioni dell'assicurazione (re) e dei prerequisiti necessari per poter svolgere il suo ruolo nella società.

• Capacità di riassumere questioni complesse in memo/presentazioni concise.

• Capacità di presentare e comunicare bene per via orale e per iscritto sia in tedesco che in inglese.

• Forte capacità interpersonali con esperienza nel trattare con gli stakeholder esterni e la gestione superiore.

• Forte giocatore di squadra, disposto a condividere la conoscenza e le informazioni e che naturalmente riunisce le persone come necessario, da tutti i paesi e le funzioni.

• Forte capacità organizzative e di gestione dei progetti.

Per la Svizzera, la fascia salariale di base per questa posizione è compresa tra CHF 128.000 e CHF 192,000 per un ruolo a tempo pieno.
Lo stipendio specifico offerto considera:

• I requisiti, la portata, la complessità e le responsabilità del ruolo

• Il proprio profilo del richiedente, tra cui istruzione/qualifica, competenza, specializzazione, competenze ed esperienza

Nella situazione in cui non si soddisfano tutti i requisiti o si superano significativamente questi, lo stipendio offerto può essere inferiore o superiore alla gamma pubblicizzata. Oltre al tuo stipendio base, potresti essere idoneo per ulteriori ricompense e benefici, tra cui un attraente bonus annuale basato sulle prestazioni.

Informazioni su Swiss Re
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione, lavorando per rendere il mondo più resiliente. Aspettiamo e gestiamo una vasta gamma di rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine. Combinando l'esperienza con il pensiero creativo e l'esperienza all'avanguardia, creiamo nuove opportunità e soluzioni per i nostri clienti. Questo è possibile grazie alla collaborazione di oltre 15.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Abbracciamo un posto di lavoro dove ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il proprio sé autentico a lavorare e la loro passione per la sostenibilità.

Se sei un professionista esperto che torna alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.
Possiamo utilizzare strumenti basati su AI per supportare la revisione e la valutazione delle applicazioni per questa posizione. Questi strumenti forniscono ulteriori informazioni ai nostri team di reclutamento, ma tutte le decisioni di assunzione sono attentamente esaminate e fatte dalle persone. Per saperne di più su come utilizziamo l'IA nel reclutamento e come gestiamo i tuoi dati personali, si prega di rivedere la nostra Informativa sulla privacy dei dati prima di applicare.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Über die Rolle

Sie interessieren sich für aufsichtsrechtliche und regulatorische Rück-/Versicherungsthemen? Möchten Sie in der Beziehung zu unserer konzernweiten Supervisorin FINMA an vorderster Front stehen und den aufsichtsrechtlichen Blickwinkel von allem abdecken, was Swiss Re bewegt? Wir suchen einen Senior Regulatory Affairs Manager, der eine führende Rolle im Team übernimmt, das wichtige Aufsichtsprozesse und -projekte in Zusammenarbeit mit den relevanten internen Stakeholdern, einschließlich der Geschäftsleitung, verwaltet. In Ihrer Funktion analysieren Sie auch regulatorische Entwicklungen, die sich auf das Geschäft von Swiss Re auswirken und vertreten die Interessen von Swiss Re gegenüber regulatorischen Expertengruppen und Branchenverbänden.

Ihre Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten umfassen:

• Verwalten Sie die Beziehung zur FINMA gemeinsam mit dem Team und übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für aufsichtliche Anfragen, Einreichungen und regulatorische Berichte.

• Leitung oder Beitrag zu interdisziplinären Ad-hoc-Teams im Zusammenhang mit Projekten, Transaktionen und Situationen mit Aufsichtsdimension.

• Führen Sie die Vorbereitung von regulatorischen Interaktionen wie Sitzungen des FINMA-Aufsichtskollegiums, Inspektionen vor Ort, regelmäßige Sitzungen auf höherer Ebene und Ad-hoc-Austausch.

• Tragen Sie zu Datenanrufen, Feldversuchen oder Konsultationen bei und koordinieren Sie diese.

• Ermittlung, Bewertung und Überwachung der wichtigsten regulatorischen Entwicklungen und Risiken. Erleichterung des internen Verständnisses der Auswirkungen und der anschließenden Vorbereitung auf bevorstehende regulatorische Anforderungen.

• Pflegen Sie engen Kontakt und Zusammenarbeit mit wichtigen internen Stakeholdern in den Geschäftsbereichen, Finanzen, Legal & Compliance, Risikomanagement und anderen relevanten internen Funktionen.

• Unterstützung bei der Erstellung von Briefing-Materialien und Präsentationen für Mitglieder des Executive Committee und/oder des Board of Directors von Swiss Re.

• Beitragen und koordinieren Sie interne Berichte und Präsentationen.

• Nehmen Sie an spezifischen Branchenveranstaltungen und -treffen teil (z. B. Schweizerischer Versicherungsverband) und vertreten Sie die Ansichten von Swiss Re als relevant.

Über das Team

Das Team von Regulatory Affairs Switzerland ist verantwortlich für die Verwaltung der Beziehungen zu unserer konzernweiten Aufsichtsinstanz FINMA und den wichtigsten Behörden in der Schweiz, um konstruktive Beziehungen zu gewährleisten und gleichzeitig die Geschäftsziele der Organisation zu unterstützen. Das Team steuert auch Risiken, die sich aus Änderungen bestehender oder neuer regulatorischer und aufsichtlicher Anforderungen ergeben, die sich wesentlich auf Swiss Re auswirken könnten.

Über dich

• Fundiertes Verständnis des regulatorischen Rahmens und der Aufsichtspraxis in der Schweiz und/oder einer anderen relevanten Gerichtsbarkeit.

• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz in der (Rück-)Versicherungsbranche oder relevanten Behörden mit Berührungspunkten in Aufsicht, Regulierung, Risikomanagement, Finanzen, Recht, Compliance oder Treasury / Capital Management.

• Ein Master-Abschluss in Rechtswissenschaften, Versicherungsmathematischen Wissenschaften, Naturwissenschaften, Mathematik, Wirtschaft, Betriebswirtschaft, Politikwissenschaft oder einem anderen relevanten Bereich.

• Hervorragende analytische Fähigkeiten sowie ein nachgewiesenes Verständnis der Grundlagen der (Rück-)Versicherung und der Voraussetzungen, die erforderlich sind, um ihre Rolle in der Gesellschaft erfüllen zu können.

• Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen in kurzen Memos / Präsentationen zusammenzufassen.

• Fähigkeit, mündlich und schriftlich in deutscher und englischer Sprache gut zu präsentieren und zu kommunizieren.

• Starke zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten mit Erfahrung im Umgang mit externen Stakeholdern und Top-Management.

• Starker Teamplayer, der bereit ist, Wissen und Informationen zu teilen, und der bei Bedarf Einzelpersonen aus verschiedenen Ländern und Funktionen zusammenbringt.

• Starke Organisations- und Projektmanagementfähigkeiten.

Für die Schweiz liegt die Grundgehaltsspanne für diese Stelle zwischen CHF 128.000 und CHF 192.000 für eine Vollzeitstelle.
Das angebotene spezifische Gehalt berücksichtigt:

• Anforderungen, Umfang, Komplexität und Verantwortlichkeiten der Rolle

• Eigenes Profil des Antragstellers, einschließlich Ausbildung/Qualifikationen, Fachwissen, Spezialisierung, Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung

Wenn Sie nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllen oder diese deutlich übertreffen, kann das angebotene Gehalt unter oder über dem angegebenen Bereich liegen. Zusätzlich zu Ihrem Grundgehalt haben Sie möglicherweise Anspruch auf zusätzliche Belohnungen und Vorteile, einschließlich eines attraktiven leistungsbezogenen Jahresbonus.

Über Swiss Re
Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen des versicherungsbasierten Risikotransfers und arbeitet daran, die Welt widerstandsfähiger zu machen. Wir antizipieren und managen eine Vielzahl von Risiken, von Naturkatastrophen und Klimawandel bis hin zu Cyberkriminalität. Durch die Kombination von Erfahrung mit kreativem Denken und modernster Expertise schaffen wir neue Möglichkeiten und Lösungen für unsere Kunden. Dies ist dank der Zusammenarbeit von mehr als 15.000 Mitarbeitern auf der ganzen Welt möglich.

Unser Erfolg hängt von unserer Fähigkeit ab, eine integrative Kultur aufzubauen, die neue Perspektiven und innovatives Denken fördert. Wir nehmen einen Arbeitsplatz an, an dem jeder die gleichen Chancen hat, beruflich zu gedeihen und sich zu entwickeln, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Rasse, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Geschlechtsidentität und / oder Ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, körperlicher oder geistiger Fähigkeit, Fähigkeiten, Gedanken oder anderen Eigenschaften. In unserem integrativen und flexiblen Umfeld kann jeder sein authentisches Selbst und seine Leidenschaft für Nachhaltigkeit mitbringen.

Wenn Sie ein erfahrener Profi sind, der nach einer Berufspause in die Belegschaft zurückkehrt, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich für offene Stellen zu bewerben, die Ihren Fähigkeiten und Ihrer Erfahrung entsprechen.
Wir können KI-basierte Tools verwenden, um die Überprüfung und Bewertung von Anwendungen für diese Position zu unterstützen. Diese Tools bieten unseren Rekrutierungsteams zusätzliche Einblicke, aber alle Einstellungsentscheidungen werden sorgfältig überprüft und von Menschen getroffen. Um mehr darüber zu erfahren, wie wir KI bei der Rekrutierung einsetzen und wie wir mit Ihren personenbezogenen Daten umgehen, lesen Sie bitte unsere Datenschutzerklärung, bevor Sie sich bewerben.

À propos du rôle

Êtes-vous passionné par les questions de supervision et de réglementation de la réassurance/assurance? Voulez-vous être à l'avant-garde de la relation avec notre superviseur de groupe FINMA et couvrir l'angle de supervision de tout ce qui bouge Swiss Re? Nous sommes à la recherche d'un gestionnaire principal des affaires réglementaires qui assume un rôle de premier plan dans l'équipe qui gère les principaux processus et projets de supervision en collaboration avec les intervenants internes pertinents, y compris la haute direction. Dans votre rôle, vous analyserez également les évolutions réglementaires affectant les activités de Swiss Re et représenterez les intérêts de Swiss Re auprès de groupes d'experts en réglementation et d'associations industrielles.

Vos principales tâches et responsabilités seront les suivantes :

• Gérer la relation avec la FINMA avec l'équipe et assumer la responsabilité des demandes de supervision, des dépôts et des rapports réglementaires.

• Diriger ou contribuer à des équipes interdisciplinaires ad hoc liées à des projets, des transactions et des situations ayant une dimension de supervision.

• Diriger la préparation des interactions réglementaires telles que les réunions du Collège de supervision de la FINMA, les inspections sur place de la FINMA, les réunions régulières de haut niveau et les échanges spéciaux.

• Contribuer et coordonner les appels de données, les exercices d'essais sur le terrain ou les consultations.

• Identifier, évaluer et surveiller les principaux développements et risques réglementaires. Faciliter la compréhension interne des répercussions et la préparation subséquente des exigences réglementaires à venir.

• Maintenir des contacts étroits et une collaboration étroite avec les principaux intervenants internes des unités opérationnelles, des finances, des services juridiques et de la conformité, de la gestion des risques et d'autres fonctions internes pertinentes.

• Appuyer la préparation de documents d'information et de présentations pour les membres du Comité exécutif et/ou du Conseil d'administration de Swiss Re.

• Contribuer et coordonner les rapports internes et la présentation.

• Participer à des événements et réunions spécifiques du secteur (par exemple l'Association suisse des assurances) et représenter les points de vue de Swiss Re comme pertinents.

À propos de l'équipe

L'équipe Regulatory Affairs Switzerland est chargée de gérer les relations avec notre superviseur de groupe FINMA et les principales autorités suisses, en assurant des relations constructives tout en soutenant les objectifs de l'organisation. L'équipe gère également les risques découlant des modifications des exigences réglementaires et de surveillance existantes ou nouvelles qui pourraient avoir une incidence importante sur Swiss Re.

À propos de toi

• Une bonne compréhension du cadre réglementaire et de la pratique de surveillance en Suisse et/ou dans une autre juridiction pertinente.

• Antécédents prouvés dans l'industrie (re)assurance ou les autorités compétentes avec des points de contact dans la supervision, la réglementation, la gestion des risques, les finances, la législation, la conformité ou la gestion du Trésor/du capital.

• Maîtrise en droit, sciences actuarielles, sciences naturelles, mathématiques, économie, administration des affaires, sciences politiques ou autre domaine pertinent.

• Excellentes compétences analytiques, ainsi qu'une compréhension éprouvée des fondements de la (re)assurance et des conditions préalables nécessaires pour qu'elle puisse remplir son rôle dans la société.

• Capacité de résumer des questions complexes en notes/présentations concises.

• Capacité de présenter et de communiquer bien oralement et par écrit en allemand et en anglais.

• Fortes compétences interpersonnelles avec l'expérience de traiter avec les intervenants externes et la haute direction.

• Joueur d'équipe fort, prêt à partager les connaissances et l'information et qui rassemble naturellement les individus au besoin, de tous les pays et fonctions.

• Forte capacité d'organisation et de gestion de projet.

Pour la Suisse, l'échelle de salaire de base pour ce poste se situe entre CHF 128 000 et CHF 192 000 pour un rôle à temps plein.
Le salaire spécifique offert tient compte:

• Exigences, portée, complexité et responsabilités du rôle

• Profil propre du candidat, y compris éducation/qualifications, expertise, spécialisation, compétences et expérience

Si vous ne répondez pas à toutes les exigences ou si vous les dépassez considérablement, le salaire offert peut être inférieur ou supérieur à la fourchette annoncée. En plus de votre salaire de base, vous pourriez être admissible à des récompenses et des avantages supplémentaires, y compris une prime annuelle axée sur le rendement attrayante.

À propos de Swiss Re
Suisse Re est l'un des principaux fournisseurs de réassurance, d'assurance et d'autres formes de transfert de risque fondé sur l'assurance, travaillant à rendre le monde plus résilient. Nous anticipons et gérons une grande variété de risques, des catastrophes naturelles et du changement climatique à la cybercriminalité. Lead AI Developer

About the Role

As a Lead AI Developer , you will play a key role in shaping and delivering AI-enabled solutions that transform how engineering teams, business users, and cross-functional stakeholders work across Property & Casualty Reinsurance.

You will be responsible for designing, building, and scaling AI-powered applications, agentic workflows, intelligent automation capabilities, and enterprise-ready GenAI solutions. The role requires a strong hands-on engineering mindset, deep technical understanding of modern AI platforms, and the ability to convert business and engineering challenges into practical, secure, scalable, and reusable AI solutions.

This is not only a development role. You will act as a technical lead and AI engineering SME, helping teams adopt AI responsibly across the software delivery lifecycle, business processes, knowledge discovery, decision support, and productivity improvement use cases. You will work closely with product owners, architects, engineering teams, data specialists, business stakeholders, and platform teams to identify high-value opportunities and deliver solutions that are reliable, measurable, and aligned with Swiss Re’s engineering and governance standards.

You will also help establish patterns, standards, guardrails, reusable components, and best practices that enable AI adoption across multiple P&C Re teams and domains.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead the design and development of scalable AI-powered applications, GenAI solutions, intelligent assistants, and agentic workflows for P&C Re.

• Build enterprise-grade AI capabilities using modern technologies such as Python, Java, TypeScript, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, GitHub Copilot, LangChain, Palantir, Semantic Kernel, or similar frameworks.

• Design and implement AI solutions that support practical business and engineering use cases such as knowledge discovery, document intelligence, process automation, engineering productivity, code assistance, testing support, operational insights, and decision support.

• Architect and implement robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation solutions, including data ingestion, chunking strategies, embeddings, vector search, prompt orchestration, grounding, source attribution, and response quality controls.

• Develop and integrate AI agents and LLM-based workflows with enterprise systems such as Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, Palantir Foundry, Databricks, internal APIs, and business applications where applicable.

• Collaborate with product owners, business SMEs, architects, data engineers, platform teams, and engineering squads to understand business needs and translate them into secure, scalable, and maintainable AI solutions.

• Establish strong engineering practices for AI development, including prompt design, evaluation frameworks, automated testing, observability, monitoring, versioning, CI/CD, and production support.

• Implement responsible AI practices, including human-in-the-loop controls, access management, data protection, explainability, validation checks, auditability, and alignment with Swiss Re governance standards.

• Lead technical troubleshooting for complex AI solution issues, including model behavior, hallucination risk, grounding gaps, latency, integration failures, data quality issues, and production reliability concerns.

• Evaluate and recommend new AI technologies, frameworks, engineering tools, and platform capabilities that can improve productivity, quality, scalability, and business value.

• Mentor developers and engineers on AI development patterns, prompt engineering, agentic development, secure integration, testing approaches, and responsible AI practices.

• Create and maintain technical specifications, architecture documents, reusable patterns, implementation guides, runbooks, and engineering best practices for AI solution delivery.

• Act as an AI Engineering SME across multiple P&C Re teams, supporting adoption, enabling teams, reviewing solution designs, and helping establish common engineering standards.

• Contribute to the broader AI adoption journey in P&C Re by identifying high-impact use cases, supporting pilots, sharing learnings, and helping scale successful solutions across teams.

About the Team

We are a team that believes in engineering excellence, practical innovation, and responsible use of technology. Our leaders are expected to stay close to engineering and lead by example through strong technical judgement, hands-on contribution, and high-quality delivery.

In P&C Re, AI is becoming an important part of how we improve engineering productivity, business processes, decision support, and user experience. We are focused on applying AI where it creates real value, with clear guardrails, strong ownership, and close collaboration between business and technology teams.

Quality, stability, security, and responsible delivery are first-class expectations in everything we do. We work closely with product owners, business stakeholders, architects, engineers, data specialists, and platform teams to build solutions that are thoughtfully designed, well-engineered, and sustainable over time.

About You

You are an experienced AI-focused engineer who enjoys solving complex problems and turning emerging technologies into practical, enterprise-ready solutions. You are hands-on, curious, collaborative, and comfortable working across engineering, architecture, product, and business teams.

You understand that successful AI adoption is about integrating an LLM. It requires strong software engineering, reliable data flows, thoughtful user experience, responsible AI controls, measurable outcomes, and continuous learning from real usage.

You are comfortable leading technical discussions, making architecture decisions, mentoring engineers, and helping teams adopt new ways of working. You are pragmatic, outcome-oriented, and able to balance innovation with security, governance, maintainability, and delivery discipline.

Minimum Requirements

We are looking for candidates who meet these minimum requirements:

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field, with 12+ years of software engineering experience , including significant hands-on experience in AI, GenAI, automation, or intelligent application development.

• Strong hands-on development experience in one or more programming languages such as Python, Java, or TypeScript , with the ability to build production-grade applications and services.

• Proven experience designing and delivering AI-powered applications, LLM-based solutions, intelligent assistants, automation capabilities, or agentic workflows in an enterprise environment.

• Strong understanding of modern GenAI concepts such as prompt engineering, function calling, tool usage, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, grounding, semantic search, AI agents, orchestration, and evaluation.

• Experience with AI and cloud platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure services, GitHub Copilot, Palantir Foundry AIP, Databricks, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or similar platforms .

• Strong software engineering foundation, including API design, microservices, integration patterns, secure coding, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, and production support.

• Experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise data sources, internal applications, APIs, document repositories, workflow systems, knowledge bases, or engineering platforms.

• Ability to design scalable and secure solution architectures for AI use cases, including access control, data privacy, auditability, monitoring, and responsible AI guardrails.

• Experience implementing quality and reliability practices for AI solutions, including response evaluation, regression testing, hallucination mitigation, traceability, feedback loops, and performance monitoring.

• Strong understanding of data structures, data pipelines, APIs, metadata, and enterprise information architecture required to support AI applications.

• Proven ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues across application code, AI model behavior, data quality, integrations, infrastructure, and user workflows.

• Strong experience partnering with product owners, architects, business stakeholders, data engineers, analysts, and engineering teams to translate business needs into practical AI-enabled solutions.

• Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives, make architectural decisions, mentor engineers, define engineering standards, and promote reusable best practices across teams.

• Demonstrated ability to act as an AI Engineering SME across multiple teams, projects, or business domains, with the ability to influence engineering practices beyond a single delivery team.

• Ability to evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend practical improvements to enterprise platforms, tools, engineering workflows, and delivery practices.

• Strong documentation skills, including the ability to create architecture documents, technical specifications, implementation guidance, process documents, standards, and reusable playbooks.

Nice-to-Have Requirements

These are additional nice-to-have requirements:

• Experience with agentic AI development , including multi-step workflows, tool-using agents, task decomposition, autonomous execution patterns, and human approval flows.

• Experience with software engineering productivity use cases , such as AI-assisted code generation, code review, test case generation, documentation generation, vulnerability analysis, CI/CD troubleshooting, and SDLC automation.

• Experience with document intelligence , including extraction, classification, summarization, semantic search, and knowledge management use cases.

• Experience with Palantir Foundry, Foundry AIP, Azure Databricks, or similar enterprise platforms for data integration, workflow orchestration, and AI-enabled business solutions.

• Experience with vector databases and search technologies such as Azure AI Search, OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, Chroma, or similar.

• Experience with orchestration and AI engineering frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, or comparable tools.

• Experience with MLOps, LLMOps, model evaluation, prompt lifecycle management, AI observability, model monitoring, and AI governance practices.

• Experience with cloud-native development on Azure, AWS, or GCP, including containers, serverless services, identity management, networking, logging, and monitoring.

• Experience with workflow orchestration, DevOps, and CI/CD practices for AI-enabled applications.

• Experience with data visualization or insight delivery tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Streamlit, or similar.

• Familiarity with frontend development and user experience design for AI-enabled applications, including React, Angular, TypeScript, or similar technologies.

•  Experience working in insurance, reinsurance, underwriting, claims, risk management, finance, or other regulated enterprise environments.

About Swiss Re
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
 We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.
