Vous apportez un esprit juridique ou contractuel aigu associé à une véritable curiosité sur les dimensions commerciales et de risque de la réassurance traditionnelle. Vous êtes à l'aise de travailler de façon indépendante, de naviguer dans l'ambiguïté et de vous engager directement auprès des intervenants et des clients chevronnés. Vous êtes fier de produire un travail précis, raisonné et adapté à vos besoins — et vous êtes stimulé par la complexité et la variété qui caractérisent le travail sur divers marchés et structures de négociation.
Nous cherchons des candidats qui répondent à ces exigences :

• Capacité éprouvée de rédiger et d' examiner individuellement des contrats complexes de réassurance ou d' assurance , y compris la documentation conventionnelle ou des accords de services financiers équivalents

• Expérience en réassurance vie & santé ou sur des marchés plus larges d' assurance / réassurance , avec une solide compréhension des structures de réassurance et des concepts de souscription

• Une bonne capacité de jugement commercial et d'évaluation des risques , avec la capacité d'identifier les risques contractuels et d'appliquer des positions appropriées dans les cadres établis

• Expérience de la collaboration directe avec les clients dans les discussions sur les contrats ou les négociations de formulation

• Familiarité avec les outils de workflow, les plateformes de gestion des contrats et le confort grâce à la technologie, y compris GenAI dans le travail quotidien
Ceux-ci sont supplémentaires agréables à avoir:

• Contexte d'un réassureur, d'un assureur, d'une équipe juridique interne ou d'un cabinet d'avocats en situation de réassurance ou de contrats financiers complexes

• Exposition aux environnements réglementaires des assurances aux États-Unis, au Canada ou aux Caraïbes
L'échelle salariale de base estimative pour ce poste pour Fort Wayne, IN; Chicago, IL et Kansas City, MO est de 80 000 $ à 120 000 $, et pour Armonk, NY, l'échelle est de 88 000 $ à 132 000 $. We are considering candidates who are already living in these metro areas.
 Are you a seasoned claims professional with a passion for complex financial lines and a drive to deliver exceptional client experiences? At Swiss Re Corporate Solutions, we're looking for a sharp, collaborative, and client-focused specialist to join our dynamic US Casualty and Financial Lines Claims team. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment where no two claims are the same, this could be the opportunity you've been waiting for!

About the Role
 This is a rare and exciting opportunity to take ownership of a diverse portfolio of financial lines claims — from directors and officers liability to fiduciary and employment practices — while working alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry. You'll bring your expertise to bear from first notice all the way through to resolution, all while collaborating across underwriting, products, and international teams to deliver market-leading outcomes for our clients.
 Key Responsibilities

• Actively manage a portfolio of directors and officers, fiduciary, and/or employment practices liability claims with full end-to-end adjudication responsibility

• Navigate confidently across both primary and excess insurance claim environments, applying sound judgment and technical expertise

• Collaborate closely with customers and brokers to achieve the most advantageous and timely claim resolutions

• Partner with the Operations team to ensure effective claim administration, process efficiency, and accurate data integrity

• Engage proactively with Client Markets teams and support business development efforts through client meetings and industry events

• Deliver high-level analysis of claims portfolio results, identifying trends and providing actionable insights to the business

• Contribute to product development by reviewing, supporting, and assisting in the creation of policy wordings and tailored client solutions

• Liaise with Actuarial, Finance, and Risk Management colleagues to share information and support the holistic management of claims, clients, and risks

• Represent Swiss Re Corporate Solutions at industry conferences, client events, and professional society functions, promoting our brand and capabilities

• Collaborate with international colleagues across regions, providing valuable insight into US trends and exposures

About the Team
 Swiss Re is one of the world's leading providers of reinsurance, insurance, and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks — from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.
 Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group. We offer innovative insurance solutions to large and midsized multinational corporations from approximately 50 locations worldwide. We help clients mitigate their risk exposure, whilst our industry-leading claims service provides them with additional peace of mind.
 Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture that encourages fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions embraces a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought, or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment, everyone can bring their authentic selves to work.

About You
 You are a motivated, detail-oriented claims professional who takes pride in delivering exceptional service and sound adjudication. You bring strong analytical thinking, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively across a wide range of stakeholders. You're comfortable representing the company externally and are eager to contribute to a high-performing, inclusive team culture.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Financial Lines Claims Experience: Demonstrated experience handling Financial Lines claims, including directors and officers, fiduciary, and/or employment practices liability

• Adjudication Expertise: Strong analytical, negotiation, and influencing skills with the ability to independently manage claims from first notice to resolution

• Licensing: Currently holds or is willing to acquire adjuster licenses as required across various jurisdictions

• Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey complex information to diverse audiences

• Educational Background: A university degree or equivalent is required

These are additional nice to haves:

• Legal Background: A law degree or legal training is highly desirable and would be a strong asset in this role

• Primary & Excess Environments: Experience navigating both primary and excess insurance claim environments

• Stakeholder Engagement: Proven ability to engage with clients, brokers, and internal business partners at a senior level

• Portfolio Analysis: Experience providing high-level portfolio analysis and identifying claims trends to inform business strategy

• Cross-functional Collaboration: Experience working with Actuarial, Finance, Risk Management, or Underwriting teams

• Industry Presence: Comfort representing an organization at industry conferences, client events, and professional society functions

• International Exposure: Experience working with or providing guidance to international teams on US-specific trends and exposures

• Self-Starter Mindset: Ability to work with minimal direct supervision while managing a complex and varied workload

• Travel Flexibility: Willingness to travel approximately 5–10% of the time

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.
 The estimated base salary range for this position in Kansas City or Chicago is $69,000 to $115,000. The estimated base salary range for this position in NYC is $75,000 to $125,000. The specific salary offered for this, or any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short-and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.

About Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group. We offer innovative insurance solutions to large and midsized multinational corporations from our approximately 50 locations worldwide. We help clients mitigate their risk exposure, whilst our industry-leading claims service provides them with additional peace of mind.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions embraces a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

Swiss Re is an equal opportunity employer. It is our practice to recruit, hire and promote without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, pregnancy, sexual orientations, marital status, military status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Decisions on employment are solely based on an individual's qualifications for the position being filled.

During the recruitment process, reasonable accommodations for disabilities are available upon request. If contacted for an interview, please inform the Recruiter/HR Professional of the accommodation needed.

We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Stiamo considerando i candidati che stanno già vivendo in queste aree della metropolitana.
Sei un professionista esperto di rivendicazioni con una passione per linee finanziarie complesse e un desiderio di offrire esperienze cliente eccezionali? In Swiss Re Corporate Solutions, stiamo cercando uno specialista acuto, collaborativo e focalizzato sul cliente per unire il nostro team di business US Casualty and Financial Lines Claims. Se prosperi in un ambiente frenetico dove non ci sono due affermazioni uguali, questa potrebbe essere l'opportunità che stai aspettando!

Informazioni sul ruolo
Si tratta di una rara ed entusiasmante opportunità di prendere possesso di un portafoglio diversificato di crediti di linee finanziarie — da amministratori e responsabili di responsabilità a pratiche fiduciarie e di occupazione — mentre si lavora accanto ad alcune delle menti più brillanti del settore. Porterai la tua esperienza a sopportare dal primo avviso fino alla risoluzione, il tutto collaborando tra sottoscrizione, prodotti e team internazionali per fornire risultati leader di mercato per i nostri clienti.
Principali responsabilità

• Gestire attivamente un portafoglio di amministratori e funzionari, fiduciari e/o pratiche di lavoro rivendicazioni di responsabilità con piena responsabilità di adjudication end-to-end

• Navigare con fiducia in ambienti di rivendicazione assicurativa primaria e in eccesso, applicando giudizio sano e competenze tecniche

• Collaborare a stretto contatto con i clienti e i broker per ottenere le risoluzioni di reclamo più vantaggiose e tempestive

• Partner con il team Operazioni per garantire un'efficace gestione dei reclami, efficienza dei processi e integrità dei dati accurata

• Impegnarsi in modo proattivo con i team dei Mercati del Cliente e sostenere gli sforzi di sviluppo aziendale attraverso riunioni dei clienti e eventi del settore

• Fornire un'analisi di alto livello dei risultati del portafoglio crediti, identificare le tendenze e fornire informazioni attuabili al business

• Contribuisci allo sviluppo del prodotto esaminando, supportando e aiutando nella creazione di wording policy e soluzioni client su misura

• Liaise with Actuarial, Finance e Risk Management colleghi per condividere informazioni e sostenere la gestione olistica di reclami, clienti e rischi

• Rappresentare Swiss Re Corporate Solutions nelle conferenze del settore, negli eventi dei clienti e nelle funzioni della società professionale, promuovendo il nostro marchio e le nostre capacità

• Collabora con colleghi internazionali in tutte le regioni, fornendo preziose informazioni sulle tendenze e le esposizioni degli Stati Uniti

Informazioni sulla squadra
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione. Prevediamo e gestiamo i rischi — dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine.
Swiss Re Corporate Solutions è il braccio di assicurazione commerciale del Gruppo Swiss Re. Offriamo soluzioni di assicurazione innovative a grandi e medie aziende multinazionali da circa 50 sedi in tutto il mondo. Aiutiamo i clienti a mitigare la loro esposizione al rischio, mentre il nostro servizio di reclami leader del settore fornisce loro un'ulteriore pace della mente.
Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions abbraccia un luogo di lavoro in cui ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile, ognuno può portare il proprio sé autentico al lavoro.

A proposito di te
Sei un professionista di rivendicazioni motivato e orientato al dettaglio che si vanta di fornire un servizio eccezionale e un giudizio sonoro. Porti un forte pensiero analitico, eccellenti capacità di comunicazione e la capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e collaborativo in una vasta gamma di stakeholder. Sei a tuo agio a rappresentare l'azienda esternamente e sono desiderosi di contribuire a una cultura di squadra altamente performante e inclusiva.
Siamo alla ricerca di candidati che soddisfano questi requisiti:

• Financial Lines Claims Experience: Esperienza dimostrata che gestisce le richieste di Financial Lines, inclusi amministratori e funzionari, fiduciari e/o pratiche di lavoro

• Adjudication Competenza: Forte analitica, negoziazione, e influenzando le competenze con la capacità di gestire in modo indipendente i reclami dalla prima comunicazione alla risoluzione

• Licensing: Attualmente detiene o è disposto ad acquisire licenze di adattamento come richiesto in varie giurisdizioni

• Competenze di comunicazione: Eccellente capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta, con la capacità di trasmettere chiaramente informazioni complesse a un pubblico diverso

• Sfondo educativo: una laurea o equivalente è richiesto

Questi sono ulteriori bello da avere:

• Sfondo giuridico: una laurea in diritto o una formazione legale è altamente auspicabile e sarebbe un bene forte in questo ruolo

• Ambienti primari ed eccessivi: esperienza di navigazione in ambienti di rivendicazione primaria e in eccesso

• Stakeholder Engagement: comprovata capacità di interagire con clienti, broker e partner commerciali interni a livello senior

• Analisi Portfolio: Esperienza che fornisce analisi di portafoglio di alto livello e identifica le tendenze dei crediti per informare la strategia aziendale

• Collaborazione interfunzionale: esperienza di lavoro con le squadre di Actuarial, Finance, Risk Management o Underwriting

• Presenza del settore: Comfort che rappresenta un'organizzazione a conferenze del settore, eventi del cliente e funzioni della società professionale

• Esposizione Internazionale: Esperienza di lavoro con o fornire una guida ai team internazionali sulle tendenze e le esposizioni specifiche degli Stati Uniti

• Self-Starter Mindset: Capacità di lavorare con una minima supervisione diretta, gestendo un carico di lavoro complesso e vario

• Flessibilità di viaggio: Volontà di viaggiare circa il 5–10% del tempo

La nostra azienda ha un modello di lavoro ibrido in cui l'aspettativa è che sarete in ufficio almeno tre giorni alla settimana.
Il range di stipendio base stimato per questa posizione a Kansas City o Chicago è $69,000 a $115,000. Il range di stipendio base stimato per questa posizione a New York è di $ 75.000 a $125,000. Lo stipendio specifico offerto per questo, o qualsiasi dato ruolo terrà conto di un certo numero di fattori, tra cui, ma non solo, la posizione del lavoro, la portata del ruolo, le qualifiche, la complessità/specializzazione/scarsità del talento, l'esperienza, l'istruzione e il bilancio del datore di lavoro. A Swiss Re, prendiamo un "approccio di compensazione totale" quando prendiamo decisioni di risarcimento. Ciò significa che consideriamo tutti i componenti di compensazione nella loro totalità (come la retribuzione base, gli incentivi a breve e a lungo termine e i benefici offerti), nella definizione di una compensazione individuale.

Informazioni su Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione. Prevediamo e gestiamo i rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions è il braccio di assicurazione commerciale del Gruppo Swiss Re. Offriamo soluzioni di assicurazione innovative a grandi e medie multinazionali dalle nostre circa 50 sedi in tutto il mondo. Aiutiamo i clienti a mitigare la loro esposizione al rischio, mentre il nostro servizio di reclami leader del settore fornisce loro un'ulteriore pace della mente.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions abbraccia un posto di lavoro in cui ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il proprio sé autentico a lavorare e la loro passione per la sostenibilità.

Se sei un professionista esperto che torna alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.

Svizzera Re è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. È la nostra pratica di reclutare, assumere e promuovere senza riguardo a razza, religione, colore, origine nazionale, sesso, disabilità, età, gravidanza, orientamento sessuale, stato civile, stato militare, o qualsiasi altra caratteristica protetta dalla legge. Le decisioni sull'occupazione si basano esclusivamente sulle qualifiche di un individuo per la posizione in essere.

Durante il processo di reclutamento, su richiesta sono disponibili sistemazioni ragionevoli per disabili. Se contattato per un colloquio, si prega di informare il Recruiter/HR Professional dell'alloggio necessario.

Possiamo utilizzare strumenti basati su AI per supportare la revisione e la valutazione delle applicazioni per questa posizione. Questi strumenti forniscono ulteriori informazioni ai nostri team di reclutamento, ma tutte le decisioni di assunzione sono attentamente esaminate e fatte dalle persone. Per saperne di più su come utilizziamo l'IA nel reclutamento e come gestiamo i tuoi dati personali, si prega di rivedere la nostra Informativa sulla privacy dei dati prima di applicare.

• Educational Background: A university degree or equivalent is required

These are additional nice to haves:

• Legal Background: A law degree or legal training is highly desirable and would be a strong asset in this role

• Primary & Excess Environments: Experience navigating both primary and excess insurance claim environments

• Stakeholder Engagement: Proven ability to engage with clients, brokers, and internal business partners at a senior level

• Portfolio Analysis: Experience providing high-level portfolio analysis and identifying claims trends to inform business strategy

• Cross-functional Collaboration: Experience working with Actuarial, Finance, Risk Management, or Underwriting teams

• Industry Presence: Comfort representing an organization at industry conferences, client events, and professional society functions

• International Exposure: Experience working with or providing guidance to international teams on US-specific trends and exposures

• Self-Starter Mindset: Ability to work with minimal direct supervision while managing a complex and varied workload

• Travel Flexibility: Willingness to travel approximately 5–10% of the time

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.
The estimated base salary range for this position in Kansas City or Chicago is $69,000 to $115,000. The estimated base salary range for this position in NYC is $75,000 to $125,000. The specific salary offered for this, or any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short-and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.

About Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group. We offer innovative insurance solutions to large and midsized multinational corporations from our approximately 50 locations worldwide. We help clients mitigate their risk exposure, whilst our industry-leading claims service provides them with additional peace of mind.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions embraces a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

Swiss Re is an equal opportunity employer. It is our practice to recruit, hire and promote without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, pregnancy, sexual orientations, marital status, military status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Decisions on employment are solely based on an individual's qualifications for the position being filled.

During the recruitment process, reasonable accommodations for disabilities are available upon request. If contacted for an interview, please inform the Recruiter/HR Professional of the accommodation needed.

We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Wir denken über Kandidaten nach, die bereits in diesen U-Bahn-Gebieten leben.
Sind Sie ein erfahrener Claim-Profi mit einer Leidenschaft für komplexe Finanzlinien und dem Antrieb, außergewöhnliche Kundenerfahrungen zu liefern? Bei Swiss Re Corporate Solutions suchen wir einen scharfen, kollaborativen und kundenorientierten Spezialisten, der sich unserem dynamischen US-Casualty- und Financial Lines Claims-Team anschließt. Wenn Sie in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung gedeihen, in der keine zwei Ansprüche gleich sind, könnte dies die Gelegenheit sein, auf die Sie gewartet haben!

Über die Rolle
Dies ist eine seltene und aufregende Gelegenheit, ein vielfältiges Portfolio von Forderungen aus Finanzlinien zu übernehmen - von der Haftung von Direktoren und Führungskräften bis hin zu Treuhand- und Beschäftigungspraktiken - während sie mit einigen der klügsten Köpfe der Branche zusammenarbeiten. Sie bringen Ihre Expertise von der ersten Ankündigung bis hin zur Lösung ein, während Sie über Underwriting, Produkte und internationale Teams zusammenarbeiten, um marktführende Ergebnisse für unsere Kunden zu liefern.
Hauptzuständigkeiten

• Aktives Verwalten eines Portfolios von Direktoren und leitenden Angestellten, Treuhand- und / oder Beschäftigungspraktiken mit voller End-to-End-Entscheidungsverantwortung

• Navigieren Sie selbstbewusst durch primäre und überschüssige Versicherungsansprüche und wenden Sie ein fundiertes Urteilsvermögen und technisches Fachwissen an

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden und Brokern, um die vorteilhaftesten und zeitnahsten Schadensbeschlüsse zu erzielen

• Zusammenarbeit mit dem Operations-Team, um eine effektive Schadensverwaltung, Prozesseffizienz und genaue Datenintegrität zu gewährleisten

• Engagieren Sie sich proaktiv mit Client Markets-Teams und unterstützen Sie die Geschäftsentwicklung durch Kundentreffen und Branchenveranstaltungen

• Bereitstellung einer hochrangigen Analyse der Ergebnisse des Schadenportfolios, Identifizierung von Trends und Bereitstellung umsetzbarer Erkenntnisse für das Geschäft

• Beitrag zur Produktentwicklung durch Überprüfung, Unterstützung und Unterstützung bei der Erstellung von Richtlinientexten und maßgeschneiderten Kundenlösungen

• Verbindung mit versicherungsmathematischen, Finanz- und Risikomanagement-Kollegen, um Informationen auszutauschen und das ganzheitliche Management von Ansprüchen, Kunden und Risiken zu unterstützen

• Vertretung von Swiss Re Corporate Solutions bei Branchenkonferenzen, Kundenveranstaltungen und Funktionen der Fachgesellschaft, Förderung unserer Marke und unserer Fähigkeiten

• Arbeiten Sie mit internationalen Kollegen in allen Regionen zusammen und bieten Sie wertvolle Einblicke in die Trends und Expositionen in den USA

Über das Team
Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen der versicherungsbasierten Risikoübertragung. Wir antizipieren und managen Risiken – von Naturkatastrophen und Klimawandel bis hin zu Cyberkriminalität.
Swiss Re Corporate Solutions ist der gewerbliche Versicherungszweig der Swiss Re Gruppe. Wir bieten innovative Versicherungslösungen für große und mittlere multinationale Konzerne von rund 50 Standorten weltweit. Wir helfen Kunden, ihre Risikoexposition zu mindern, während unser branchenführender Schadenservice ihnen zusätzliche Sicherheit bietet.
Unser Erfolg hängt von unserer Fähigkeit ab, eine integrative Kultur aufzubauen, die neue Perspektiven und innovatives Denken fördert. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions umfasst einen Arbeitsplatz, an dem jeder die gleichen Chancen hat, beruflich zu gedeihen und sich zu entwickeln, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Rasse, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Geschlechtsidentität und / oder Ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, körperlicher oder geistiger Fähigkeit, Fähigkeiten, Gedanken oder anderen Eigenschaften. In unserem integrativen und flexiblen Umfeld kann jeder sein authentisches Selbst zur Arbeit bringen.

Über dich
Sie sind ein motivierter, detailorientierter Claims Professional, der stolz darauf ist, außergewöhnlichen Service und eine fundierte Beurteilung zu liefern. Sie bringen starkes analytisches Denken, hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit mit, sowohl unabhängig als auch kollaborativ mit einer Vielzahl von Stakeholdern zu arbeiten. Du repräsentierst das Unternehmen gerne nach außen und bist bestrebt, zu einer leistungsstarken, integrativen Teamkultur beizutragen.
Wir suchen Kandidaten, die diese Anforderungen erfüllen:

• Erfahrung mit Financial Lines-Forderungen: Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Umgang mit Financial Lines-Forderungen, einschließlich Direktoren und leitender Angestellter, Treuhänder und / oder Haftpflicht gegenüber Beschäftigungspraktiken

• Beurteilungskompetenz: Starke analytische, Verhandlungs- und Einflussfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Ansprüche von der ersten Ankündigung bis zur Auflösung unabhängig zu verwalten

• Lizenzierung: Derzeit hält oder ist bereit, Adjuster-Lizenzen zu erwerben, wie in verschiedenen Ländern erforderlich

• Kommunikationsfähigkeiten: Hervorragende verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Informationen an unterschiedliche Zielgruppen klar zu vermitteln

• Pädagogischer Hintergrund: Ein Universitätsabschluss oder ein gleichwertiger Abschluss ist erforderlich

Dies sind zusätzliche nett zu haben:

• Rechtlicher Hintergrund: Ein Jurastudium oder eine juristische Ausbildung ist sehr wünschenswert und wäre ein starker Gewinn in dieser Rolle

• Primary & Excess Environments: Erfahrung beim Navigieren in primären und überschüssigen Versicherungsansprüchen

• Stakeholder-Engagement: Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, mit Kunden, Brokern und internen Geschäftspartnern auf leitender Ebene zu interagieren

• Portfolioanalyse: Erfahrung in der Bereitstellung einer hochrangigen Portfolioanalyse und der Identifizierung von Schadenstrends zur Information der Geschäftsstrategie

• Cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Versicherungsmathematiker-, Finanz-, Risikomanagement- oder Underwriting-Teams

• Branchenpräsenz: Komfort, der eine Organisation auf Branchenkonferenzen, Kundenveranstaltungen und Funktionen der Fachgesellschaft repräsentiert

• International Exposure: Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit oder der Bereitstellung von Anleitungen für internationale Teams zu US-spezifischen Trends und Expositionen

• Self-Starter Mindset: Fähigkeit, mit minimaler direkter Aufsicht zu arbeiten und gleichzeitig eine komplexe und abwechslungsreiche Arbeitsbelastung zu bewältigen

• Reiseflexibilität: Bereitschaft, etwa 5-10% der Zeit zu reisen

Unser Unternehmen hat ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, bei dem erwartet wird, dass Sie mindestens drei Tage pro Woche im Büro sind.
Die geschätzte Grundgehaltsspanne für diese Position in Kansas City oder Chicago beträgt 69.000 bis 115.000 US-Dollar. Die geschätzte Basisgehaltsspanne für diese Position in NYC beträgt 75.000 bis 125.000 US-Dollar. Das spezifische Gehalt, das dafür oder eine bestimmte Rolle angeboten wird, berücksichtigt eine Reihe von Faktoren, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf den Arbeitsplatz, den Umfang der Rolle, die Qualifikationen, die Komplexität / Spezialisierung / Knappheit von Talenten, Erfahrung, Ausbildung und Arbeitgeberbudget. Bei Swiss Re verfolgen wir einen "Gesamtvergütungsansatz", wenn wir Entschädigungsentscheidungen treffen. Dies bedeutet, dass wir alle Komponenten der Entschädigung in ihrer Gesamtheit (wie Grundvergütung, kurz- und langfristige Anreize und angebotene Leistungen) bei der Festlegung der individuellen Entschädigung berücksichtigen.

Über Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen der versicherungsbasierten Risikoübertragung. Wir antizipieren und managen Risiken, von Naturkatastrophen und Klimawandel bis hin zu Cyberkriminalität.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions ist der gewerbliche Versicherungszweig der Swiss Re Gruppe. Wir bieten innovative Versicherungslösungen für große und mittlere multinationale Konzerne an unseren rund 50 Standorten weltweit. Wir helfen Kunden, ihre Risikoexposition zu mindern, während unser branchenführender Schadenservice ihnen zusätzliche Sicherheit bietet.

Unser Erfolg hängt von unserer Fähigkeit ab, eine integrative Kultur aufzubauen, die neue Perspektiven und innovatives Denken fördert. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions umfasst einen Arbeitsplatz, an dem jeder die gleichen Chancen hat, beruflich zu gedeihen und sich zu entwickeln, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Rasse, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Geschlechtsidentität und / oder Ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, körperlicher oder geistiger Fähigkeiten, Fähigkeiten, Gedanken oder anderen Eigenschaften. In unserem integrativen und flexiblen Umfeld kann jeder sein authentisches Selbst und seine Leidenschaft für Nachhaltigkeit mitbringen.

Wenn Sie ein erfahrener Profi sind, der nach einer Berufspause in die Belegschaft zurückkehrt, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich für offene Stellen zu bewerben, die Ihren Fähigkeiten und Ihrer Erfahrung entsprechen.

Während des Rekrutierungsprozesses sind angemessene Unterkünfte für Behinderungen auf Anfrage verfügbar. Wenn Sie für ein Interview kontaktiert werden, informieren Sie bitte den Recruiter / HR Professional über die erforderliche Unterkunft.

Nous envisageons des candidats qui vivent déjà dans ces zones métropolitaines.
Êtes-vous un professionnel chevronné avec une passion pour les lignes financières complexes et un effort pour offrir des expériences clients exceptionnelles? Chez Swiss Re Corporate Solutions, nous sommes à la recherche d'un spécialiste précis, collaboratif et axé sur le client pour rejoindre notre équipe dynamique US Casualty et Financial Lines Claims. Si vous prospèrez dans un environnement rapide où aucune revendication n'est la même, cela pourrait être l'occasion que vous attendiez!

À propos du rôle
Il s'agit d'une occasion rare et passionnante de s'approprier un portefeuille diversifié de créances sur les lignes financières — de la responsabilité des administrateurs et des dirigeants aux pratiques fiduciaires et d'emploi — tout en travaillant avec certains des esprits les plus brillants de l'industrie. Vous apporterez votre expertise dès le premier avis jusqu'à la résolution, tout en collaborant à l'échelle de la souscription, des produits et des équipes internationales pour fournir des résultats de pointe au marché pour nos clients.
Principales responsabilités

• Gérer activement un portefeuille d'administrateurs et d'administrateurs, de fiduciaires et/ou de pratiques d'emploi, avec pleine responsabilité d'arbitrage de bout en bout

• Naviguer avec confiance dans les environnements de réclamation d'assurance primaire et excédentaire, en appliquant un jugement solide et une expertise technique

• Collaborer étroitement avec les clients et les courtiers pour obtenir les résolutions les plus avantageuses et les plus opportunes

• Collaborer avec l'équipe des opérations pour assurer l'administration efficace des demandes, l'efficacité du processus et l'intégrité exacte des données

• Participer de manière proactive aux équipes de Marchés Clients et appuyer les efforts de développement des entreprises par le biais de réunions avec les clients et d'événements industriels

• Effectuer une analyse de haut niveau des résultats du portefeuille de réclamations, en identifiant les tendances et en donnant des indications pratiques aux entreprises

• Contribuer au développement de produits en examinant, appuyant et aidant à la création de formulations de politiques et de solutions sur mesure pour les clients

• Assurer la liaison avec les collègues d'actuariat, des finances et de la gestion des risques afin de partager l'information et de soutenir la gestion globale des réclamations, des clients et des risques

• Représenter Swiss Re Corporate Solutions lors de conférences, événements clients et activités de la société professionnelle, promouvoir notre marque et nos capacités

• Collaborer avec des collègues internationaux d'une région à l'autre, en donnant un aperçu utile des tendances et des expositions aux États-Unis

À propos de l'équipe
Suisse Re est l'un des principaux fournisseurs mondiaux de réassurance, d'assurance et d'autres formes de transfert de risque fondé sur l'assurance. Nous anticipons et gérons les risques - des catastrophes naturelles et du changement climatique à la cybercriminalité.
Swiss Re Corporate Solutions est la branche assurance commerciale du Groupe Swiss Re. Nous offrons des solutions d'assurance innovantes aux grandes et moyennes multinationales provenant d'une cinquantaine de sites dans le monde. Nous aidons les clients à atténuer leur exposition aux risques, tandis que notre service de réclamation leader de l'industrie leur procure une plus grande tranquillité d'esprit.
Notre succès dépend de notre capacité à bâtir une culture inclusive qui encourage de nouvelles perspectives et des idées novatrices. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions englobe un lieu de travail où chacun a les mêmes chances de prospérer et de se développer professionnellement, indépendamment de son âge, de son sexe, de sa race, de son appartenance ethnique, de son identité et/ou de son expression, de son orientation sexuelle, de ses aptitudes physiques ou mentales, de ses compétences, de sa pensée ou de toute autre caractéristique. Dans notre environnement inclusif et flexible, chacun peut apporter son authentique travail.

À propos de toi
Vous êtes un professionnel motivé, axé sur les revendications détaillées qui est fier de fournir un service exceptionnel et une saine décision. Vous apportez une pensée analytique forte, d'excellentes compétences en communication et la capacité de travailler de façon indépendante et en collaboration avec un large éventail d'intervenants. Vous êtes à l'aise de représenter l'entreprise à l'extérieur et êtes impatient de contribuer à une culture d'équipe très performante et inclusive.
Nous cherchons des candidats qui répondent à ces exigences :

• Expérience en matière de réclamations des secteurs financiers : Expérience démontrée en matière de réclamations des secteurs financiers, y compris les administrateurs et les dirigeants, les fiduciaires et/ou les pratiques d'emploi

• Expertise en arbitrage : Forte capacité d'analyse, de négociation et d'influence avec la capacité de gérer les revendications de façon indépendante, du premier avis au règlement

• Délivrance de licences : détient ou est prêt à acquérir des licences d'ajustement, selon les besoins, dans diverses administrations

• Compétences en communication : Excellentes compétences en communication verbale et écrite, avec la capacité de transmettre clairement des renseignements complexes à divers publics

• Contexte éducatif : Un diplôme universitaire ou équivalent est requis

Ce sont des avantages supplémentaires à avoir:

• Contexte juridique : Un diplôme en droit ou une formation juridique est hautement souhaitable et constituerait un atout important dans ce rôle

• Environnements primaires et excédentaires : expérience de navigation des environnements de sinistres primaires et excédentaires

• Engagement des intervenants : Capacité éprouvée de collaborer avec les clients, les courtiers et les partenaires commerciaux internes à un niveau supérieur

• Analyse de portefeuille : Expérience en matière d'analyse de portefeuille de haut niveau et identification des tendances en matière de réclamations pour éclairer la stratégie opérationnelle

• Collaboration interfonctionnelle : Expérience de travail avec des équipes d'actuariat, de finance, de gestion des risques ou de souscription

• Présence de l'industrie : Confort représentant une organisation à des conférences de l'industrie, des événements clients et des fonctions de la société professionnelle

• Exposition internationale: Expérience de travail avec des équipes internationales ou fourniture de conseils sur les tendances et les expositions propres aux États-Unis

• Self-Starter Mindset: Capacité à travailler avec une supervision directe minimale tout en gérant une charge de travail complexe et variée

• Souplesse des voyages : Volonté de voyager environ 5 à 10 % du temps

Notre entreprise a un modèle de travail hybride où l'on s'attend à ce que vous soyez au bureau au moins trois jours par semaine.
L'échelle salariale de base estimative pour ce poste à Kansas City ou Chicago est de 69 000 $ à 115 000 $. L'échelle salariale de base estimative pour ce poste à New York est de 75 000 $ à 125 000 $. Le salaire spécifique offert pour ce poste, ou tout autre rôle donné, tiendra compte d'un certain nombre de facteurs, y compris, sans s'y limiter, le lieu d'affectation, l'étendue du rôle, les qualifications, la complexité, la spécialisation ou la pénurie de talents, l'expérience, les études et le budget de l'employeur. Chez Swiss Re, nous adoptons une «approche de la rémunération totale» pour prendre des décisions en matière de rémunération. Cela signifie que nous considérons toutes les composantes de la rémunération dans leur ensemble (comme la rémunération de base, les incitatifs à court et à long terme et les avantages offerts) dans l'établissement de la rémunération individuelle.

À propos de Swiss Re Corporate Solutions
Suisse Re est l'un des principaux fournisseurs mondiaux de réassurance, d'assurance et d'autres formes de transfert de risque fondé sur l'assurance. Nous anticipons et gérons les risques, des catastrophes naturelles et du changement climatique à la cybercriminalité.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions est la branche assurance commerciale du Groupe Swiss Re. Nous offrons des solutions d'assurance innovantes aux grandes et moyennes multinationales de nos 50 sites dans le monde. Nous aidons les clients à atténuer leur exposition aux risques, tandis que notre service de réclamation leader de l'industrie leur procure une plus grande tranquillité d'esprit.

Notre succès dépend de notre capacité à bâtir une culture inclusive favorisant de nouvelles perspectives et une pensée novatrice. Swiss Re Corporate Solutions embrasse un lieu de travail où chacun a les mêmes chances de prospérer et de se développer professionnellement, quel que soit son âge, son sexe, sa race, son appartenance ethnique, son identité et/ou son expression, son orientation sexuelle, ses aptitudes physiques ou mentales, ses compétences, sa pensée ou d'autres caractéristiques. Dans notre environnement inclusif et flexible, tout le monde peut apporter son authentique soi au travail et sa passion pour la durabilité.

Si vous êtes un professionnel expérimenté qui revient au marché du travail après une interruption de carrière, nous vous encourageons à postuler à des postes ouverts qui correspondent à vos compétences et à votre expérience.

Suisse Re est un employeur à chances égales. Notre pratique consiste à recruter, embaucher et promouvoir sans égard à la race, à la religion, à la couleur, à l'origine nationale, au sexe, au handicap, à l'âge, à la grossesse, à l'orientation sexuelle, à l'état civil, à l'état militaire ou à toute autre caractéristique protégée par la loi. Les décisions relatives à l'emploi sont fondées uniquement sur les qualifications d'une personne pour le poste à pourvoir.

Pendant le processus de recrutement, des aménagements raisonnables sont disponibles sur demande. Si vous êtes contacté pour une entrevue, veuillez informer le recruteur/professionnel des RH de l'accommodement nécessaire.

Nous pouvons utiliser des outils alimentés par l'IA pour appuyer l'examen et l'évaluation des demandes pour ce poste. Ces outils fournissent des renseignements supplémentaires à nos équipes de recrutement, mais toutes les décisions d'embauche sont soigneusement examinées et prises par les gens. Pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous utilisons l'IA dans le recrutement et comment nous traitons vos données personnelles, veuillez consulter notre Déclaration de confidentialité des données avant de postuler.

jobs.description:
Senior Distribution Manager
 Are you ready to shape the future of commercial insurance in Japan? Join our dynamic team as a Senior Distribution Manager and leverage your expertise to build strategic partnerships, drive profitable growth, and make a significant impact in one of the world's most sophisticated insurance markets.
 About the Role
 As Senior Distribution Manager, you'll be at the forefront of our distribution strategy in Japan, working directly with the Head of Customer and Distribution to transform strategic vision into market success. This influential leadership position offers the opportunity to build lasting relationships with key agencies and brokers while driving sustainable business growth.
 Key Responsibilities

• Execute and enhance distribution strategies for the Japan market aligned with our strategic direction

• Drive new business generation and portfolio growth through agencies and brokers across relevant lines of business

• Develop and manage senior-level relationships with key agencies and brokers to build long-term strategic partnerships

• Bridge communication between the Japanese market and underwriting teams to ensure effective business flows

• Lead and develop the Distribution team, fostering a high-performance and collaborative culture

• Oversee activation, development and performance management of assigned agencies and brokers

• Monitor and analyze market trends, broker dynamics and competitive developments to inform strategic decisions

• Influence across functions to improve operational effectiveness, service quality and market competitiveness

• Negotiate effectively with senior internal and external stakeholders to achieve strategic business objectives

• Drive innovation in distribution through digital platforms, new approaches and differentiated value propositions

• Manage distribution pipeline, forecasting and performance tracking with transparency to senior management

• Collaborate with underwriting, operations and other functions to ensure alignment and seamless execution

• Provide guidance for insurance solicitation materials and key marketing initiatives

• Ensure accurate oversight of sales activities and reporting within Customer 360 and other relevant systems

• Support strategic initiatives led by the Head Customer and Distribution

• Maintain compliance with all applicable internal policies and external laws and regulations

• Represent our company in senior-level meetings with clients, agencies, brokers and other stakeholders

About the Team
 You'll join Swiss Re Corporate Solutions (Swiss Re International SE), Tokyo Office. As part of our dynamic and growing Customer and Distribution team reporting directly to the Head of Customer and Distribution, you'll help deliver innovative solutions to customers, agencies and brokers in the Japanese market.
 About You
 You're a seasoned commercial insurance professional with a proven track record in distribution management in the Japanese market. You thrive in collaborative environments and can effectively navigate complex stakeholder relationships while maintaining a strong focus on results.
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Further develop internal and client facing data solutions

• Provide a resilient and secure tech operating platform through continuous improvement and operational support

• Co-create advanced tech and data enabled services in global, cross functional teams

• Support many other exciting projects in a collaborative environment with colleagues from Swiss Re Asset Management's international offices
 Key Responsibilities

• Design, develop, test, and maintain end-to-end data solutions, from ETL processing to reports and visualisation

• Maintain and further enhance a reliable, governed and high-quality data foundation across various technologies, from PostgreSQL to Palantir Foundry

• Maintain code quality and automated testing using CI/CD pipelines

• Provide operational support and troubleshooting of the production issues

• Ensure timely delivery of business reporting deliverables aligned to closing cycles and financial markets needs

 You are a hands-on data engineer with a strong track record of delivering sustainable, data driven solutions.  • Strong knowledge of SQL and databases, preferably Postgres SQL

 These are additional nice to haves:
 • Experience on TypeScript / JavaScript

 • AI and ML engineering

Ready to build and run data driven digital services that power our Alternative Capital Partners organisation?
About the Role & Team
The Asset Management Digital and Tech Transformation unit has the mission to enable AM to become an AI powered, data centric organization . We foster a data-centric culture and ensure a state-of-the-art tech and data landscape, smartly using public cloud and SaaS solutions to provide innovative, secure and cost aware technology services.
If you join us, as a member of the ACP (Alternative Capital Partners) IT team, you will be able to participate in a variety of interesting initiatives . For example, you will:

• Further develop internal and client facing data solutions

• Provide a resilient and secure tech operating platform through continuous improvement and operational support

• Co-create advanced tech and data enabled services in global, cross functional teams

• Support many other exciting projects in a collaborative environment with colleagues from Swiss Re Asset Management's international offices
Key Responsibilities

• Design, develop, test, and maintain end-to-end data solutions, from ETL processing to reports and visualisation

• Maintain and further enhance a reliable, governed and high-quality data foundation across various technologies, from PostgreSQL to Palantir Foundry

• Maintain code quality and automated testing using CI/CD pipelines

• Provide operational support and troubleshooting of the production issues

• Ensure timely delivery of business reporting deliverables aligned to closing cycles and financial markets needs
About You
You are a hands-on data engineer with a strong track record of delivering sustainable, data driven solutions. Your passion is engineering and Data practices and fully recognize the benefits of ETL processes that ensure data is accurate, reliable, and accessible. You take ownership for reliable operations, approach new challenges with a solution-oriented mindset, and enjoy partnering with business SMEs in cross-functional teams. You care about security, quality, user experience, documentation, testing, and the bigger picture.
We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:
• Degree in Computer Science (Master's preferred) or a comparable engineering discipline
• 5+ years' experience building and operating data solutions
• Strong understanding of data modelling, ETL processes and data warehousing concepts
• Strong knowledge of SQL and databases, preferably Postgres SQL
• Strong programming skills in Python
• E xperience with Data frameworks (Pandas, Polars, PySpark)
• Experience with Palantir Foundry, Databricks or similar
• Strong analytical, conceptual, and problem-solving skills
• Good knowledge and work experience on automated testing (e.g. pytest) or test driven-development approach
• Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across global teams
• Proficiency in English (written & verbal)
These are additional nice to haves:
• Experience on TypeScript / JavaScript
• Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and tools using Azure DevOps or equivalent platforms
• Familiarity with batch processing and application operations, monitoring, and orchestration, preferably UC4
• AI and ML engineering
• Comfortable working in agile delivery environments (e.g., Azure DevOps, Jira)
Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.
For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between [EUR 2,400] and [EUR 4,100] per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:​

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role, ​

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.​

In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.​
Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.​
About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 14,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Bereit zum Aufbau und Betrieb datengesteuerter digitaler Dienste, die unsere Organisation von Alternative Capital Partners unterstützen?

Die Asset Management Digital and Tech Transformation Unit hat es sich zur Aufgabe gemacht, AM zu einer KI-gestützten, datenzentrierten Organisation zu machen. Über dich
Sie sind ein praktischer Dateningenieur mit einer starken Erfolgsbilanz bei der Bereitstellung nachhaltiger, datengesteuerter Lösungen. Ihre Leidenschaft sind Engineering- und Datenpraktiken und erkennen die Vorteile von ETL-Prozessen an, die sicherstellen, dass Daten korrekt, zuverlässig und zugänglich sind. Sie übernehmen Verantwortung für zuverlässige Abläufe, gehen neue Herausforderungen mit einer lösungsorientierten Denkweise an und genießen die Zusammenarbeit mit KMU in funktionsübergreifenden Teams. Sie kümmern sich um Sicherheit, Qualität, Benutzererfahrung, Dokumentation, Tests und das Gesamtbild.
Wir suchen Kandidaten, die diese Anforderungen erfüllen:
• Abschluss in Informatik (Master bevorzugt) oder einer vergleichbaren Ingenieurdisziplin
• 5+ Jahre Erfahrung beim Aufbau und Betrieb von Datenlösungen
• Starkes Verständnis von Datenmodellierung, ETL-Prozessen und Data-Warehousing-Konzepten
• Starke Kenntnisse von SQL und Datenbanken, vorzugsweise Postgres SQL
• Starke Programmierkenntnisse in Python
• E xperience mit Data Frameworks (Pandas, Polars, PySpark)
• Erfahrungen mit Palantir Foundry, Databricks oder ähnlichem
• Starke analytische, konzeptionelle und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten
• Gute Kenntnisse und Arbeitserfahrung im automatisierten Testen (z. B. Pytest) oder Test-Driven-Development-Ansatz
• Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit zur Zusammenarbeit in globalen Teams
• Englischkenntnisse (schriftlich und mündlich)
Dies sind zusätzliche nett zu haben:
• Erfahrung mit TypeScript / JavaScript
• Vertrautheit mit CI/CD-Konzepten und -Tools mit Azure DevOps oder gleichwertigen Plattformen
• Vertrautheit mit Batch-Verarbeitungs- und Anwendungsoperationen, Überwachung und Orchestrierung, vorzugsweise UC4
• AI und ML Engineering
• Komfortables Arbeiten in agilen Bereitstellungsumgebungen (z.B. Azure DevOps, Jira)
Unser Unternehmen hat ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, bei dem erwartet wird, dass Sie mindestens drei Tage pro Woche im Büro sind.
Für die Slowakei liegt die Grundgehaltsspanne für diese Position zwischen [2400 EUR] und [4100 EUR] pro Monat (für eine Vollzeitstelle). Das angebotene spezifische Gehalt berücksichtigt:

• Anforderungen, Umfang, Komplexität und Zuständigkeiten der Rolle,

• das Profil des Antragstellers, einschließlich Ausbildung/Qualifikationen, Fachwissen, Spezialisierung, Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung.

Zusätzlich zu Ihrem Grundgehalt bietet Swiss Re eine attraktive leistungsbasierte variable Vergütungskomponente, die Ihre Leistungen würdigt. Darüber hinaus genießen Sie eine Vielzahl von globalen und standortspezifischen Vorteilen.
Die Berechtigung kann je nach den Bedingungen der Swiss Re Police und Ihrem Arbeitsvertrag variieren.
Über Swiss Re
Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen des versicherungsbasierten Risikotransfers und arbeitet daran, die Welt widerstandsfähiger zu machen. Wir antizipieren und managen eine Vielzahl von Risiken, von Naturkatastrophen und Klimawandel bis hin zu Cyberkriminalität. Durch die Kombination von Erfahrung mit kreativem Denken und modernster Expertise schaffen wir neue Möglichkeiten und Lösungen für unsere Kunden. Dies ist dank der Zusammenarbeit von mehr als 14.000 Mitarbeitern auf der ganzen Welt möglich.

Unser Erfolg hängt von unserer Fähigkeit ab, eine integrative Kultur aufzubauen, die neue Perspektiven und innovatives Denken fördert. Wir nehmen einen Arbeitsplatz an, an dem jeder die gleichen Chancen hat, beruflich zu gedeihen und sich zu entwickeln, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Rasse, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Geschlechtsidentität und / oder Ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, körperlicher oder geistiger Fähigkeit, Fähigkeiten, Gedanken oder anderen Eigenschaften. In unserem integrativen und flexiblen Umfeld kann jeder sein authentisches Selbst und seine Leidenschaft für Nachhaltigkeit mitbringen.

Wenn Sie ein erfahrener Profi sind, der nach einer Berufspause in die Belegschaft zurückkehrt, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich für offene Stellen zu bewerben, die Ihren Fähigkeiten und Ihrer Erfahrung entsprechen.
Wir können KI-basierte Tools verwenden, um die Überprüfung und Bewertung von Anwendungen für diese Position zu unterstützen. Diese Tools bieten unseren Rekrutierungsteams zusätzliche Einblicke, aber alle Einstellungsentscheidungen werden sorgfältig überprüft und von Menschen getroffen. Um mehr darüber zu erfahren, wie wir KI bei der Rekrutierung einsetzen und wie wir mit Ihren personenbezogenen Daten umgehen, lesen Sie bitte unsere Datenschutzerklärung, bevor Sie sich bewerben.

jobs.description:
Overview
 At iptiQ by Swiss Re, we are building the next generation of digital life and health insurance. Our engineering teams are driving innovation across large-scale, cloud-native platforms that power millions of customer interactions. We blend modern software engineering with deep industry expertise to create solutions that are accessible, reliable, and user-centric. Our technology extends well beyond traditional insurance and encompasses data-intensive systems, modern architectures, digital health solutions, advanced analytics, and secure, high-performance services.
 About the role
 As a Lead Software Engineer , you will take ownership of significant cross-domain initiatives, influence architectural direction, and guide engineering teams through complex technical challenges. You will partner closely with Senior Engineering Managers (SEMs), architects, and cross-functional leads to plan and deliver large, strategic programs.
 You will also serve as a technical role model—driving high-quality engineering practices, ensuring robust delivery forecasting, and elevating the technical maturity of your domain.
 Our Technology Stack
 Our cloud-native, multi-tenant SaaS platform runs on AWS. We use Kotlin, Java, SpringBoot, Docker, Kubernetes, Apache Kafka, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL on the backend, and ReactJS and TypeScript on the frontend. Our continuous delivery pipeline leverages GitLab. We are using Prometheus, ElasticSearch, Kibana and Grafana as our logging and monitoring stack.
 Our mission
 iptiQ is not just an insurance company; we are at the forefront of integrating technology into the life and health insurance space. We employ people with diverse technical backgrounds who are eager to solve some of the industry's most complex problems and make a lasting impact on our customers globally. At iptiQ, you'll not only be a part of transforming the insurance industry but also work on large-scale applications and new platforms that redefine how insurance products are developed and delivered. From revolutionizing underwriting processes to creating user-centric digital health tools, our engineers are at the heart of iptiQ's mission to transform the world of insurance.
 Ideal Candidate:
 We are looking for someone who:

• Has strong technical depth in several components of our stack, with proven ability to lead complex engineering efforts.

• Operates with ownership and accountability over domain-quality and cross-domain delivery.

• Has an entrepreneurial mindset, continuously seeks improvement, and motivates teams through influence rather than authority.

• Demonstrates exceptional collaboration skills across engineering, product, architecture, and operations.

• Acts as a mentor and technical leader for engineers across multiple teams.
 Key Responsibilities:

• Drive and deliver multi-quarter, cross-domain initiatives and support SEMs with planning, estimation accuracy, and technical alignment.

• Lead technical grooming for complex, cross-domain features and guide story preparation for small to medium domain work.

• Shape and communicate technical proposals (RFCs) and guide them through CTO-level decision-making.

• Act as a domain expert , providing guidance on architectural decisions and integration impacts.

• Independently design and develop high-quality features while continuously improving domain quality (logging, error handling, documentation, API clarity).

• Maintain strong engineering discipline by following DoR/DoD, avoiding unaligned refactoring, and ensuring clear, maintainable documentation.

• Achieve high delivery predictability (90–100% estimation accuracy) and effectively manage unplanned work within planned capacity.

• Mentor and support engineers across teams, elevating technical capabilities and cross-domain collaboration.
 What We Offer:

• A supportive and collaborative team environment

• Opportunity to work on cutting-edge technologies

• Professional growth and learning opportunities

• Flexible working time and location
 For Spain, the base salary range for this position is between EUR 60,000 and EUR 100,000 (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers: ​

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,​

• the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.​
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.​
 Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.​

 At iptiQ, we partner with established brands around the world to create impactful digital insurance solutions. We make it easier for consumers to buy the insurance they need from the brands they trust. We provide life and non-life insurance through our end-to-end digital platform and build multi-channel customer experiences.

What we offer our employees is outstanding. Hybrid working in offices across the world, phenomenal learning & career opportunities and a culture that encourages new perspectives to challenge conventions and come up with innovative solutions. We believe in the power of inclusion. Drawing on our employees' broad range of perspectives, life experiences and backgrounds stimulates creativity and gives us a competitive edge. iptiQ embraces a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive regardless of their age, gender, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, religion, physical or mental ability, or other characteristic and can be their authentic self. Ignite your curiosity to shape digital insurance.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

iptiQ is part of Swiss Re, one of the world’s leading providers of re/insurance and risk transfer solutions. This means we’re backed by Swiss Re’s capital strength and more than 150 years of risk knowledge. Through our partnerships, we contribute to Swiss Re’s vision to make the world more resilient.

Panoramica
In iptiQ by Swiss Re, stiamo costruendo la prossima generazione di assicurazione sulla vita digitale e sulla salute. I nostri team di ingegneria stanno guidando l'innovazione attraverso piattaforme cloud-native su larga scala che alimentano milioni di interazioni dei clienti. Uniamo l'ingegneria software moderna con una profonda esperienza nel settore per creare soluzioni accessibili, affidabili e orientate all'utente. La nostra tecnologia si estende ben oltre l'assicurazione tradizionale e comprende sistemi ad alta intensità di dati, architetture moderne, soluzioni sanitarie digitali, analisi avanzate e servizi sicuri e ad alte prestazioni.
Informazioni sul ruolo
Come Lead Software Engineer , prenderete la proprietà di significative iniziative cross-domain, influenzare la direzione architettonica e guidare i team di ingegneria attraverso complesse sfide tecniche. Potrai collaborare a stretto contatto con Senior Engineering Managers (SEM), architetti e cross-funzionali porta a pianificare e fornire grandi programmi strategici.
Potrai anche fungere da modello di ruolo tecnico – guidando pratiche di ingegneria di alta qualità, garantendo una robusta previsione di consegna e aumentando la maturità tecnica del tuo dominio.
La nostra tecnologia Stack
La nostra piattaforma SaaS cloud-native e multi-tenant funziona su AWS. Usiamo Kotlin, Java, SpringBoot, Docker, Kubernetes, Apache Kafka, MongoDB e PostgreSQL sul backend, e ReactJS e TypeScript sul frontend. La nostra fornitura continua sfrutta GitLab. Stiamo usando Prometheus, ElasticSearch, Kibana e Grafana come il nostro stack di registrazione e monitoraggio.
La nostra missione
iptiQ non è solo una società di assicurazione; siamo in prima linea nell'integrazione della tecnologia nello spazio di assicurazione sulla vita e sulla salute. Usiamo persone con diversi background tecnici che sono desiderosi di risolvere alcuni dei problemi più complessi del settore e di avere un impatto duraturo sui nostri clienti a livello globale. A iptiQ, non solo farai parte della trasformazione dell'industria assicurativa, ma lavorerai anche su applicazioni su larga scala e nuove piattaforme che ridefiniscono come i prodotti assicurativi sono sviluppati e consegnati. Dalla rivoluzione dei processi di sottoscrizione alla creazione di strumenti per la salute digitale incentrati sull'utente, i nostri ingegneri sono al centro della missione di iptiQ di trasformare il mondo dell'assicurazione.
Candidato ideale:
Stiamo cercando qualcuno che:

• Ha una forte profondità tecnica in diversi componenti del nostro stack, con comprovata capacità di condurre complessi sforzi di ingegneria.

• Funziona con proprietà e responsabilità rispetto alla qualità del dominio e consegna cross-domain.

• Ha una mentalità imprenditoriale, cerca continuamente miglioramento e motiva le squadre attraverso l'influenza piuttosto che l'autorità.

• Dimostra competenze di collaborazione eccezionali tra ingegneria, prodotto, architettura e operazioni.

• Agisce come mentore e leader tecnico per gli ingegneri di più squadre.
Responsabilità chiave:

• Guidare e fornire iniziative multiquarter, cross-domain e supportare SEMs con pianificazione, precisione di stima e allineamento tecnico.

• Guidare la toelettatura tecnica per caratteristiche complesse e cross-domain e la preparazione di storia guida per il lavoro di dominio piccolo e medio.

Overview
At iptiQ by Swiss Re, we are building the next generation of digital life and health insurance. Our engineering teams are driving innovation across large-scale, cloud-native platforms that power millions of customer interactions. We blend modern software engineering with deep industry expertise to create solutions that are accessible, reliable, and user-centric. Our technology extends well beyond traditional insurance and encompasses data-intensive systems, modern architectures, digital health solutions, advanced analytics, and secure, high-performance services.
About the role
As a Lead Software Engineer , you will take ownership of significant cross-domain initiatives, influence architectural direction, and guide engineering teams through complex technical challenges. You will partner closely with Senior Engineering Managers (SEMs), architects, and cross-functional leads to plan and deliver large, strategic programs.
You will also serve as a technical role model—driving high-quality engineering practices, ensuring robust delivery forecasting, and elevating the technical maturity of your domain.
Our Technology Stack
Our cloud-native, multi-tenant SaaS platform runs on AWS. We use Kotlin, Java, SpringBoot, Docker, Kubernetes, Apache Kafka, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL on the backend, and ReactJS and TypeScript on the frontend. Our continuous delivery pipeline leverages GitLab. We are using Prometheus, ElasticSearch, Kibana and Grafana as our logging and monitoring stack.
Our mission
iptiQ is not just an insurance company; we are at the forefront of integrating technology into the life and health insurance space. We employ people with diverse technical backgrounds who are eager to solve some of the industry's most complex problems and make a lasting impact on our customers globally. At iptiQ, you'll not only be a part of transforming the insurance industry but also work on large-scale applications and new platforms that redefine how insurance products are developed and delivered. From revolutionizing underwriting processes to creating user-centric digital health tools, our engineers are at the heart of iptiQ's mission to transform the world of insurance.
Ideal Candidate:
We are looking for someone who:

• Has strong technical depth in several components of our stack, with proven ability to lead complex engineering efforts.

• Operates with ownership and accountability over domain-quality and cross-domain delivery.

• Has an entrepreneurial mindset, continuously seeks improvement, and motivates teams through influence rather than authority.

• Demonstrates exceptional collaboration skills across engineering, product, architecture, and operations.

• Acts as a mentor and technical leader for engineers across multiple teams.
Key Responsibilities:

• Drive and deliver multi-quarter, cross-domain initiatives and support SEMs with planning, estimation accuracy, and technical alignment.

• Lead technical grooming for complex, cross-domain features and guide story preparation for small to medium domain work.

• Shape and communicate technical proposals (RFCs) and guide them through CTO-level decision-making.

• Act as a domain expert , providing guidance on architectural decisions and integration impacts.

• Independently design and develop high-quality features while continuously improving domain quality (logging, error handling, documentation, API clarity).

• Maintain strong engineering discipline by following DoR/DoD, avoiding unaligned refactoring, and ensuring clear, maintainable documentation.

• Achieve high delivery predictability (90–100% estimation accuracy) and effectively manage unplanned work within planned capacity.

• Mentor and support engineers across teams, elevating technical capabilities and cross-domain collaboration.
What We Offer:

• A supportive and collaborative team environment

• Opportunity to work on cutting-edge technologies

• Professional growth and learning opportunities

• Flexible working time and location
For Spain, the base salary range for this position is between EUR 60,000 and EUR 100,000 (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers: ​

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,​

• the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.​
In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.​
Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.​
#LI-Hybrid
About iptiQ
At iptiQ, we partner with established brands around the world to create impactful digital insurance solutions. We make it easier for consumers to buy the insurance they need from the brands they trust. We provide life and non-life insurance through our end-to-end digital platform and build multi-channel customer experiences.

What we offer our employees is outstanding. Hybrid working in offices across the world, phenomenal learning & career opportunities and a culture that encourages new perspectives to challenge conventions and come up with innovative solutions. We believe in the power of inclusion. Drawing on our employees' broad range of perspectives, life experiences and backgrounds stimulates creativity and gives us a competitive edge. iptiQ embraces a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive regardless of their age, gender, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, religion, physical or mental ability, or other characteristic and can be their authentic self. Ignite your curiosity to shape digital insurance.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

iptiQ is part of Swiss Re, one of the world’s leading providers of re/insurance and risk transfer solutions. This means we’re backed by Swiss Re’s capital strength and more than 150 years of risk knowledge. Through our partnerships, we contribute to Swiss Re’s vision to make the world more resilient.

These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. Über die Rolle

Als Spezialist für Versicherungsverträge befinden Sie sich an der Schnittstelle zwischen vertraglicher Präzision und Versicherungsexpertise, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Verträge robust, konform und auf die Ziele der französischen Geschäftseinheit ausgerichtet sind. Sie arbeiten mit Underwritern und Stakeholdern zusammen, um maßgeschneiderte Lösungen zu entwickeln, die unsere Interessen schützen und gleichzeitig die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden erfüllen.
Hauptzuständigkeiten

• Entwerfen und entwickeln Sie French Swiss Re CorSo Formulare und Ad-hoc-Klauseln und Formulierungen mit Präzision und Genauigkeit.

• Überprüfen und analysieren Sie die Formulierungen von Drittanbietern, um Risiken und Verstöße gegen interne Richtlinien zu identifizieren.

• Arbeiten Sie mit Underwritern und internen Stakeholdern zu komplexen Formulierungsthemen zusammen.

• Durchführung von Audits durch umfassende Vertragsüberprüfungen, um Compliance und Qualität zu gewährleisten.

• Überwachen Sie die Marktentwicklungen, um proaktiv Verträge zu sperren und neue Trends zu identifizieren.

• Analyse der Formulierungen der Wettbewerber, um Einblicke in die vorherrschenden Marktstandards zu erhalten und das Verständnis der operativen Praktiken auf dem französischen Markt zu verbessern.

• Durchführung von Schulungen und Sensibilisierungssitzungen, um das Wissen der Stakeholder über politische Formulierungen und Vertragsgrundsätze zu verbessern.

• Bereitstellung einer fachkundigen Beratung in Vertragsangelegenheiten zur Unterstützung der Geschäftsziele und des Risikomanagements.

Über das Team

Das EMEA Contracts & Wording-Team ist für die Ausarbeitung von Formulierungen und Klauseln für Versicherungspolicen mit großen Risiken, die Überprüfung von Formulierungen Dritter und die Bereitstellung von Expertenberatung in Vertragsangelegenheiten verantwortlich. Wir arbeiten eng mit Underwritern zusammen, um eine robuste Vertragsentwicklung zu gewährleisten und gleichzeitig die Markttrends zu überwachen, um die Interessen des Unternehmens zu schützen. Unser Team bietet auch spezialisierte Schulungen an, um das organisatorische Verständnis der Versicherungsvertragsgrundsätze zu verbessern.
Über dich

Sie sind ein detailorientierter Profi, der sich für Underwriting und vertragliche Präzision begeistert. Sie gedeihen in kollaborativen Umgebungen, in denen Sie Ihre analytische Denkweise anwenden können, um komplexe Probleme zu lösen. Ihre Kommunikationsfähigkeiten ermöglichen es Ihnen, komplizierte Vertragskonzepte verschiedenen Interessengruppen klar zu erklären, und Sie sind dem kontinuierlichen Lernen in einer sich entwickelnden Versicherungslandschaft verpflichtet.
Wir suchen Kandidaten, die diese Anforderungen erfüllen:

• Fließend Französisch mit nativen Kenntnissen.

• Mindestens 7 Jahre Erfahrung in der Zeichnung oder Ansprüche, mit einem soliden Verständnis der Versicherungsgrundsätze.

• Umfassende Kenntnisse der Richtlinienformulierungen in den primären CorSo-Geschäftsbereichen wie E & C, Property, GL oder FinPro sowie deren praktische Umsetzung.

• Rechtliche Eignung und außergewöhnliche Liebe zum Detail mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Vertragssprache zu analysieren.

• Erfolgsbilanz beim Aufbau starker Beziehungen zu Underwritern und als integriertes Teammitglied.

• Nachweis der Fähigkeit, Interessengruppen zu beeinflussen und Vertragsänderungen effektiv auszuhandeln.

• Starke Fähigkeit, effektiv zu kommunizieren.
